name: Emenski Canyon Run
description: Emenski Canyon Run 2026 is a mountain running event held in the village of Emen, Veliko Tarnovo Province. The race offers three courses of varying distance and elevation gain: 8 km with 360 m of positive elevation gain, 16 km with 720 m, and 24 km with 1,100 m. Participants can enjoy marked trails, aid stations, and professional timing. The event includes a medal and souvenir for all finishers, as well as race photos.
course_highlights: Three courses of 8 km, 16 km, and 24 km
Mountain terrain with 360 to 1,100 metres of positive elevation gain
Marked trails and aid stations along the route
additional: Registration and race-pack collection from 08:00 to 11:00. Technical briefing at 10:20 at the start. Starts: 24 km at 10:30, 16 km at 11:00, and 8 km at 11:45. A medal and souvenir for all finishers. Timing and a race bib for all participants. Race photography. Trail running across different distances, registration, medals, aid stations, and technical information for participants.

description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Race is a running event held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run along the cool trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes several races over distances of 15 km, 7 km and 3 km, as well as a race for families, making it suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. Participants can enjoy a natural, scenic and healthy setting, away from paved roads.
course_highlights: Route along the cool trails of Hoia Forest
Various distances: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km and a family race
Event held in nature, away from paved roads
additional: The event includes a registration package with a T-shirt and race number. Races are held for all ages, including one dedicated to families. The route follows natural forest trails, offering a running experience in nature. The race starts in the evening, creating a special night-race atmosphere. The participation fee includes a medal, timing and medical assistance. Registration is exclusively online, with entries open until June 13, 2026.

name: CROSUL 15 NOIEMBRIE
description: The 15 November Run is an annual sporting event held in Brașov, commemorating the Anti-Communist Revolt of 15 November 1987 by workers at the Roman Truck Factory. The main event is a 5-kilometre road race along the historic route of the revolt, open to all running enthusiasts. There are also races for children, with distances adapted to their ages, promoting physical activity and team spirit. The event is organized by Brașov City Hall in partnership with the 15 November 1987 Brașov Association and the Together for Movement Sports Club.
course_highlights: A historic 5 km route along the streets associated with the 1987 Brașov Revolt
An urban road route through Brașov, including historic and cultural landmarks
Children’s races from 250 m to 1.2 km, adapted for different age groups
additional: Registration is free and limited to 1,800 participants (1,500 adults and 300 children). Race kits can be collected the day before at the Sport Guru Brașov store between 15:30 and 20:00. The race starts inside the SC Roman industrial park, right outside the former Section 440 of the Truck Factory, where the revolt began. Running on the streets of Brașov, a 5 km route, races for all ages, commemorative event, organized in November 2025

name: Маратон Бургас
price_range: от 10 до 50 EUR в зависимост от избраната дистанцията и периода
description:
Burgas Marathon 2026 awaits you on November 15 for an unforgettable run!

Whether you’re chasing a new personal best, preparing for your first half marathon, or simply want to share the excitement of sport with your family and friends, Burgas Marathon offers a distance for everyone.

Choose your challenge:

42.195 km Marathon | 21.097 km Half Marathon | 10.5 km | 5 km |
1 km Decathlon Fun Run – for children, families, and everyone who wants to be part of the running celebration

The course runs along the sea and past iconic locations in Burgas, combining a fast route, beautiful views, and an incredible atmosphere. Participants from Bulgaria and abroad, dozens of volunteers, music, support along the course, and that unforgettable feeling when you cross the finish line await you.

Choose your distance, register, and become part of the event that brings people together through sport, movement, and a love of an active lifestyle.

Burgas Marathon – Run with the pulse of Burgas!

name: 2ος Δρόμος Υγείας «Αγιος Δημήτριος – Στα Μονοπάτια των Ορυζώνων»
4o Γίδι των Μεθάνων
description: The 4th Methana Goat is a mountain race organized under the auspices of the Municipality of Troizinia–Methana, with the participation of the Argolis Hellenic Rescue Team. It is a challenging course offering unique mountain-running experiences in a volcanic landscape of great natural beauty. The race is a celebration for lovers of the mountains and adventure, attracting runners seeking a challenge and a connection with nature. The organizers emphasize the safety and support of participants throughout the race.
course_highlights: The volcanic landscape of Methana
Routes with steep climbs and natural beauty
Extensive views of the sea and mountains
additional: The race includes 28 km and 12 km routes, with elevation gains of up to +1720 m and +680 m, respectively, and offers cultural and entertainment events. The area is known for its thermal baths and unique natural landscape.

name: XL kmrun - Бонсови поляни
description: XL kmrun – Bonsovi Polyani is a November race in the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun. It takes place in the Lyulin Mountain area and the iconic Bonsovi Polyani locality on the outskirts of Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances—short, medium, and long—allowing runners with different levels of preparation and ambitions to take part. The event is part of a series of races offering varied courses and running conditions in the natural surroundings of Sofia.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Lyulin Mountain area and the Bonsovi Polyani locality
A choice of three distances—short, medium, and long
A natural, iconic location on the outskirts of Sofia
additional: The race will take place in a natural setting with mountainous terrain; registration details and fees have not been specified. The date is November 22, 2026.

description: The 1st Nafpaktos Half Marathon “Ahepa Run” is a new road race that combines sport with Greece’s cultural heritage. The race routes pass through historic paths and natural landscapes, offering a unique running experience for all runners. The event also includes a 1 km race for children and a 5 km race for amateur runners and people with disabilities, promoting social connection and sustainable tourism. Participants receive full support, electronic timing, and commemorative gifts.
course_highlights: Routes through ancient paths and natural landscapes
5 hydration stations with water and energy drinks
Electronic timing and medical support throughout
additional: Participant amenities: race bib, backpack, commemorative T-shirt, finisher’s medal, electronic certificate, medical support, bag-drop and changing facilities, athlete transportation, 5 hydration stations, electronic timing, and refreshments along the course and at the finish. The event includes a half marathon, a 5 km race, and a 1 km children’s race, with impressive routes through natural and historic landscapes. Participation promotes health and the area’s cultural identity.

name: Gidi of Methana
description: The Methana GOAT is an annual mountain running race held in autumn on the volcanic peninsula of Methana. It offers courses of 28 km with 1,720 m of elevation gain, 12 km with 680 m, and 5 km with 120 m, attracting athletes seeking a challenge across rugged volcanic terrain. The race stands out for its constantly changing scenery, views of the sea from high points, and warm hospitality. The area’s thermal baths offer a chance to relax before or after the race.
course_highlights: Volcanic terrain with steep climbs
Frequent views of the sea from high mountain passes
Beautiful landscapes with changing natural surroundings
additional: Courses: 28 km (+1,720 m), 12 km (+680 m), and 5 km (+120 m). The area’s thermal baths offer a chance to relax before or after the race. Trail race through volcanic landscapes in Methana, Greece; registration via the official website; scheduled for November 22–23, 2025.

name: Zapad Fruške Gore 2026
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a competitive and recreational sporting event held on Fruška Gora, known for its historic trails and new challenges. The event features various courses, including an ultra-extreme marathon, an ultra marathon, and medium and short courses suited to runners of different abilities. It brings together nature and running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience amid the beautiful landscapes of Fruška Gora. The organizers aim to provide good organization and support for participants throughout the event.
course_highlights: Ultra Extreme Marathon with 5 ITRA points
Middle Eastern Marathon with 3 ITRA points
Apprentice Southern Marathon with 1 ITRA point
additional: Transport to the marathon start from Novi Sad is organized for Saturday from 6:00. On-site registration for the FUN courses is available at Popovica on Saturday. Race packets are collected before the race. The races are scored under the ITRA system across different courses. Participants can expect various race categories, including ultra, medium, and beginner courses, with online registration available. The event is part of a wider festival promoting sport and nature on Fruška Gora.

description: The International Olympia Marathon is a historic road race held in Ancient Olympia, the birthplace of Olympism. Runners have the opportunity to run along the historic “Sacred Way,” following a route rich in cultural memory and sporting ideals. The event includes a Marathon, Half Marathon, 10 km, Family Run, and children’s race, offering a unique sporting experience for everyone. The start and finish are at the Town Hall Square in Ancient Olympia, with full support and services for participants.
course_highlights: Route along the historic “Sacred Way” of Ancient Olympia
8 support stations with water, isotonic drinks, energy gels, and medical assistance
Kilometre markers every 5 km and electronic timing
additional: Runner benefits: race bib with electronic timing chip, commemorative medal and T-shirt, and water, isotonic drink, energy drink, and non-alcoholic beer at the finish. There are 8 support stations with water, isotonic drink, and energy gels. A medical check is mandatory to participate. Doping control is conducted by the Hellenic Anti-Doping Organization. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the Ancient Olympia Town Hall, as well as portable toilets along the course. Runners must keep to the right side of the road. The event welcomes participants from around the world and features celebrations and awards, with an emphasis on cultural heritage and the spirit of the Olympic Games.

description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a mountain running event celebrating Romania on National Day, held in Cluj-Napoca. In its 9th edition in 2026, the event offers a variety of routes, including a 50 km ultramarathon, team races, a half marathon, a cross-country race, and children’s races. Participants can support one of Romania’s 9 historical regions while enjoying scenic landscapes and a friendly atmosphere. The main 50 km route passes through natural and urban areas, with well-organized hydration and refreshment stations. The event also includes a live broadcast, modern facilities, and prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: The Ultra 50k route passes through forests, urban areas, and ski slopes around Cluj
Hydration and refreshment stations offer water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and sweets
The final 12 km are predominantly downhill, with just one climb of more than 100 m
additional: The runner’s kit includes a race bib with timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and live rankings, a finisher’s medal, and access to hydration and refreshment stations offering sweet and savory products, still and sparkling water, isotonic drinks, supplements, and fruit. A refund policy is available if announced by November 9, 2026. Time limits are 9h for Ultra 50k, 5h for Half 25k, 3h for Cross 15k, and 1h30 for Mini EcoTrail 7k. The event also includes Play&Run children’s races and an awards ceremony at 15:00. Race distances include Ultra 50k, Half 25k, Cross 15k, Mini EcoTrail 7k, and children’s races; events take place from November 28 to December 1, 2026, with exhibitions, kit distribution, and awards ceremonies.

name: MARATON 1 DECEMBRIE
description: The 1 December Marathon is an annual competition held in IOR Park in Bucharest, open to runners of all levels. The event offers an enjoyable sporting experience, with well-organized courses and a friendly atmosphere. Participants can receive race kits and attentive organizational support, helping ensure a safe and motivating race. The marathon also supports charitable causes, bringing the community together for a worthy purpose.
course_highlights: Course held in IOR Park, Bucharest
Race kits handed directly to participants or to a representative with the required documents
Race kit collection available over the three days before the race
additional: Race kits can be collected over the three days before the race at locations in Bucharest: SportGuru Store (69 Unirii Boulevard) and ParkLake Shopping Center. Kits are handed only to the registered and validated participant, upon presentation of an identity document. Another person may collect a kit only with a signed copy of the participant’s identity document. For the teenagers’ race, the kit is handed only to the minor, accompanied by a parent or legal guardian who signs a declaration of physical and medical fitness. Participation includes races for different categories and supports charitable causes; the event has a tradition of promoting an active and healthy lifestyle.

description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a landmark event celebrating Romania on National Day, offering runners a unique trail-running experience in the picturesque landscapes around Cluj. Now in its 9th edition, the main Ultra 50k race is a favorite among trail runners for the challenge and beauty of its course, which includes forests and spectacular climbs and descents. Participants can support one of Romania’s 9 historical regions, and the atmosphere is friendly and festive, with well-stocked aid stations and personalized finisher medals. The event also includes races for all ages and levels, from Mini EcoTrail to team races.
course_highlights: A 50 km course with climbs and descents through the forests around Cluj
Checkpoints and hydration stations offering a variety of refreshments (water, isotonic drinks, fruit, sweets, and savory food)
Views above Cluj-Napoca and iconic areas such as Borhanci, the Poarta de su’ Feleac Museum, and the Feleacu ski slopes
additional: The race kit includes a race bib with a timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and live rankings, a personalized finisher medal, and access to aid stations serving sweet and savory foods, isotonic drinks, and fruit. There are children’s races and team races with special rules on the spacing between members. Cut-off times: 9h for Ultra 50k, 5h for Half 25k, 3h for Cross 15k, and 1h30 for Mini EcoTrail 7k. Refund insurance is included if announced by November 9. Participants can support various historical regions of Romania and enjoy varied routes, from trail to cross-country, with registration open and early-bird prices available.

name: OVB Charity RUN
description: OVB Charity Run is a charity race organized in Cluj-Napoca, dedicated to runners of all levels who want to support a worthy cause through sport. The event offers an enjoyable running experience in a friendly setting, promoting the local running community and social engagement. This is the first edition of the race, inviting participants to enjoy running and contribute to the common good.
course_highlights: 6 km course in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca
Supports the 'Saint Nectarios' Palliative Care Center for seriously ill children
Race options of 2 km (family, non-competitive) and 6 km (competitive)
additional: Participants can register until December 5, 2025; the event takes place in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca, and supports the pediatric cause through donations and sponsorships.

name: XL kmrun - Северен парк
description: XL kmrun - North Park is a race on the 5kmrun calendar, held in North Park, Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances—6 km, 12 km, and 18 km—suitable for different levels of fitness. The event offers the opportunity to run in a natural setting on varied terrain and is part of the XLkmrun series of races held at various locations around Sofia. It is a traditional winter race that attracts runners from the city and the surrounding region.
course_highlights: Three distances: 6 km, 12 km, and 18 km
Terrain with alternating climbs and descents
Held in North Park, Sofia
additional: The distances allow participants to choose according to their abilities and preferred level of exertion. The race is part of the XLkmrun winter calendar and takes place in conditions suitable for winter running.

name: Gučevo winter trail 2026
location: Planinarski dom PK Gučevo, Mount Gučevo, Serbia
description: Gučevo Winter Trail 2026 is a mountain race held on Mount Gučevo, starting near the PK Gučevo Mountain Lodge. The race is challenging, with 700 metres of total elevation gain and 700 metres of descent over a 13 km course. Participants can enjoy the natural scenery and demanding terrain, which tests endurance and running technique. The start is scheduled for 11:00, and the organizers emphasize the importance of following the rules and staying safe during the race.
course_highlights: 13 km course with 700 m of total elevation gain and 700 m of descent
Mountain terrain on Mount Gučevo
Checkpoints at 6 km and at the finish at 13 km
additional: Registration requires confirmation that participants have read and understood the race regulations and risks, as well as permission to use photos and videos from the race. Registration includes consent to participate at one’s own risk and acceptance of the regulations and rules of conduct.

name: Everesting+ Ultra Zărand
description: Ultra Zarand Everesting+ is an extreme mountain running race held in Căsoaia, Arad County, Romania, on 11-12 December 2026. The event offers two challenging distances: 172 km with 9,250 m of elevation gain, rated difficult, and 86 km with 4,600 m of elevation gain, rated intermediate. The race is known for its demanding mountain terrain and Everesting challenge, making it suitable for experienced runners seeking a top-level endurance competition. Participants can track their performance on a personalized results dashboard.
course_highlights: Distances of 86 km and 172 km with 4,600 m and 9,250 m of elevation gain, respectively
Mountain terrain rated intermediate and difficult
Everesting event with extreme endurance challenges
additional: The event has a personalized dashboard for tracking participants’ results. No entry-fee details or start times are provided. The race has a UTMB index for both distances, indicating international recognition of its difficulty. The event also includes a 10 km race to promote local tourism and natural and cultural heritage, offering a unique opportunity for ultramarathon and mountain running enthusiasts.

name: Semimaraton „Pe Argeș în Jos”
description: The “Pe Argeș în Jos” Half Marathon is an annual sporting event held in the heart of Pitești, bringing together runners of all levels. The courses start in Ștrand Park, pass through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks, and continue along the Argeș River promenade, offering a distinctive natural and urban setting for running. The event includes races for all ages and fitness levels, from children’s races to the 21 km half marathon, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The atmosphere is vibrant, with supporters, music, and prizes for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Ștrand Park, near the Summer Theatre
Course through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks
Run along the Argeș River promenade, with picturesque views
additional: Race kit collection is on December 12 at EF Store and on December 14 at the Summer Theatre for participants from outside Pitești. The half marathon, 5 km, and 10 km races start at 10:00 in Ștrand Park. The children’s race starts at 12:30, and the awards ceremony is at 13:00. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal representative when registering and collecting their race kit. The event includes online registration, race kit collection on 12.12.2026, and access to results and photos after the event.

description: Deliblatska Peščara 2026 is a one-day hiking event organized by PSK Pobeda, held in the beautiful surroundings of Deliblatska Peščara near Čardak. Participants can choose between two hiking groups, with routes ranging from 8 to 16 kilometers through rolling landscapes of sand dunes and woodland. The route is easy, with negligible elevation gain, and is suitable for people with light to moderate fitness levels. After the hike, participants can take a break and enjoy an organized lunch with hot soup and refreshments. This event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and spend time together in the spirit of mountaineering.
course_highlights: Routes through rolling landscapes of sand dunes and woodland
Two hiking groups: 15–16 km or 8–10 km
Easy route with negligible elevation gain
additional: Departure is at 7:30 from Nebojšina Street, by the Church of Saint Sava. Recommended gear includes protection from wind, rain, and cold; sturdy hiking boots; layered clothing; a thermos or water bottle (minimum 1 liter); a flashlight; and hiking poles. Advance notice and registration with the guide are required for the organized lunch. Return to Belgrade is planned between 18:30 and 19:00. Participants must bring their hiking membership card, health insurance card, and ID card. The guide assigns bus seats in the order participants register and pay. Hiking through Deliblatska Peščara requires appropriate gear, registration with fee, and participant responsibility.

name: Πεντελικόν Μάραθων
description: The Pentelikon Marathon is a 12-kilometer mountain race, organized for the fourth consecutive year by the Telmissos Nea Makri Marathon Runners’ Association in collaboration with the Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association. The route follows forest trails, starting at Agia Marina in Nea Makri. The race aims to provide financial support to the Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association for forest protection and volunteer service to the community. Despite recent fire damage, Mount Pentelikon retains its remarkable beauty and historical significance, and the race contributes to efforts to restore the mountains.
course_highlights: A 12 km mountain route on forest trails
Start at Agia Marina in Nea Makri
An area of great historical significance and natural beauty
additional: The race is organized with the support of the Municipality of Marathon and under the auspices of EOSLMA-Y. The start is at 10:00 a.m. The event aims to provide financial support to the Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association for forest protection and volunteer service. The route passes by S.E.D.M. (Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association) and follows a trail through a forest that suffered a fire in August 2024. The event includes competitive and volunteer participation, with an emphasis on enjoying nature and promoting mountain running.

name: 7. Winter Trail Race na Fruškoj gori
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a traditional sports, competitive, and recreational event held on Fruška Gora. The race features a variety of courses, from ultra-extreme to beginner, with challenging climbs and beautiful natural surroundings. Participants can enjoy the challenges and beauty of the mountain terrain while competing in a unique atmosphere. The event brings together runners of all levels and promotes a healthy lifestyle and a love of nature.
course_highlights: Varied courses with 1 to 5 ITRA points
Mountain terrain with significant climbs and descents
Beautiful landscapes and natural surroundings of Fruška Gora
additional: Races are scored under the ITRA system, with different difficulty categories (1 to 5 ITRA points). The event includes ultra-extreme, ultra, medium, short, and beginner marathons. The beginner Southern Marathon is 22 km long, with 898 m of ascent and descent. Group and fun registration options are also available for the shorter courses. The event takes place in April, and the 7th Winter Trail Race on Fruška Gora is held in December. Participation includes courses of various lengths, and the event is part of a series of races on Fruška Gora, focused on trail and mountain sports. Registration details are not available.

name: 27ος Αγώνας Αλσους Δαφνίου
description: The 27th Daphni Grove Race is a traditional 10-kilometer road race held in Daphni Grove. The course starts on Athens Avenue and passes beside the ancient sanctuary of Daphni Apollo and Aphaia Aphrodite, offering a route away from the city noise with beautiful views of the Thriasian Gulf. The race is dedicated to the memory of Babis Georgats zonas and is a celebration for runners, with traditional hospitality and electronic timing. Participants are asked to arrive early to collect their race numbers, and there is a place to store their belongings.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometer course in Daphni Grove
Passes beside the ancient sanctuary of Daphni Apollo and Aphaia Aphrodite
Views of the Thriasian Gulf, away from the city noise
additional: The start is on Athens Avenue, near Daphni Hospital. Athletes must arrive at least one hour before the start to collect their race numbers from the registration desk. Electronic timing and baggage storage are available. It is recommended that participants leave their cars at the end of Iera Odos, near Daphni Monastery, to avoid congestion. Electronic timing and baggage storage are provided. Race-number pickup takes place before the start; arriving at least one hour early is recommended.

name: ORADEA CITY TRAIL RUN
location: Parcul Ion C. Brătianu, Oradea, Romania
organizer: Asociaţia Clubul Sportiv Xterra Sport Bihor
description: Oradea City Trail is a running competition held in Ion C. Brătianu Park in Oradea, offering three routes: half marathon, cross, and mini. The event is for runners of all ages, with clearly defined age categories, and emphasizes sportsmanship and the outdoor experience. Participants receive personalized race kits and finisher medals, while the top finishers are awarded prizes by category. The race starts in the morning, and the routes are clearly marked, with refreshment points along the way.
course_highlights: 21 km half-marathon route with a time limit of 3.5 hours
10.5 km cross route with a time limit of 2 hours
Start and finish in Ion C. Brătianu Park, Oradea
additional: Race confirmation and race-pack pickup take place on race day between 07:00 and 09:30 in IC Brătianu Park. The technical briefing is at 09:30, before the start. The half-marathon route has three refreshment points, while the cross/mini route has one. Participants must wear their race number visibly on their clothing. Trail-running shoes are recommended. Minors must have parental consent.

name: 7ος Βυζαντινός Αγώνας
organizer: Δήμος Μεγαρέων και Αντιδημαρχία Αθλητισμού & Νέας Γενιάς, σε συνεργασία με τους Αθηναίους Δρομείς, τον Απόλλωνα Δυτικής Αττικής και τους Δρομείς Μεγάρων «Ο Όρσιππος»
description: The 7th Byzantine 50-Kilometer Road Race is an ultradistance race held in Megara, starting and finishing at Vasilissa Frederikis Square. The course is entirely paved and passes through pistachio groves, olive groves, vineyards, wooded sections, and the Alepochori–Dourakou beach, offering a unique experience of the area’s natural surroundings. The race has a charitable purpose and is intended for runners with marathon experience. The event honors the memory of Georgios Panos and promotes running and ultradistance racing.
course_highlights: A 49,600-meter course that is entirely paved
Passes through pistachio groves, olive groves, vineyards, and forests
Approximately 5 kilometers along Alepochori–Dourakou beach
additional: Race-day registration opens at 07:00 and closes at 08:30. The race has a time limit of 7 hours and 30 minutes. Refreshment stations are located every 5 km, and medical support is provided. Timing is done using an electronic RFID chip. Participants may donate non-perishable food for charity before the start. The announcement for the 7th event specifies refreshment stations every 5 km, medical support, electronic timing with an RFID chip, and a time limit of 7 hours and 30 minutes. The published details are for the event on January 18, 2026.

name: 14ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αιγιαλείας
location: Aigio Seafront near the Old Port, Aigio, Aigialeia, Greece
description: The 14th Aigialeia Half Marathon is organized by the Aigio Sports Club “Athinodoros the Aegian,” with the support of the Municipality of Aigialeia’s Deputy Mayor’s Office for Culture and Sports. The race takes place on Aigio beach, near the old port, on a nearly entirely paved and flat course with minimal elevation change. The course starts on the beach and heads toward the community of Nikolaeika, continuing through local communities and seaside villages along the old railway line as far as Stafidala, before finishing back on Aigio beach.
course_highlights: Nearly entirely paved course
Flat course with minimal elevation change
Passes through local communities and seaside villages along an old railway line
additional: Parallel 5 km and 1.5 km races follow similarly flat, paved routes. The finish is on Aigio beach, near the 12 Fountains and the historic plane tree of Pausanias. The available information concerns the 2026 event and also mentions 5 km and 1,500 m races. Details of the 2027 event have not yet been confirmed.

name: 15ος Ημιμαραθώνιος «Ιωάννης Καποδίστριας»
distance_verbose: Ημιμαραθώνιος, 10 km, 3000 μέτρα, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.2 km
price_range: 10-15 € για τις κύριες αποστάσεις· παιδικοί αγώνες δωρεάν
description: The 15th “Ioannis Kapodistrias” Half Marathon in Aegina is a historic road race honoring the first governor of modern Greece. The event features races of 21.1 kilometers, 10,000 meters, 3,000 meters for walkers, and children’s races, offering a celebration for runners of all ages and abilities. The event takes place in central Aegina and combines sport with cultural heritage, attracting a large number of participants each year. The longer-distance races start in the morning, while the shorter races start earlier, creating a wonderful sporting atmosphere for the whole family.
course_highlights: 21.1-kilometer half marathon in central Aegina
Children’s races of 200m, 500m, and 1,000m for all ages
3,000m route for walkers and a 10,000m road race
additional: Awards ceremonies take place at 11:00 for the children’s races and at 13:45 for the other races. Age categories are offered for the half marathon and the 10,000-meter race: 18–39, 40–59, and 60+ years. Participants in the longer races must be at least 18 for the half marathon and 16 for the 10,000-meter race. Middle and high school students may also participate in the 3,000m race, under their parents’ responsibility. All participants receive finisher medals, and the top three in each category receive trophies. For the 2026 event, water stations every 2,500 m and isotonic drinks along the half marathon route are listed. Prices and benefits for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: The Salomon Mountain Cup is a popular series of winter trail races in the mountains of Attica, offering runners of all levels the chance to enjoy mountain running and nature. The event includes three races in Penteli, Hymettus and Parnitha, with two courses at each race: a longer, more technical course and a shorter one for beginners. The series has become an established fixture in the running community and offers incentives through awards, prize draws and individual and team rankings. MyRace is responsible for organizing the event, with support from Salomon, which invites runners of all ages to take part in this celebration of mountain running.
course_highlights: Three races in the mountains of Attica: Penteli, Hymettus and Parnitha
Two courses at each race: a long course (10–12 km) and a short course (4–7 km), both with significant elevation gain
Natural scenery and technical trails, with elevation gains ranging from +170 m to +660 m
additional: At each race, the top three men and women in each distance receive awards. Age categories are available only for the long distance. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. Four pairs of Salomon shoes are drawn at each race. There are individual and team rankings for the long distance. Teams consist of 3 people, and the top three teams receive awards. In a recent edition, the race in Penteli started from Semelis Square. The event provided a race number with a timing chip, water stations, snacks at the finish, a commemorative certificate and medical coverage.

name: Витоша Ски и Дъски
location: Aleko Hut, Vitosha Nature Park, Sofia, Bulgaria
description: Vitosha Ski and Board is an event organized by the Sofia Mountain Club Association, held in Vitosha Nature Park, around Aleko Hut. The competition offers two main routes—the short “Zaeka” and the long “Cherni Vrah”—which start at 09:17. This winter sports event attracts ski and snowboard enthusiasts, offering challenging courses in a mountain setting. Participants can enjoy Vitosha’s beautiful scenery and mountain air.
course_highlights: “Zaeka” course – short course
“Cherni Vrah” course – long course
Held in Vitosha Nature Park, around Aleko Hut

name: 2ο Tsiggla Trail Run

description: The TSIGGLA Trail Run takes place in Tsigla Forest near Didymoteicho, offering a unique running experience in a natural setting on the borders of Europe. The event includes an 8-kilometre training route through the forest, suitable for runners of all levels. It coincides with the annual vasilopita-cutting gathering of Thrace’s runners, creating a friendly, sociable atmosphere. The race is an alternative sporting get-together with a strong local character and tradition.
course_highlights: 8 km training route in Tsigla Forest
Natural setting near the Greece–Turkey border
Recreation area and forest trail
additional: The event includes the annual vasilopita-cutting gathering of Thrace’s runners and is an excursion-style meeting for athletes. The route is intended for training and takes place in the recreation area of Tsigla Forest. The race is held in early February and also includes related events and activities in the Didymoteicho area.

name: 49ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Υγείας Αθήνας 21 χλμ.
location: Ολυμπιακό Κωπηλατοδρόμιο Σχοινιά, Μαραθώνας, Αττική, Greece
description: The 49th Athens Health Run 21 km is organized by the Athens Health Runners Association and takes place at the Schinias Olympic Rowing and Canoeing Centre. Since 1978, the race has promoted popular mass participation in sport and running, welcoming runners of all ages and fitness levels. The course is paved, completely flat, and loops around the rowing course, offering an enjoyable and fast experience. The event also includes 10 km and 5 km races, with technical support provided by MyRace.
course_highlights: Paved and completely flat course
Four laps around the water course at the Schinias Olympic Rowing and Canoeing Centre
Water stations along the course and at the finish
additional: Participants receive a race bib with a timing chip and safety pins. Medical support is available, along with the option to print a commemorative certificate showing the participant’s name and result. Race packs can be collected on race day from 07:30 to 09:00. The race has a 3-hour time limit. The top three men and women overall and the winners of the age categories receive awards. Supporters provide energy gels, natural mineral water, and bananas at the finish. 21.1 km course, 600-participant limit, online registration, race pack with chip and medal, water stations, live results, medical support

name: Национален крос "По стъпките на Васил Левски" 2026
location: Garden next to National School of Applied Arts “Prof. Venko Kolev”, Troyan, Bulgaria
description: The National Cross-Country Race “In the Footsteps of Vasil Levski” is an annual event honoring the memory of the Apostle, with participants covering part of the route he once traveled. The race takes place in Troyan, starting near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts. Several distances of varying difficulty and elevation are offered for different age and gender groups. The event combines sporting spirit with historical remembrance and is open to anyone wishing to honor Vasil Levski’s legacy.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 8 km, and 12 km, with elevation gains ranging from 10 m to 375 m
The course follows paths traveled by Vasil Levski
The start is near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan
additional: Registration is open until 09.02.2026. Members of the Bulgarian Orienteering Federation submit entries at https://orienteering.bg, while those who are not registered can submit entries by email or phone. Bib numbers can be collected from the secretariat by 11:00, and on-site registration is possible until 10:30 if bib numbers are available. The youngest participants (3 km) are transported by minibus to the starting point and run along red markings. The Masters start (12 km) is at 11:20, following yellow markings. For the 2026 edition, the start is listed at 11:00 from the garden near the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan; advance entries are accepted, and on-site registration is possible if bib numbers are available. The date listed in the 2026 sources is 14 February, not 20 February 2027.

name: SKV Vertical Race

name: 7ο Atlas Trail Running
description: Experience mountain running at the Atlas Trail Running race in the Malakasa area of Attica. The race offers four routes: 34Km, 24Km, 11Km and 6Km, featuring a variety of technical sections, forest roads and trails through scenic, lush green landscapes. During the race, you will pass two chapels: Prophet Elias and Saint Mercurius. Some mountain-race experience is required, and suitable shoes and a hydration vessel are mandatory.
course_highlights: 60% forest roads and 40% trails
The scenic, lush green landscape of Malakasa
Two chapels along the route (Prophet Elias, Saint Mercurius)
additional: All participants receive timing by 'AGON Race Timing' and a unique medal. Carefully planned refreshment stations ensure sufficient calories and electrolytes. Sponsors RUN N TRAIL - BETTER PEOPLE provide a 500ml water flask. The largest team is awarded. The announcement for the previous event recommends experience in mountain races and requires suitable mountain shoes and a hydration vessel. It included timing, a medal and a 500 ml flask.

name: 5ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αγάπης
description: Ο 5ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αγάπης στη Μυτιλήνη θα πραγματοποιηθεί το Σαββατοκύριακο 14 και 15 Φεβρουαρίου 2026, προσφέροντας ένα πλούσιο πρόγραμμα αθλητικών και πολιτιστικών εκδηλώσεων. Το Σάββατο οι αγώνες ξεκινούν στην περιοχή Τσαμάκια με αποστάσεις 1000μ., 2500μ., Family Running 2500μ. και 5000μ. για διάφορες ηλικιακές κατηγορίες. Την Κυριακή οι αθλητές συγκεντρώνονται στο κέντρο της πόλης για τους αγώνες των 10 χιλιομέτρων και του ημιμαραθωνίου 21 χιλιομέτρων. Ο θεσμός αυτός έχει καθιερωθεί ως σημαντικό γεγονός για την πόλη της Μυτιλήνης.

name: 10ο MaskaRun
description: Η αθλητική πανδαισία στον Ορχομενό Βοιωτίας την Κυριακή 15 Φεβρουαρίου 2026 συνδυάζει το 10ο επετειακό MaskaRun με τον 1ο Αγώνα Δρόμου 5 χλμ. «Ασώπιχος» και τις εκδηλώσεις για την Πανελλήνια Ημέρα του Φιλάθλου. Η διοργάνωση αποτελεί μια μεγάλη γιορτή αθλητισμού, μνήμης και ανθρωπιάς, με ελεύθερη συμμετοχή για όλους. Η Κεντρική Πλατεία Ορχομενού θα είναι το επίκεντρο των εκδηλώσεων, που περιλαμβάνουν επίσης επίδειξη χειροσφαίρισης (Handball) και κληρώσεις με δώρα για τα παιδιά. Το MaskaRun έχει καθιερωθεί ως θεσμός με μαζική συμμετοχή και φέτος προστίθεται μια πιστοποιημένη αγωνιστική διαδρομή 5 χλμ. «Ασώπιχος» με επίσημη χρονομέτρηση.

name: 11ο Lycabettus Run
description: Ο 11ος Lycabettus Run είναι ένας ξεχωριστός αγώνας δρόμου που διεξάγεται στον καταπράσινο λόφο του Λυκαβηττού στην Αθήνα. Οι διαδρομές περιλαμβάνουν ασφάλτινους και χωμάτινους δρόμους, προσφέροντας μια μοναδική εμπειρία τρεξίματος μέσα στη φύση και με θέα την πόλη. Ο αγώνας περιλαμβάνει ατομικές και ομαδικές κατηγορίες, με εκκινήσεις το πρωί και πλήρη υποστήριξη για τους δρομείς. Η διοργάνωση προσφέρει μετάλλια, κύπελλα, ψηφιακά διπλώματα, ιατρική κάλυψη και σταθμούς ανεφοδιασμού.

name: Προπονητική Ημερίδα Νίκης Βύρωνα
description: Η Προπονητική Ημερίδα Νίκης Βύρωνα διοργανώνεται από τον Γυμναστικό Σύλλογο Νίκη Βύρωνα, με έδρα το Δημοτικό Στάδιο Βύρωνα. Ο σύλλογος, που ιδρύθηκε το 2005, προσφέρει εξειδικευμένη καθοδήγηση από προπονητές με εμπειρία και υψηλές αθλητικές επιδόσεις. Η ημερίδα στοχεύει στην προώθηση του κλασικού αθλητισμού και τη βελτίωση της ποιότητας ζωής μέσω της γυμναστικής. Η διοργάνωση αποτελεί μια ευκαιρία για αθλητές και φίλους του αθλητισμού να γνωρίσουν τη χαρά του στίβου σε ένα φιλικό και οργανωμένο περιβάλλον.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: Η σειρά αγώνων Salomon Mountain Cup 2026 είναι μια αγαπημένη χειμωνιάτικη σειρά trail αγώνων στα βουνά της Αττικής, που προσφέρει νέες αγωνιστικές εμπειρίες σε δρομείς όλων των επιπέδων. Περιλαμβάνει τρεις αγώνες σε Πεντέλη, Υμηττό και Πάρνηθα, με δύο διαδρομές ανά αγώνα: μια μεγαλύτερη, τεχνική και απαιτητική, και μια μικρότερη για αρχάριους ή προπόνηση. Η διοργάνωση στοχεύει να φέρει τους δρομείς σε επαφή με τη φύση και να αναδείξει την ομορφιά του ορεινού τρεξίματος στην Αττική. Η MyRace είναι υπεύθυνη για τη διοργάνωση, με την υποστήριξη της Salomon ως ονομαστικού χορηγού.

description: The 5th Friendship and Solidarity Memorial Run is a special sporting event held in the former forest of Varympompi. The race offers two routes, 14.5 km and 6.3 km, on forest trails and paved roads, both fully marked. Participation is free with registration and a €10 deposit, which is refunded on race day. The money collected from runners who do not show up will be donated to an orphanage. There is no electronic timing or awards, as all participants are considered winners and receive a mug as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Two routes, 14.5 km and 6.3 km, on forest trails and paved roads
Full course marking and water stations along the route
Held in the natural setting of the former Varympompi forest (Tatoi Estate)
additional: There is no electronic timing or awards. Every participant receives a mug, possibly featuring a personal photo. Participation is free with registration and a €10 deposit, refunded on race day. The money from runners who do not show up will be donated to an orphanage. Water stations are available along the route. Routes of 14.5 km and 6.3 km on forest trails and paved roads; no electronic timing; participation with a €10 deposit; a mug with a personal photo as a prize; charitable support for the orphanage.

name: 10ος Δρόμος Αξιών
location: Ιερός Ναός Ζωοδόχου Πηγής, Κεφαλάρι Αργολίδας, Αργολίδα, Greece
description: The 10th Road of Values, organized by the 1st Argos Scout Group, is a running race dedicated to the universal values of life. The race is held on February 22, on the occasion of Scout Thinking Day, and honors the memory of the great Greek marathon runner Stelios Kyriakides. The start and finish are at Kefalari, Argos, at the Church of Zoodochos Pigi, offering a special experience for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 10 km road race starting and finishing at Kefalari, Argos
650-meter children's race at the same location
Special tribute to Stelios Kyriakides and universal values
additional: The event includes two simultaneous starts at 10:30 a.m. for the main 10 km race and the 650-meter children's race. The event has a long tradition and is associated with Scout Thinking Day. The race is dedicated to universal values and takes place in a natural setting, starting and finishing at the Church of Zoodochos Pigi. Participation is free and includes a 650-meter children's race.

name: Γεντίκι Trail 9
description: Ο Γεντίκι Trail είναι ένας ορεινός αγώνας που διεξάγεται στην περιοχή του Γεντίκι στη Λάρισα. Η διαδρομή των 21 χιλιομέτρων ακολουθεί σηματοδοτημένα μονοπάτια με θετική υψομετρική διαφορά +1370 μέτρα, προσφέροντας μια απαιτητική και συναρπαστική εμπειρία για τους δρομείς βουνού. Υπάρχει επίσης μια μικρότερη διαδρομή 5,1 χιλιομέτρων με θετική υψομετρική +250 μέτρα, ιδανική για όσους επιθυμούν μια πιο σύντομη πρόκληση. Ο αγώνας αποτελεί κριτήριο για τη συμμετοχή στον Olympus Marathon, προσελκύοντας δρομείς που αναζητούν υψηλό επίπεδο ανταγωνισμού και φυσικής ομορφιάς.

name: 5ο Koumaria Trail Series
description: The 5th Koumaria Trail Series is organized by the Achaia Marathon Runners’ Association “Pheidippides” and offers a challenging off-road course through the mountainous natural surroundings of Petrotó, Achaia. The event includes 40 km, 22 km, 12 km, and 5 km routes, with many runners and volunteers, offering a unique mountain-running experience. The race is marked by strong competition, as well as support and assistance for runners at aid stations. The event honors tradition and the beauty of nature while promoting sport and well-being.
course_highlights: Challenging off-road mountain terrain
40 km, 22 km, 12 km, and 5 km routes
Aid stations in the mountain village of Petrotó
additional: The Achaia Marathon Runners’ Association “Pheidippides” operates aid stations and assists approximately 600 mountain runners with the help of volunteers. The race is a major organizational success and also honors athletes with personal records. Technical off-road terrain, participation and volunteer involvement, major organizational success, and support activities.

name: ДЛШ КОЛОКРОС, КУПА ДОЛЧИНИ
description: Bulgarian Cyclocross Championship, Dolcini Cup is a cyclocross race held in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. The event is part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship and offers participation opportunities for various rider categories. The race starts at 09:30, and detailed information and regulations are available on the federation’s official website. Registration is online via a special link provided by the organizers.
course_highlights: Race in Borisova Gradina, Sofia
Part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship
Various participant categories

name: 2ο Τρέχω Στον Μαραθώνα
description: The “MARATHON - I Run in Marathon” road race is a flat 6.8-kilometer race held in Nea Makri, by the sea, along the Nea Makri–Marathon Beach coastal promenade. It is aimed at experienced runners and athletes over the age of 15, offering an enjoyable route without difficulties. The start and finish are at the central small harbor of Nea Makri, with the race starting at 16:30. The event provides hydration and snack stations along the route and at the finish, ensuring a complete experience for participants.
course_highlights: Flat 6.8 km route by the sea
Nea Makri–Marathon Beach coastal promenade
Start and finish at the central small harbor of Nea Makri
additional: The entry package includes hydration and snacks along the route and at the finish. Stations provide bottled water, soft drinks, juices, bananas, sweet snacks, and savory snacks. Participation is open to people over the age of 15, with parental consent required for minors under 18. Runners participate at their own risk and must have recent medical examinations. Routes of approximately 8.2 km, participation open to all ages, online registration, finish at the port of Nea Makri, with water and snacks provided during and after the race.

name: 18ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Καθαράς Δευτέρας
location: Byzantine Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Saviour, Alepochori, Attica, Greece
description: The 18th Clean Monday Road Race is a traditional 10,000-meter race held in Alepochori, Attica, starting and finishing at the Byzantine Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Savior. The course is uneven, dirt, and marked, offering a beautiful experience for runners of all levels. There is also a 300-meter children’s race and a carnival costume and dance contest. After the race, a celebration follows with music, wine, and traditional Lenten dishes, creating a festive atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Uneven dirt course
Start and finish at the Byzantine Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Savior
Marked course and water provided
additional: The 10,000-meter race is limited to 250 athletes. Registration is by telephone only. A bus is available for €10, departing from Metaxourgeio (Karaiskaki Square) at 8:00. After the race, participants receive a handmade commemorative medal; trophies and prizes are awarded for the children’s race and costume contest. The post-race celebration features a DJ, dancing, wine, and a picnic with traditional Lenten dishes. For the 18th edition, the limit is stated as 250 participants in the 10 km race, with telephone registration. A bus from Athens is available for a €10 fare. The announced date for the 18th edition is February 23, 2026, different from the date of March 1, 2027, provided in the metadata.

price_range: 15-25 € για τους αγώνες 10 και 26 χλμ.· δωρεάν charity fun run

description: The 2nd Spetses Mountain Run “Sotirios Anargyros” is a mountain race held on Spetses, aiming to promote sport and fair play and showcase the trails of the pine-covered mountain overlooking the sea. The event includes 26 km and 10 km courses, as well as a children’s walk, offering a unique experience for athletes and visitors. The event is supported by the Municipality of Spetses and the AKSS Foundation, with an emphasis on environmental awareness and promoting local products.
course_highlights: Trails on a pine-covered mountain overlooking the sea
26 km and 10 km courses in a natural setting
Children’s walk on the grounds of the AKSS Foundation
additional: Race registration opens at 10:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. on the previous day at the TITANIA cinema, where the technical briefing and athletes’ meal also take place. On race day, registration is open from 08:30 to 09:45 a.m. After the race, awards are presented at 3:00 p.m., followed by a farewell celebration with local delicacies. The available information concerns the 2026 edition and does not yet confirm the date of March 20, 2027.

name: 2ο Ελάτεια Historic Trail
organizer: Ορειβατικός, Φυσιολατρικός Σύλλογος Ελάτειας και ο Σύλλογος Νεολαίας Ελάτειας
description: The 2nd Historic Trail Elateia is a mountain race offering three routes of varying distances and difficulty, set in a beautiful natural and historic environment. The route starts from Elateia’s central square and follows trails and forest roads, passing archaeological sites and offering unique views of the Maliakos Gulf and the surrounding mountains. The race is also suitable for runners with limited experience in mountain running, with full course marking and aid stations. The event is renowned for its excellent organization, support from volunteers, and participation by the local community.
course_highlights: Start from Elateia’s central square at an elevation of 180 m
Pass by archaeological sites and the chapel of Saint Athanasios
Views of the Maliakos Gulf and the mountains of Kallidromos, Parnassos, Giona, Oiti, and Vardousia
additional: The race starts from Elateia’s central square. There are three routes: 21.2 km, 12.6 km, and 6.2 km. Electronic timing is provided by CHRONOLOG. There are three aid stations. All finishers receive a medal. Payments are accepted by card only. Refunds are available up to 10 days before the race, subject to a small fee. The cutoff time for the middle-distance route is 2 hours and 30 minutes.

name: 14ος Χορτιάτης Trail Run
description: Ο 14ος Χορτιάτης Trail Run διοργανώνεται από τον Σύλλογο Δρομέων Υγείας Θεσσαλονίκης και πραγματοποιείται στο όρος Χορτιάτης της Θεσσαλονίκης. Ο αγώνας έχει ως στόχο τη γνωριμία των δρομέων με το ορεινό περιβάλλον του Χορτιάτη, την εξοικείωση με τις προκλήσεις του ορεινού τρεξίματος και την προστασία του φυσικού περιβάλλοντος. Η διοργάνωση υποστηρίζεται από τον Δήμο Πυλαίας - Χορτιάτη και προωθεί την άσκηση, την αθλητική παιδεία και την κοινωνική υπευθυνότητα. Πρόκειται για έναν ορεινό αγώνα που συνδυάζει φυσική ομορφιά και αθλητική πρόκληση, ιδανικό για δρομείς που αγαπούν το βουνό και τη φύση.

name: Ολοι Μαζί Μπορούμε
description: Οι αγώνες δρόμου Ολοι Μαζί Μπορούμε πραγματοποιούνται για τρίτη συνεχόμενη χρονιά στην Πάρνηθα, Αττική, με στόχο την αναδάσωση και την προστασία του περιβάλλοντος. Οι συμμετέχοντες μπορούν να επιλέξουν ανάμεσα σε τρεις διαδρομές, ώστε να συμμετέχουν όλοι ανεξαρτήτως ηλικίας και φυσικής κατάστασης. Η συμμετοχή για τους ενήλικες κοστίζει 10 ευρώ, ενώ για τα παιδιά έως 12 ετών είναι δωρεάν. Όλοι οι δρομείς λαμβάνουν ατομική χρονομέτρηση και αναμνηστικό t-shirt. Η διοργάνωση ενώνει τις δυνάμεις των συμμετεχόντων για τη δημιουργία ενός βιώσιμου περιβάλλοντος.

name: Πανελλήνιοι Αγώνες Βετεράνων Στίβου
description: Οι Πανελλήνιοι Αγώνες Βετεράνων Στίβου διοργανώνονται υπό την αιγίδα της Ομοσπονδίας Ελλήνων Βετεράνων Αθλητών Στίβου (ΟΕΒΑΣ) και πραγματοποιούνται στο Αλσύλλιο Σπιάντζας στην Ηλεία. Πρόκειται για αγώνες ανωμάλου δρόμου και 10 χλμ. βάδην, που απευθύνονται σε βετεράνους και ανεξάρτητους αθλητές. Η διοργάνωση έχει την υποστήριξη της Περιφέρειας Δυτικής Ελλάδας και του Δήμου Πύργου, προσφέροντας μια αθλητική εμπειρία υψηλού επιπέδου σε ένα όμορφο φυσικό περιβάλλον. Οι αγώνες ξεκινούν το πρωί με την πρώτη εκκίνηση στις 08:30.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: Το Salomon Mountain Cup είναι μια αγαπημένη σειρά χειμωνιάτικων trail αγώνων στα βουνά της Αττικής, που προσφέρει σε κάθε δρομέα την ευκαιρία να απολαύσει το ορεινό τρέξιμο και τις φυσικές ομορφιές της περιοχής. Η διοργάνωση περιλαμβάνει τρεις αγώνες σε Πεντέλη, Υμηττό και Πάρνηθα, με δύο διαδρομές σε κάθε αγώνα: μια μεγαλύτερη, τεχνική και απαιτητική, και μια μικρότερη για αρχάριους ή προπόνηση. Η σειρά έχει καθιερωθεί ως θεσμός στη δρομική κοινότητα και δίνει κίνητρα με βραβεύσεις, κληρώσεις και βαθμολογίες για ατομικές και ομαδικές επιδόσεις. Η διοργάνωση γίνεται από την MyRace και υποστηρίζεται από τη Salomon, προσκαλώντας δρομείς κάθε ηλικίας να συμμετάσχουν σε αυτή τη γιορτή του ορεινού τρεξίματος.

name: 14ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αθήνας

price_tiers.distance: Special Olympics Hellas και ΑμεΑ Cosmote Telekom

description: The 14th Athens Half Marathon is one of Greece’s most popular road races, held in the historic center of Athens. The 21-kilometer course offers a unique experience through the city, with support stations and comprehensive organization. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over and is a celebration of sport and participation. Also held are 5-kilometer races, a Family Run, and special categories for people with disabilities. The event prioritizes participants’ safety and comfort, providing support along the entire course and an expo area before the race.
course_highlights: A 21-kilometer course in the historic center of Athens
Support stations with water, energy gels, isotonic drinks, and sponges
Start at 08:00, with the finish open until 11:30
additional: Race materials can be collected from the Runners’ Service Center & ERGO Half Marathon Expo at the Palaio Faliro Indoor Stadium – Taekwondo Venue. Full hydration and energy support is available along the course. Participants compete at their own risk, and no medical certificates are required. A cancellation policy allows refunds until February 8, 2026. Also held are 5-kilometer races, a Family Run, and special categories for people with disabilities. The event includes the Family Run, the Special Olympics Hellas race, and activities such as the ERGO HALF MARATHON EXPO, with major courses and activities for everyone.

name: Στα Βήματα του Ζορμπά
description: The “In the Footsteps of Zorba” race is held in Kolindros, Pieria, and features 13 km and 4 km courses, as well as a 500-metre children’s race. The event highlights the area’s historical and cultural heritage, offering participants a unique experience amid beautiful natural surroundings, with panoramic views of the Thermaic Gulf and the Pierian Mountains. The race is open to athletes aged 12 and over, with special requirements for minors. It is organized by the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros and SMF SPORTS, which is responsible for organizing and supporting the event.
course_highlights: 13 km and 4 km courses in Kolindros, Pieria
Panoramic views of the Thermaic Gulf and the Pierian Mountains
500-metre children’s race for younger athletes
additional: Athletes aged 15 and over may enter the 13 km race, while athletes aged 12 and over may enter the 4 km race when accompanied by an adult. The event also includes a 500-metre children’s race. SMF SPORTS provides event organization, electronic timing, and sportswear sales services. Technical courses, online registration, medical support, commemorative medals and participant gifts, cultural events, and local traditions.

name: Avala trail race
description: Avala Trail Race is a mountain race held on Avala near Belgrade. Organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club, the event brings together runners who enjoy nature and the challenges of mountain terrain. The race is known for its demanding yet beautiful route through wooded areas, offering an opportunity for both a sporting challenge and camaraderie. The fifth edition of the race is scheduled for March 13, 2027.
course_highlights: Mountain trail on Avala
Wooded areas and natural surroundings
Challenging terrain with climbs
additional: The fifteenth edition of the race is organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club from Belgrade. Around 70 participants have registered for 2027 so far. Photographer Nemanja Jovanović is covering the event. Participants can expect medals, T-shirts, and professional timing. The race is part of an annual tradition of events on Avala.

name: DRC x URC Run
description: DRC X URC Run is a friendly running event in central Athens, offering a chance to enjoy a light run and socialize with other runners. The route offers 5 km and 8 km options, with different paces to suit each participant. The run starts at the Karaiskakis Statue in the Zappeion, creating a lovely atmosphere for a running morning. Participation is free and limited to 200 places, so runners are encouraged to sign up quickly.
course_highlights: 5 km and 8 km routes in central Athens
Starting point: the Karaiskakis Statue in the Zappeion
A chance to enjoy a light run at different paces (5 km at 6:30 pace, 8 km at 6:00 pace)
additional: Participation is free and limited to 200 places. Participants can choose the pace that suits them and run with other runners in central Athens. The event also includes an open light run and activities in central Athens, and is part of a series of running events organized by DRC and URC.

name: 10ο Women’s Run
description: Ο 10ος Women's Run είναι ένας μη ανταγωνιστικός αγώνας δρόμου 5 χιλιομέτρων που διοργανώνεται από τον Σύλλογο Αθλητών Υγείας Χίου σε συνεργασία με τον Δήμο Χίου, με σκοπό να τιμήσει τη γυναίκα. Η διαδρομή είναι επίπεδη και διασχίζει το κέντρο της πόλης της Χίου, με εκκίνηση και τερματισμό στην Κεντρική Πλατεία (Δημαρχείο Χίου). Ο αγώνας προσφέρει μια ευχάριστη εμπειρία για όλες τις συμμετέχουσες, με παροχές όπως μπλουζάκι, μετάλλιο και αναμνηστικό δίπλωμα. Η εκκίνηση γίνεται στις 11:30 π.μ. και η συμμετοχή είναι ανοιχτή σε γυναίκες άνω των 18 ετών, με δυνατότητα συμμετοχής ανηλίκων με γονική συναίνεση.

17ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Καλαμπάκα – Τρίκαλα
description: Ο 17ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Καλαμπάκα - Τρίκαλα «Θανάσης Σταμόπουλος» είναι ένας από τους πιο γρήγορους ημιμαραθώνιους δρόμους στην Ελλάδα και την Ευρώπη, με μια ελαφρώς κατηφορική διαδρομή που ξεκινά από την ιστορική Καλαμπάκα και καταλήγει στην καρδιά των Τρικάλων. Η διοργάνωση τιμά τη μνήμη του Θανάση Σταμόπουλου, ιδρυτικού μέλους του Συλλόγου Δρομέων Τρικάλων, και προσελκύει χιλιάδες δρομείς από όλη την Ελλάδα και το εξωτερικό. Παράλληλα με τον κλασικό ημιμαραθώνιο, προσφέρονται αγώνες 5K, 5K ΑΜΕΑ και παιδικός αγώνας 1K, καθιστώντας το γεγονός μια γιορτή για όλες τις ηλικίες και επίπεδα. Η διαδρομή προσφέρει όμορφα τοπία, ιστορικά και σύγχρονα στοιχεία, ενώ η ατμόσφαιρα είναι γεμάτη ενθουσιασμό και υποστήριξη από τους θεατές.

name: Piraeus Port Run
description: Ο Piraeus Port Run είναι ένας εμβληματικός αγώνας δρόμου που διεξάγεται στον Πειραιά, στη μνήμη του Πειραιώτη δρομέα Χρήστου Βαρτζάκη. Ο αγώνας προσφέρει διαδρομές 10 χλμ, 5 χλμ και 1 χλμ για παιδιά, με έμφαση στην ασφαλή και ποιοτική δρομική εμπειρία, αναδεικνύοντας το παραλιακό μέτωπο της πόλης. Αποτελεί θεσμό για τα αθλητικά δρώμενα του Πειραιά και διοργανώνεται υπό την αιγίδα του Δήμου Πειραιά και του Συλλόγου Δρομέων Υγείας Πειραιά. Η διοργάνωση δίνει ιδιαίτερη σημασία στην υποστήριξη των δρομέων και στην παροχή ιατρικής φροντίδας κατά τη διάρκεια του αγώνα.

name: 1ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Ηγουμενίτσας
description: The 1st Igoumenitsa Road Race (Igoumenitsa City Run) is organized by the Igoumenitsa Runners’ Association in collaboration with the sports company Epirus Athletic Events and the Municipality of Igoumenitsa. The event features 10,000m and 5,000m races, as well as a 1,000m children’s race for primary school students. The start and finish are at the Pantheon Municipal Cultural Center, offering a unique experience on a beautiful urban route. The race is dedicated to the memory of young Maximos Lamprousis, honoring his memory and smile.
course_highlights: 10,000m and 5,000m routes through the city of Igoumenitsa
A 1,000m children’s race for primary school students
Start and finish at the Pantheon Municipal Cultural Center
additional: The children’s race starts at 10:35 a.m. The race is dedicated to the memory of Maximos Lamprousis. The start and finish are at the Pantheon Municipal Cultural Center. Organized in the coastal zone, with participation open to all ages and levels, plus a celebration and surprises in the city.

name: 4ος Καλλιγώνιος Ημιμαραθώνιος
description: The Kalligonios Half Marathon in Lefkada is an annual road race offering events for everyone, from a children’s race to a half marathon. The race combines an athletic challenge with the beauty of Lefkada’s scenery, attracting runners of all ages and abilities. The event is friendly and offers all participants an enjoyable experience.
course_highlights: 21.1 km and 9 km routes featuring natural scenery and historical monuments
1,000 m race for Special Olympics participants and children
Discounts on accommodation and transport for participants
additional: An event focused on cultural and athletic experiences, with entries in various categories and preparation for other races. Registration for 2027 appears to be opening soon.

name: Τρέχω για την άνοιξη ζωής
organizer: Πανελλήνια Ένωση Γονέων και Κηδεμόνων Ατόμων Παιδιών Νοητικά Υστερούντων (ΠΕΓΚΑΠ - ΝΥ)
description: The “I Run for the Spring of Life” road race is held under the auspices of the Attica Region and with the support of the Friends’ Association of P.E.G.K.A.P.-N.Y. It is a sporting event featuring 10 km and 4 km races, as well as a 500 m race for people with disabilities. The races start and finish on Drosias Avenue in Stamata. The courses are looped and pass by notable landmarks in the Municipality of Dionysos, offering an enjoyable experience for runners of all levels. The event is open to runners who train regularly as well as amateur athletes, with categories by age and gender.
course_highlights: Looped 10 km course (2 × 5 km), starting and finishing on Drosias Avenue in Stamata
4 km course for middle-school boys and girls and adults
500 m race open to people with disabilities
additional: The races take place on Sunday, March 28, 2027, in the Municipality of Dionysos. There are age categories for men and women, with age limits and veterans’ categories. Runners who train regularly as well as amateur athletes are eligible to participate. The start and finish are at the corner of Drosias–Stamata Avenue and Solomou Street, with designated turnarounds on the 2.5 km and 2 km courses. All participation supports charitable causes, with an emphasis on strengthening social cohesion and raising awareness about people with disabilities.

name: Voio Race – Νεάπολη
description: The Voio Race in Neapoli is organized by the Municipality of Voio and includes 10,000 m and 5,000 m races, as well as a 1,000 m children’s race. The start and finish are on Neapoli’s pedestrian street, and the course runs along the old Tsotyli–Neapoli national road. The race is open to runners aged 12 and over, offering a pleasant experience on a public road with support from the local traffic police. The event uses wave starts and provides electronic timing for all participants.
course_highlights: 10 km course on a public road, starting from the Tsotyli Health Center
5 km course, starting from the junction in the village of Peristera
1 km children’s race, starting from the kiosk at the entrance to Neapoli
additional: Participants collect a race number with an integrated timing chip and race materials from the registration center on race day. The 22 km race has a maximum finish time of 4 hours and uses wave starts, with runners assigned to start blocks based on their times. After the time limit, runners who have not finished continue at their own risk on the sidewalk. The event includes courses on public roads and pedestrian streets, with support from volunteers and awards for the winners. The event takes place on 28 March 2027.

name: OPENING SEASON-награден фонд 3 000 € Ultra Trail Run&XCM Cycling
location: Clearing above the Rakiya Kazan, Ayazmoto Park (Metropolitan Methodius Kusev Park), Stara Zagora, Bulgaria
organizer: Клуб по колоездене и туризъм „Сърнена гора“
description: OPENING SEASON 2027 is the fourth anniversary edition of the iconic race in Stara Zagora, opening the sports season with a record prize pool of €5,000. Organized by the Sarnena Gora Cycling and Tourism Club with the support of Stara Zagora Municipality, the event features Ultra Trail Run and XCM Cycling disciplines. The race offers a variety of distances with different difficulty levels and course markings, following scenic routes through Mitropolit Metodiy Kusev Park (Ayazmoto).
course_highlights: Dynamic 5 km course within the park, marked in white
Moderately challenging 11 km distance with yellow markings and moderate elevation gain
The royal 42 km distance, marked in orange and featuring the challenges of the Sarnena Gora
additional: Registration and collection of race packs and numbers with timing chips from 06:30 to 08:30. Technical briefing before the start. Cycling (XCM & E-Bike) starts at 09:00; running races at various distances (5, 11, 21, 34, 42 km) start at 09:30. Grand awards ceremony at 17:00. Routes are marked with different colors for each distance. The start and finish are on the meadow above the rakia still. According to the published schedule, registration is from 06:30 to 08:30, cycling starts at 09:00, and running starts at 09:30.

name: Danube 24h Run 2026
description: Danube 24h Run is an ultramarathon held in the city of Ruse at the City Stadium. Participants can choose between the 24-hour, 12-hour and 6-hour events, or a 3 x 2-hour relay. The event offers an endurance challenge and is suitable for runners with different levels of fitness.
course_highlights: Ruse City Stadium is the start and finish venue
Individual running and relay options
Events of different durations: 24 hours, 12 hours, 6 hours and a relay
additional: For the 2026 edition, the 24-hour and 6-hour runs are scheduled to start on March 28 at 11:00, the 12-hour run at 23:00, and the relay on March 29 at 06:00. The race date listed in the metadata differs from the dates on the edition pages.

name: Gârboavele Trail Run
location: Pădurea Gârboavele, Tulucești, Galați County, Romania

name: 9ο “Το Δεκάρι του Πάρκου”
description: The 9th Charity Road Race “The Park 10K” is being held for the ninth consecutive year on the beautiful trails of Tritsis Park. This is a cross-country race with 5- and 10-kilometer courses, supported by the Metropolitan Park Management Agency and organized for charity, benefiting MDA Hellas. The race attracts runners of all ages and abilities who enjoy running in nature and supporting their community.
course_highlights: Cross-country race at the Antonis Tritsis Environmental Awareness Park
5- and 10-kilometer courses through a natural setting
Access through five main entrances, with Entrance A recommended as it is near the start
additional: Tritsis Park can be accessed through five entrances; Entrance A, near the start, is recommended. The race is supported by the Park Management Agency and benefits MDA Hellas. It promotes social awareness, the protection of Tritsis Park, and support for MDA Hellas, while offering people of all ages the chance to enjoy sports in a natural setting.

name: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo
organizer: Спортен клуб по планинско бягане и туризъм „Пловдив и Родопа“
description: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo is a mountain running race held in the foothills of the Rhodope Mountains around the village of Markovo, Plovdiv Province. The race offers four distances—8, 12, 22, and 44 km—as well as a 700-meter children’s course. Participants can enjoy well-marked and secured courses with aid stations providing water, food, and drinks. Race services include timing, electronic results tracking, medical assistance, and special race packs with gifts. The event is held under the auspices of Markovo Town Hall and organized by the Plovdiv and Rhodopa Mountain Running and Tourism Sports Clubs.

name: 9ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Σπερχειού
description: Ο 9ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Σπερχειού «Αθανάσιος Ακρίδας» διοργανώνεται στη Σπερχειάδα Φθιώτιδας με τη στήριξη του Δήμου Μακρακώμης και της Δ.Κ. Σπερχειάδας. Πρόκειται για έναν αγώνα δρόμου που τιμά την παράδοση και το φυσικό κάλλος της περιοχής, προσφέροντας μια μοναδική εμπειρία σε δρομείς που αγαπούν το τρέξιμο και τη φύση. Ο αγώνας αποτελεί μια γιορτή άθλησης και κοινωνικής ευθύνης, με στόχο την προώθηση του μαζικού αθλητισμού και την ανάπτυξη του εθελοντισμού.

name: 44ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Δήμου Φιλοθέης – Ψυχικού
description: The 44th Filothei-Psychiko Municipality Road Race is an annual sporting event held in the Filothei and Psychiko area of Athens. The race offers runners of all ages an opportunity to take part in a route through a beautiful suburb with sports and cultural facilities. The event is supported by the Municipality of Filothei-Psychiko and promotes physical activity and social solidarity in the local community. The city is counting down to Sunday, March 22, race day.
