description: The 3rd Pallini Run is a sporting and cultural gathering held in Pallini, Attica, offering 5 km and 10 km road races as well as a 1,000 m children’s race. The race takes place on a World Athletics-certified course, mostly through beautiful Mediterranean countryside with vineyards and olive groves, on paved routes with gentle elevation changes. The start is at Eleftherias Square in Pallini, at 8:30 a.m. The event is supported by local clubs and has a charitable purpose. Participants receive a commemorative medal and hydration during the race.
course_highlights: World Athletics-certified course
Routes through Mediterranean countryside with vineyards and olive groves
Paved routes with gentle elevation changes
additional: Registration is online only and requires a debit or credit card. No registrations are accepted on race day. Group registration is available, with special rates for families with many children. All participants receive a commemorative medal and hydration. Paved routes with gentle elevation changes; participation from age 6 with parental consent; registration open until April 15, 2026; no race-day registration.

name: 5ος Αγώνας Ορεινού Τρεξίματος «Αλέξανδρος Παναγούλης»
description: The 5th “Alexandros Panagoulis” Mountain Running Race in Sivros, Lefkada, is a celebration of sport and nature, offering a unique experience on trails filled with springs and lush green landscapes. The race honors the memory of Alexandros Panagoulis and attracts athletes of all ages who enjoy the mountain course and friendly atmosphere. The event is marked by energy, smiles, and impressive performances, creating an unforgettable sporting experience.
course_highlights: Trails among springs and lush green landscapes
Mountain course in Sivros, Lefkada
An event honoring Alexandros Panagoulis
additional: An event focused on safety, hospitality, and showcasing the area’s natural beauty, with online registration and detailed results.

name: 8ο Kissavos Marathon Race Ευάγγελος Κουμπάρος
description: The Kissavos Marathon Race «Evangelos Koumbaros» is an annual mountain running race held in the area of Agia, Larissa. The route starts from Agia’s central square and crosses enchanting forest trails, picturesque mountain villages and natural springs, reaching the summit of Kissavos at 1,978 metres, with stunning views of the Aegean Sea. The race offers a unique experience in a protected forest of outstanding natural beauty, included in the NATURA 2000 network. The event also includes shorter routes and a children’s race, with full support and prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: Route through fairytale forests of fir, beech, oak and chestnut trees
Natural springs and picturesque mountain villages with squares and small chapels
Kissavos summit at 1,978 metres, with views of the Aegean Sea
additional: ITRA and UTMB scoring. Amenities: distance-marker signs, medical support, a medal for all participants, chip timing for net times, refreshments at numerous points, and food, dessert and fruit for athletes. The race will take place on 2 May 2027 in Agia, Larissa, with online registration through the official website. It includes various routes on mountain terrain, highlighting the area’s natural beauty.

name: 10ο Run For All
description: The 10th Papagou–Holargos City Road Race «RUN4ALL» is an annual event that honors World Autism Awareness Day and promotes the participation of people with intellectual disabilities and congenital heart conditions. The race includes a 1 km route for children and 5 km and 10 km races for adults and students, with electronic timing and commemorative gifts for all participants. Proceeds support the «Champs» basketball teams of the Holargos Basketball Club, which are for children on the autism spectrum. The event takes place in the Municipality of Papagou–Holargos and offers residents a 50% discount with a special coupon.
course_highlights: A 1 km children’s route, with children on the autism spectrum taking part
5 km and 10 km races with electronic timing and rankings
Event in the Municipality of Papagou–Holargos, supported by local sports clubs
additional: A 50% discount is available to residents of Papagou–Holargos with coupon DC2550. Primary and middle-school students can take part in the 1 km children’s race free of charge. All participants receive a technical T-shirt, medal, water, snack, and surprises. Group registration requires two steps: payment and submission of participants’ details before the race. Distances: 5 km and 10 km, plus a 1 km children’s route. Water and snacks are provided, along with medals and commemorative gifts. A doctor and ambulance will be present.

name: 17o Μονοπάτι Παρνασσού
description: The 17th Parnassos Trail is a major mountain-running celebration held in Amfikleia, Phthiotis. The event includes seven races for all ages and fitness levels, with routes starting and finishing in 25th of March Square. The two-day event features children’s races, the Amfikleia City Trail through the traditional settlement’s narrow lanes, and mountain races of 6, 12, and 25 kilometers with significant elevation gain. The event combines sporting activity with local tradition and natural beauty, offering participants a comprehensive experience.
course_highlights: Technical 25 km mountain route with 1,610 m of elevation gain
4 km route through the cobbled lanes of the traditional settlement of Amfikleia
A variety of races for all ages and fitness levels
additional: All races start and finish in 25th of March Square in Amfikleia. Race registration is located in the courtyard of the Cultural Center in the square. Saturday afternoon features children’s races and the Amfikleia City Trail, followed by a Pasta Party for participants in the evening. Awards are presented on Saturday evening for the children’s races and City Trail, and on Sunday afternoon for the mountain races. The event also includes children’s races, online registration, and supporting events such as a pasta party. The event takes place on April 25 and 26, 2026, with the aim of promoting sport and nature.

name: 20ός Διεθνής Μαραθώνιος «Μέγας Αλέξανδρος»
description: The Alexander the Great International Marathon covers the route from Pella, the ancient capital of Macedonia and birthplace of Alexander the Great, to Thessaloniki, the modern Greek metropolis. It is a race that combines sport with history and culture, offering a unique experience along a route steeped in Greece and ancient Greek civilization. The marathon is a major international sporting event, with accompanying activities and races for all ages and categories.
course_highlights: Route from ancient Pella to Thessaloniki
Beautiful scenery and historic sites along the route
A combination of sport and culture
additional: Road races of 1,000 m are offered for primary school students, along with 5 km and 10 km races, as well as the Panhellenic Marathon Championship for athletes with disabilities. There are accompanying activities, information sessions, and cultural events. Group registration is available for teams of 10 people or more. Technical instructions and participation certificates are provided. The event includes 5 km and 10 km races and a marathon, as well as accompanying activities and exhibitions.

name: Ηετιώνιος Αγώνας Δρόμου
description: The Hetionian Dapetsona Road Race, under the auspices of the Municipality of Keratsini-Drapetsona and the Region of Attica, invites runners of all ages to take part in a celebration of sport and culture. The route starts at the old Drapetsona town hall and is designed with respect for the area’s historical and cultural heritage. With a friendly atmosphere and excellent organization, the race offers an opportunity to participate, stay healthy, and share a sense of community. Routes are available for adults, children, and people with disabilities, offering a unique experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the old Drapetsona town hall
5 km route heading east
Children’s race and 500-meter race for people with disabilities
additional: The time limit for the 5 km route is 1 hour, after which runners proceed at their own risk. Participants under 18 need a declaration of consent from a parent or guardian. Registration is not available on race day. Ceremonies and results at a local event, participation in various categories, and respect for the area’s history and culture.

name: Go Kea
description: GO KEA is an exciting two-day sporting event combining trail running and open-water swimming on the beautiful island of Kea. The event aims to offer an authentic experience of sport and connection with nature, establishing Kea as a unique sporting destination. The two-day event brings together athletes and enthusiasts from across Greece and abroad, offering a variety of activities in a captivating Cycladic landscape.
course_highlights: Trail running on Kea’s natural trails
Open-water swimming in the island’s clear waters
A connection with nature and the unique Cycladic landscape
additional: The event is organized in collaboration with GOEvents. Information is provided about ferry routes from Lavrio to Kea and local transportation. You can sign up for a mailing list to receive updates about the Municipality of Kea and its events. The event includes trail running and open-water swimming routes, with an emphasis on safety, preparation, and enjoying nature. Participants can register in advance and enjoy a complete outdoor activity experience.

name: 2o Rodopi Backyard Ultra
description: The Rodopi Backyard Ultra is a demanding backyard ultra held in the Komotini area. It is an endurance race in which runners must complete repeated 6.7-kilometer laps every hour until only one winner remains. The course is mountainous and showcases the unique natural beauty of the Rhodope region, combining technical trails with changes in elevation. The race is organized by the Rodopi Runners club, which ensures smooth organization and supports participants.
course_highlights: Mountain course with technical trails
Repeated 6.7-kilometer laps every hour
Unique natural beauty of the Rhodope region
additional: The race is run in one-hour cycles, with runners required to complete the 6.7 km lap within the hour to continue. Refreshments are available along the course, and the organizer provides support. Race regulations governing safety and participation are available on the official website. The event takes place outdoors on a competitive course, with an emphasis on endurance and participant support. The event includes organizational and medical support.

name: MaricaRUN
description: MaricaRUN 2026 is a unique sporting event featuring 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a 1 km children’s run, held in the beautiful Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. The race combines sport, excitement, and a charitable cause, with 40% of entry fees donated to charity. The course is flat, suitable for everyone, and passes through the most beautiful parts of the park, with views of the Maritsa River. Participants will enjoy a well-organized route with refreshment stations and a festive atmosphere featuring prizes and sports demonstrations.

name: Коджа Кая
description: Kodzha Kaya is Bulgaria’s first fully autonomous ultramarathon, held in the village of Bilka, in the Kodzha Kaya Peak area. The race offers various distances with substantial elevation gain and no aid stations, making it a true test of endurance and skill. Participants are challenged to finish before sunset while enjoying breathtaking views and natural beauty. This event is for lovers of adventure and mountain running, and leaves memories to last a lifetime.

name: МарицаРън 2026
description: Maritsa Run 2026 is a professionally organized race suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The event offers three distances: 1 km for children up to 14 years old, 5 km for a fun sporting challenge, and 10 km for a greater personal achievement. The course passes through the most beautiful parts of Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad, including its paths, the river, the relaxation area, and art installations. Participants can enjoy a great atmosphere with music, spectators, and support along the route, as well as prizes and recognition, with a prize fund of over €1,500.

name: Sălciua Trail Run
description: Sălciua Trail Run 2026 este o competiție de alergare în natură desfășurată în comuna Sălciua, situată între Munții Trascău și Muntele Mare, oferind o priveliște spectaculoasă. Evenimentul reunește pasionați de alergare, natură, cultură și distracție, fiind o oportunitate de a evada din cotidian și de a te bucura de frumusețea naturii în compania celor dragi. Competiția include patru curse: Cursa Zmeilor (28 km), Crosul Liliecilor (15 km), Family and Young Run (5 km) și Cursa Spiridușilor (400-800 m), deschise tuturor participanților care respectă condițiile de vârstă și înscriere. Organizatorii asigură o experiență completă, cu kituri de concurs, festivitate de premiere și ateliere tematice pentru toate vârstele.

name: Chindia City Race
description: Chindia City Race este o alergare tradițională organizată în inima Cetății Târgoviștei, chiar lângă emblematicul Turn al Chindiei. Evenimentul are loc pe 2 mai 2026, în Piața Tricolorului, și adună participanți de toate vârstele, într-o atmosferă de sărbătoare și competiție prietenoasă. Startul este programat la ora 10:00, iar cursa celebrează spiritul și istoria orașului, invitând alergătorii să-și testeze viteza și rezistența pe un traseu urban plin de energie și tradiție.

name: ROC 50 Miles
description: The Rodopi Challenge 50 Miles (ROC) is an introductory 89-kilometre mountain ultra trail race with 4,800 metres of positive elevation gain, held every spring in the Rhodope mountain range by the non-profit company Rodopi Ultra Trail AMKE. The loop course starts and finishes at the Erymanthos Forest Village and passes through villages, primeval forests and mountain trails. The race is aimed at experienced athletes who want to be introduced to the spirit of ultra trail racing, offering a demanding and unique mountain-running experience. The race starts early in the morning, and participants have a time limit of 19.5 hours to finish.
course_highlights: 89-kilometre course: 72% trails, 25% dirt roads and 3% paved roads
Total positive elevation gain of 4,800 metres
Passes through primeval forests, villages and mountain trails of outstanding natural beauty
additional: Maximum of 300 participants. The race closes at 00:30 on the same day, allowing a time limit of 19.5 hours. To participate, runners must have finished or withdrawn from a mountain-running race of at least 40 kilometres after 1/1/2024. The course is part of the ROUT Classic 100 miles and is a loop. The race includes routes on natural trails and offers accommodation options at campsites and hotels, with access mainly by road and rail. Family events and other shorter-distance routes are also available.

name: Mechi Chal Trail Chepelare
description: Mechi Chal Trail is an exciting mountain race taking place on May 3, 2026, in Chepelare, at Olympic Square. The courses follow mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The race offers three distances with different elevation gains, challenging participants with true mountain terrain. Every finisher receives a medal, and the winners receive cash and merchandise prizes.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване и спускане мъже и жени, под 20 г., под 18г., под 16г.
description: The National Mountain Running Championship—uphill and downhill—for men and women, as well as under-20, under-18 and under-16 boys and girls, takes place in Chepelare. The competition offers challenging mountain terrain that tests participants’ endurance and skills. It is an important event in the Bulgarian athletics calendar, attracting both young and experienced runners. The organizers provide professional event management and support for all participants.

name: Sri Chinmoy Run and Become Marathon
17ος Διεθνής Ποσειδώνιος Ημιμαραθώνιος
description: Ο 17ος Διεθνής Ποσειδώνιος Ημιμαραθώνιος στο Παλαιό Φάληρο προσφέρει όμορφες και γρήγορες διαδρομές δίπλα στη θάλασσα, ιδανικές για δρομείς όλων των επιπέδων. Η διοργάνωση περιλαμβάνει παράλληλους αγώνες όπως σκυταλοδρομία, τέταρτο μαραθώνιο, αγώνα 5 χλμ, δυναμικό βάδισμα και παιδικό αγώνα, δημιουργώντας μια γιορτή αθλητισμού και κοινωνικής προσφοράς. Οι συμμετέχοντες απολαμβάνουν υψηλής ποιότητας τεχνικά μπλουζάκια και έχουν τη δυνατότητα να κατεβάσουν πιστοποιητικά επίδοσης και φωτογραφίες από τον αγώνα. Η διοργάνωση φροντίζει για την άνεση και την ενημέρωση των δρομέων με ψηφιακό βοηθό γραμματείας και πλήρες πρόγραμμα αγώνων.

name: 3ος Εργατικός Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμου
description: The 3rd Workers’ People’s Road Race, organized by the Athens and Piraeus Labour Centres, is a race with historical and political significance, dedicated to the memory of the 200 communists executed in Kaisariani on May Day 1944. The route starts at the Haidari Camp and finishes at the Kaisariani Shooting Range, honoring their sacrifice and keeping historical memory alive. The race has been embraced by the unions and is open to everyone who wants to follow in the footsteps of History. The race starts early in the morning, and all participants receive commemorative medals. The top three men and women in the overall standings are awarded.
course_highlights: Route from Haidari Camp to the Kaisariani Shooting Range
Historical and political event dedicated to the 200 executed communists
Commemorative event with awards and medals
additional: The race starts at Haidari Camp “Karaiskaki A” – Block 15 and finishes at the Kaisariani Shooting Range. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 11 a.m. PAME invites people to participate. All finishers receive commemorative medals. Ceremonies and road race, with registration open until April 30; finish at the Kaisariani Shooting Range, awards and commemorative medals.

name: 5o Pamvotis View Trail
description: The 5th Pamvotis View Trail is a mountain-running race held in Drosocori, Ioannina, offering two routes against the backdrop of the enchanting Lake Pamvotis and the area's impressive mountains. The start and finish are in the village square, and the routes pass scenic spots such as Mavili, Driskos, Gerakari, and Iliokali. The race is open to runners of all levels, offering a unique experience of nature and adventure near the city of Ioannina. The organizers provide medical coverage and aid stations to ensure participants’ safety and comfort.
course_highlights: Two routes: 21 km with +1,150 m elevation gain and 9 km with +420 m elevation gain
Aid stations at 6, 13, and 17 km on the 21 km route
Potable water springs at 7, 15, and 19 km on the 21 km route
additional: Medical coverage is provided by volunteers from the Ioannina Red Cross and a private doctor, with a portable defibrillator available. Participants must be over 18; minors need a signed parental declaration and must be accompanied by a parent. Routes have aid stations and medical coverage from the Red Cross and a private doctor, with time limits of 2 and 5 hours to finish, respectively.

name: 9ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Λιμένων Μεγάρων – Νέας Περάμου
location: Λιμάνι Νέας Περάμου, Νέα Πέραμος, Μεγαρέα, Αττική, Ελλάδα
description: The 9th Megara–Nea Peramos Ports Road Race is a sporting celebration organized by the Local Councils of the Municipal Communities of Megara and Nea Peramos, in collaboration with the Deputy Mayor for Sports & the New Generation of the Municipality of Megara and the “Athinaioi Dromeis” athletic club. It features 9- and 18-kilometer routes, as well as a 1,000-meter children’s race. The race aims to promote sports and showcase the area’s natural beauty and history. The race starts at the port of Nea Peramos and the port of Pachi, Megara, with a shared finish at the port of Pachi, Megara.
course_highlights: 9,050 m and 18,100 m routes
Start at the port of Nea Peramos (9 km) and the port of Pachi, Megara (18 km)
Shared finish at the port of Pachi, Megara
additional: Timing is electronic, using an RFID chip. Refreshment and water stations and medical support are provided. The time limit for the 18 km race is 2 hours and 30 minutes. Adults and minors with a signed parental consent form may participate. A 1,000 m children’s race is available for children born between 2014 and 2020. The event is organized in collaboration with local municipal bodies, with an emphasis on promoting sports and social cohesion at the port of Nea Peramos.

name: 9ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Πυθαγόρας ο Σάμιος
description: The 9th “Pythagoras the Samian” Half Marathon is a major sporting event held on Samos, starting at the Heraion’s Kolona. The race honors the memory of Pythagoras, the great philosopher and mathematician of antiquity, and attracts runners from all over Greece. The course offers a unique running experience in a historic and picturesque setting, combining sport and culture. The event is organized by the Directorate of Primary Education of Samos, which ensures the smooth running of the event and the safety of participants.
course_highlights: Start at the Heraion’s Kolona, a historic site on Samos
Course with views of the Aegean Sea
A blend of cultural and sporting surroundings
additional: Courses through natural and cultural sites, starting at the Heraion’s Kolona and finishing at Pythagoras Central Square, with water and isotonic drinks provided, as well as cultural activities.

name: 15η Ανοπαία Ατραπός
organizer: Δήμος Λαμιέων και Σύλλογος Δρομέων Φθιώτιδας
description: The 15th Anopaia Trail is a landmark mountain running race held at Thermopylae, an area of historical significance and natural beauty. The race is at the heart of mountain running in the region, offering a unique experience for runners who love a challenge and the outdoors. It is organized by the Municipality of Lamia, which supports the promotion of sport and the area’s natural environment. The event attracts runners from across Greece and is a celebration of mountain running.
course_highlights: Route through historic Thermopylae
Mountain scenery and striking natural beauty
Challenging terrain for mountain runners
additional: Technical T-shirt available, finish at a historic site, registration until April 24, 2026, written permission from a parent or guardian required, and online registration available.

name: Εορδαία Run
description: Eordaia Run is an important sporting event hosted by the Municipality of Eordaia. The event aims to promote the values of sport, foster the spirit of fair play, and strengthen grassroots running. It includes a 10-kilometer road race and a 1,000-meter children’s race, offering an enjoyable sporting experience for all participants. The event emphasizes safety and the smooth running of the races, with transportation provided for runners and a registration desk for race-number collection.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer road race
1,000-meter children’s race
Bus transportation for runners from the community of Kryovrysi
additional: The registration desk opens at 15:30 for race-number collection. Buses transport runners from 16:15 to 16:45. Due to a date change, those who have already paid cannot participate and should contact the organizers by email for a refund. 10-kilometer road race and 1,000-meter children’s race, tradition and events, date: April 17, 2026, Ptolemaida, Greece

name: Run Greece Καβάλα
description: Run Greece Kavala is a sporting event featuring 10 km and 5 km races, a power walking event, and races for families and children. The event promotes sport and healthy living in the city of Kavala, offering an enjoyable experience for runners of all ages and levels. It is supported by SEGAS and is part of the national Run Greece programme. The start and finish are at central locations in the city, with safe and scenic routes.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km routes in an urban setting
Power walking and races for children and families
Organised event supported by SEGAS
additional: The event includes road races for adults, power walking, a Family Run, and races for children. It promotes the I Run Clean programme and safety in sport. There is a mobile app related to the race. Participants can register online, and race materials can be collected from the service centre in Kavala. The route includes two laps around the city, and the event promotes sport and social participation.

name: Voio Race Series – Μπούρινος
description: VoioRace is a series of four road races held in different locations in the Municipality of Voio, aiming to promote health, well-being, and social cohesion. The event is organized on a non-profit basis with the help of volunteers and is open to people over the age of 15. The courses are mountainous and offer an opportunity to walk, run, and enjoy nature. Taking part is considered a victory and finishing a triumph, promoting sport as an important part of life.
course_highlights: Four road races in different locations in the Municipality of Voio
Beautiful mountain courses
Promotion of health, well-being, and social responsibility
additional: People over the age of 15 may participate. Minors require parental consent. The event is organized with the help of volunteers and promotes social cohesion and environmental responsibility. Four road races in different locations in the Municipality of Voio, with varied courses and activities that support the local community and an active lifestyle.

name: 10 дневно състезание „Шри Чинмой“
description: The 10-day Sri Chinmoy race in Sofia is the first certified multi-day race in Bulgaria and takes place in St. Peter and Paul Park. The race is run on a flat, certified 785-meter asphalt loop, with each participant competing to cover the greatest possible distance over 10 days. The event is organized with attention to detail, including official lap counting and strict rules for fairness and safety. Participants can enjoy the atmosphere of the race village and the support of the organizers and fellow runners.

name: РЕКОРД НА ХАЙДУШКАТА ПЪТЕКА 2026
location: Sinite Kamani Nature Park, Sliven, Bulgaria
description: The Haidushka Path Record 2026 is an annual race held in Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven. Participants race up the iconic trail from its starting point to the large fountain by Karandila Hotel. The route offers different variations of varying difficulty. The race is for prestige, with no categories or prize money; results are officially recorded and published for every participant who completes the climb in under 1 hour. It is a unique challenge for mountain-running and nature enthusiasts.

name: ЮНАШКИ ИГРИ 2026
location: Сините камъни Nature Park, Sliven, Bulgaria
description: Yunashki Games 2026 take place in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven on May 6, in honor of the birthday of Hadji Dimitar and St. George’s Day—the Day of Courage. The event celebrates the traditions and spirit of the haiduks, featuring games and competitions in which they tested their strength when choosing a voivode. The course and atmosphere are connected to the region’s historical heritage and the natural beauty of Sinite Kamani. The event is organized by the Old Elm Foundation, which works to preserve Sliven’s cultural heritage and nature.

name: Crosul de noapte
description: Crosul de Noapte - Delonghi is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants two distances: 4 km and 10 km. The event takes place on May 8, 2026, and is suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a nighttime sporting experience in the city. It is an excellent opportunity to run in an urban setting with a friendly and competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: 4 km and 10 km distances
Night run in Cluj-Napoca
Urban course accessible to all levels
additional: The event includes well-marked courses, online registration, and a safe environment for participants.

name: Iron Ultra Trail
description: Iron Ultra Trail je izazovna trka u prirodi koja se održava u Valjevu, poznata po svojim zahtevnim stazama i prelepim pejzažima Zapadne Srbije. Trka okuplja zaljubljenike u trail trčanje i avanturistički duh, pružajući jedinstveno iskustvo kroz šumske i planinske terene. Organizatori West Serbia Trails garantuju vrhunsku atmosferu i dobru organizaciju za sve učesnike.

name: Международен турнир за юноши и девойки под 18 г. „Младост”
description: The “Youth” International Tournament for boys and girls under 18 is held at the City Stadium in Ruse. This event has a rich tradition and brings together young athletes from various countries to compete in a range of track and field disciplines. The tournament supports the development of youth sport and gives talented athletes under 18 the opportunity to compete. The organizers emphasize the importance of registered performances for participation in certain disciplines, such as the girls’ long jump.

name: Трън Ултра Рън
description: Tran Ultra Run is an ultramarathon mountain-running event held in the picturesque Kraishte region, based in the village of Turokovtsi, Tran Municipality. The event offers four courses of varying distances and elevation gains, passing through the Rui, Ezimir, and Greben mountains, with numerous panoramic views and varied terrain ranging from soft trails to rocky sections. Organized by the Tran Tourist Association with the support of Tran Municipality, the event is suitable for mountain-running enthusiasts seeking a challenge and beautiful scenery.

name: Alpinist TRI
description: The Climbing Triathlon “New Life for the Alpinist Hut” is a unique competition that replaces classic swimming with a vertical challenge. It takes place around the Alpinist Hut and the village of Basarbovo, Ruse, and includes three disciplines: MTB cycling, running, and a final Via Ferrata climb. The competition can be entered individually or as a two-person relay, and all funds raised go toward restoring the hut. It’s an opportunity to test your strength against nature and support a worthy cause in one of the most beautiful areas of the Polomie region.

name: Amusnet Charity Run 2026
description: Amusnet Charity Run 2026 is a trail run with a cause, held in the area of the village of Zheleznitsa, near Sofia. The course is just over 5 km long and offers varied terrain, including a beautiful forest trail, a challenging climb, and a final descent. The event is open to everyone, whether you want to run or walk. The main goal is to take part and support the National Paralympic Federation. For every kilometer covered, Amusnet donates €5 to support the cause, which helps Bulgarian athletes with disabilities.

name: Tran Ultra Run
description: Tran Ultra Run is a mountain race held in the picturesque Kraishte region, based in the village of Turakovtsi, Tran Municipality. The race offers four courses of varying distances and elevation gains, passing through the Ruy, Ezimirska, and Greben mountains, with numerous peaks and panoramic views. The courses are loop routes with varied terrain, including soft trails, rocky sections, steep slopes, and forest areas. Organized by the Tran Tourist Society with the support of Tran Municipality, the race provides course marking, aid stations, and medical assistance for participants.

description: The Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță is an international half marathon held on some of Bucharest’s most beautiful and fastest streets, offering both professional athletes and amateur runners the opportunity to achieve a competitive personal best. The event also includes 10 km races, races for people with mobility impairments, and a 3.5 km fun run for all ages. The race kit includes a bib with chip timing and a finisher’s medal, while the official T-shirt is optional. The organizer is the Constantina Diță Sports Club Association, and the event is supported by major partners such as Decathlon.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on Bucharest’s main streets
World Athletics Label-certified half marathon course
Dedicated routes for the half marathon, 10 km, people with disabilities, and the fun run
additional: The race kit must be collected in person at the Expo, upon presentation of an ID document. The official T-shirt is optional and can be purchased separately for EUR 15. Participation for wheelchair users is free. The time limit is 3 hours for the half marathon and 1.5 hours for the 10 km race. Some streets will be closed during the event, so using public transport is recommended, especially the metro to Aviatorilor station. The course offers options for running and walking, with the opportunity to take part in record attempts; the event also includes other races, such as the 10 km and relay races.

name: Subcarpați Trail Run
location: Baza Sportivă „Stejarul”, Cocorăștii Mislii, Prahova, Romania
distance_verbose: 50 mile, Maraton, Maraton, 23 km, Semimaraton, 5 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Categoria de vârstă 14–17 ani beneficiază de taxă redusă: 150 lei pe toată perioada înscrierilor

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Fun Race – 125 lei / persoană, indiferent de vârstă

description: Subcarpați Trail Run is a mountain running competition organized for trail running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience in the heart of Goruna Forest, in the Prahova Subcarpathians. The varied courses, from the Fun Race to the Ultramarathon, test runners’ endurance and perseverance in spectacular natural surroundings. The event brings together amateurs and professionals in a friendly, motivating atmosphere, with the start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii. It is an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the area and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Courses through Goruna Forest, with scenery of wooded hills
Distances and difficulty levels vary, from the 4 km Fun Race to the 75 km Ultramarathon with 2,800 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday from 16:30 to 21:30 and on Saturday morning, depending on the race. The Ultramarathon starts at 06:00, the Marathon at 10:00, and the Half Marathon and Cross Country Race also at 10:00. The Fun Race starts after 11:45. Cash and product prizes are awarded to winners, including bonuses for course records. Varied courses, start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base, on-site registration available, official photographers on the course.

name: Thermal Trail Race 2026
description: Thermal Trail Race este o competiție de trail running ce se desfășoară în Betfia / Băile 1 Mai, pe potecile pitorești ale pădurii din zonă. Evenimentul oferă două probe, una de 14 km și una de 7 km, potrivite pentru diferite categorii de vârstă și niveluri de experiență. Traseele sunt bine marcate și oferă o experiență sportivă în natură, cu premii pentru cei mai buni concurenți. Participanții beneficiază de cronometrare electronică și tricou oficial al evenimentului.

name: Trascău Trail Run ~ 2026
description: Trascău Trail Run este o cursă montană ce oferă trei probe: maraton, semimaraton și cros, desfășurate în peisaje pitorești din zona Rimetea, Alba. Traseele trec prin locuri spectaculoase precum Piatra Secuiului, Cetatea Colțești, Cheile Plaiului și Peștera Huda lui Papară, oferind o experiență de alergare montană cu diferențe semnificative de nivel și priveliști impresionante. Evenimentul este organizat de Asociația Green & Wild și pune accent pe aventura în natură și patrimoniul local. Participanții beneficiază de puncte de hidratare și alimentare, medalii și premii, iar înscrierile sunt limitate și se fac online.

name: TRAILRUN IN TARA NASAUDULUI
description: Trail Run în Țara Năsăudului este un eveniment de alergare în natură destinat tuturor categoriilor de vârstă și nivelurilor de experiență, desfășurat în jurul Casuțelor din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud. Evenimentul oferă trei curse diferite: un traseu de 2 km pentru copii și familii, un traseu intermediar de 5 km cu urcări scurte și poteci de pădure, și un traseu de 10 km dedicat alergătorilor care caută o provocare autentică de trail running. Participanții se bucură de o atmosferă de susținere, socializare și fair-play, cu puncte de hidratare pe trasee și un Starter Kit inclus pentru cursele de 5 km și 10 km.

name: Fox Trail Čardak 2026
description: Fox Trail Čardak je trka koja vodi kroz jedinstveni pejzaž Deliblatske peščare, pružajući učesnicima priliku da biraju između tri distance: 5 km rekreativno, 12 km izazovno i 21 km trail polumaraton. Ova manifestacija održava se 9. maja 2026. godine u Čardaku i namenjena je svim ljubiteljima prirode i trčanja, bilo da su početnici ili iskusni trkači. Staza je pažljivo osmišljena da pruži autentično iskustvo trčanja kroz prirodu sa odgovarajućim izazovima i lepotama peščare.

name: 14ο Corfu Mountain Trail
description: Ο 14ος Corfu Mountain Trail είναι μια σειρά από τέσσερις μοναδικούς αγώνες ορεινού τρεξίματος που διεξάγονται στο νησί της Κέρκυρας. Οι διαδρομές περιλαμβάνουν το CMT Ultra 103 χλμ με ανάβαση στο όρος Παντοκράτορα, το Rain Trail 44 χλμ, το Olive Tree Trail 24 χλμ και το Quick Trail 12 χλμ, προσφέροντας εκπληκτικές θέες στη θάλασσα και τα παραδοσιακά χωριά. Ο τερματισμός γίνεται στην καρδιά της πόλης της Κέρκυρας, στο Liston, δίνοντας μια ξεχωριστή εμπειρία σε κάθε δρομέα. Η διοργάνωση συνεργάζεται με τον Δήμο Κεντρικής Κέρκυρας και τα Διαπόντια Νησιά, προσφέροντας μια αξέχαστη αθλητική περιπέτεια.

name: 2ος Αγώνας Δρόμου «Πλατανοθεραπεία»
description: The 2nd “Platanotherapy” Road Race in Davleia is a unique event held amid the village’s natural beauty. The event features three courses and is intended for runners who want to enjoy the scenery and the sporting experience in a friendly environment. It is organized by the Municipality of Livadeia, the Davleia Community, and the Pandavleiakos team, with a start time of 17:30. This is a lovely sporting event that strengthens the local community and promotes a love of sport.
course_highlights: Three different courses through the natural beauty of Davleia
Held in the mountainous surroundings of Mount Parnassus
Start at 17:30 for an enjoyable late-afternoon sporting experience
additional: The race is organized by the Municipality of Livadeia, the Davleia Community, and the Pandavleiakos team. The race starts in Davleia, in the Mount Parnassus area. No information was found about registration fees or the registration process. Pre-registration is required. The race starts on Saturday, 15/05/2027, between 17:30 and 17:50. The course is approximately 5 kilometers long and includes natural scenery and sporting activities.

name: 4ο Triantafilia Mountain Trail Races
description: The 4th Triantafilia Mountain Trail Races are organized by the Panta Vrechei Greek Mountaineering Club in the South Evrytania area. These mountain races feature courses along trails and dirt roads, with beautiful natural scenery and significant elevation gain. The race starts from Tornos Square, and the 10 km course includes trails such as the Waterfalls Trail and the Pilgrims’ Trail. The race is aimed at runners who love mountain running and being in nature.
course_highlights: Scenic trails, including the Waterfalls Trail
650 meters of elevation gain on the 10 km course
Courses along dirt roads and trails in South Evrytania
additional: The races are held under the auspices of local authorities and sports organizations, with participants competing over various distances on spectacular routes through mountain trails and villages.

name: 6ο Thrace Night Run
description: The 6th Thrace Night Run in Alexandroupoli is an annual sporting event offering 10,000 m, 5,000 m and 1,500 m races for runners of all ages. The race starts and finishes on the city’s seafront avenue, on a 2,500 m loop course, with both power walking and running. The event combines sport and culture, with the registration centre hosted at a gallery of post-Byzantine visual arts. It features electronic timing, extensive medical support and awards for winners in various age categories. The race attracts more than 1,200 participants and is supported by the Municipality of Alexandroupoli and other organisations.
course_highlights: A 2,500 m loop course along Alexandroupoli’s seafront avenue
Power walking and running over 1,500 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m distances
Start and finish on the seafront avenue, with electronic timing
additional: Race-pack collection is available on the Friday and Saturday before the race at the Old Town Hall of Alexandroupoli. Water and bananas are provided at refreshment stations along the course and at the finish. All participants receive a sports backpack. Dry-fit T-shirts, windbreakers and thermal garments are available for purchase. The race has a total limit of 1,200 participants. Medical support includes medical examinations and cooperation with the National Centre for Emergency Care (EKAB), the Hellenic Red Cross and the Hellenic Rescue Team. The race takes place on 15 May 2027, with participants from across Greece and the Balkans. The event promotes unity, sport and culture, while offering a unique night-running experience.

name: Elenovo Trail Run 2026
location: село Еленово, местност "Кара дере", община Нова Загора, област Сливен, Bulgaria
organizer: Народно читалище "Светлина-1908" и Община Нова Загора
price_range: до 12 април - по-ниска цена, след това - по-висока
description: Elenovo Trail Run is a new trail-running event in Nova Zagora Municipality, Sliven Province. The race takes place in the scenic Kara Dere area near the village of Elenovo, with varied courses suitable for runners of different levels. The event is part of the regional folklore festival and offers a unique opportunity to combine sport and nature with local traditions. The organizers provide GPX files for the courses to help participants prepare.
course_highlights: Courses of 4 km, 10/11 km, and 20/21 km on mountainous terrain
The Kara Dere area, with scenic views and natural beauty
Held as part of a folklore festival with a rich cultural program
additional: GPX files for the courses are available to download and use for preparation. The event takes place in an area with the Kara Dere reservoir. The organizer is the Nova Zagora Tourist Information Center, with coordinator Daniel Yordanov. The courses are available as downloadable GPX files; the event includes various routes and cultural activities in the Kara Dere area.

name: Sunrise Ultra
description: Sunrise Ultra is a challenging race along the rugged cliffs of Bulgaria’s northern coast, offering three distances: 42 km, 17 km, and 7 km. The race passes through iconic natural and cultural landmarks in the municipalities of Kavarna and Shabla, combining endurance with the beauty of the seascape. Participants receive a special T-shirt and medal inspired by the sunrise and the vastness of the sea, symbolizing the spirit of the event. It is a unique experience for nature and running enthusiasts seeking adventure and inspiration.

name: Wings for Life
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race for runners and wheelchair participants, taking place on May 10, 2026, in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. Instead of a traditional finish line, competitors run until they are caught by the virtual “Catcher Car,” which starts 30 minutes after the beginning and gradually increases its speed. The event raises funds for spinal cord research, with 100% of entry fees and donations going to this cause. Participants can gather at the popular “The Sun” spot in Borisova Gradina and take part through the Wings for Life World Run mobile app.

name: XL kmrun - Плана
description: XL Plana is a trail race and part of the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun. It takes place near the village of Plana, close to Sofia, in the Plana Mountain. Participants can choose from three distances—5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km—which cross open terrain with varied conditions, including wet and sunny sections. The race is suitable for mountain-running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in a natural setting.

name: Луковит рън
description: The Lukovit Run road race is an annual 8.8-kilometer event that starts in the center of Lukovit and finishes at Prohodna Cave. The race attracts runners of different ages and abilities, with past winners including Ismail Senandzhi and Marinela Nинеva. The event is part of the Municipality of Lukovit’s sports calendar and offers a mass start over 800 meters for younger participants. The course is scenic and challenging, combining urban and natural surroundings.

name: Мемориал „Веселин Даскалов”
description: The Veselin Daskalov Memorial is a traditional athletics competition held in Lukovit, Bulgaria. The jubilee 20th edition took place at the city stadium, with more than 200 athletes from across the country competing in various distances from 100 m to 1500 m. The competition attracts both children and national-level athletes, providing opportunities for young talents and established competitors to showcase their skills. The organizers hold an official awards ceremony attended by local representatives and sports figures.

name: Маратон "Розова долина" - Rose Valley Marathon
description: The Rose Valley Marathon in Kazanlak is a sporting event for running enthusiasts of all levels. Its main goal is to encourage physical activity and introduce participants to the beauty of Bulgaria’s Rose Valley. The race offers three distances: a classic marathon of 42 km, a half marathon of 21 km, and a 10 km race. The start and finish are in Rosarium Park, in front of the Museum of Roses in Kazanlak. The course passes through the city, along cycling paths, and on secondary roads, with around 100 meters of elevation gain. The event takes place on May 10, 2026, at 09:00 and offers refreshment stations every 5 km, as well as awards in various categories.

name: СТЕНАТА RUN 2026
description: STENATA RUN 2026 is a race held near the Shumen Reservoir in the city of Shumen. The event offers various distances and formats, including individual and relay runs lasting from 1 to 6 hours. The course is suitable for runners with different levels of fitness and goals, combining natural beauty with challenges. The organizers, Shumen Early Runners, invite you to take part in this dynamic and friendly race.

name: VW Mureș Half Marathon
description: VW Mureș Half Marathon 2026 te invită să alergi în inima Transilvaniei, prin centrul orașului Târgu Mureș, pe 10 mai 2026. Evenimentul oferă trasee variate de 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, ștafetă 4x5 km și cursă pentru copii, toate cu startul și sosirea în zona centrală, ideală pentru susținerea de către familie și prieteni. Participanții vor descoperi punctele turistice reprezentative ale orașului într-o atmosferă vibrantă de primăvară, bucurându-se de premii, medalii și energie bună la fiecare pas. Organizatorul este Asociația Mureș Runners, care promovează un stil de viață sănătos și comunitatea prin sport.

name: Urbani polumaraton
description: Sportsko udruženje Urbana desetka poziva vas da učestvujete u Urbani polumaraton u Smederevu 10. maja 2026. godine. Ovaj događaj obuhvata drugu godinu polumaratona na 21 km i treću godinu Dunavske desetke na 10 km, trke koje vode uz obalu Dunava, kroz urbano jezgro grada, Vilu Obrenovića i naselje Jugovo. Trkači će uživati u kombinaciji ravničarskog terena i valovitih vinograda, sa startom na Trgu republike ispred zgrade suda. Svaki učesnik dobija startni broj sa čipom, unikatnu majicu i medalju, kao i osveženje tokom i nakon trke.

name: First Challenge Run
description: First Challenge Run je humanitarna trka koja se održava 10. maja 2026. godine na Adi Ciganliji u Beogradu. Trkači će istrčati krug oko jezera dužine 7,7 km, uživajući u prirodi i sportskom izazovu. Ova trka je prilika za okupljanje, druženje i podršku humanitarnom cilju, pogodna kako za iskusne trkače, tako i za početnike.

name: Ugrin run
description: Ugrin run je trka koja se održava u Ugrinovcima 10. maja 2026. godine sa startom u 10 časova. Trka nudi dve distance, 5 km i 10 km, koje vode kroz maksimalno prohodnu, bezbednu i jasno obeleženu stazu sa dve okrepe sa vodom i voćem. Pored glavnih trka, organizovane su i revijalne dečije trke za različite uzraste, koje su besplatne uz saglasnost roditelja. Učesnici dobijaju unikatnu medalju na cilju, a za najbolje su obezbeđene robne nagrade i pehari.

name: Kozomor 2026
description: Planinarsko trkačko udruženje Kozomor i Komisija za planinarski treking PSS pozivaju takmičare na drugo kolo Treking i trejl lige Srbije koje će se održati 10. maja 2026. godine u Kosjeriću. Ova trka okuplja zaljubljenike u planinski treking i trail trčanje, pružajući izazovnu i atraktivnu stazu kroz prirodu. Učesnici mogu očekivati dobro organizovanu manifestaciju sa podrškom iskusnih planinarskih i trkačkih entuzijasta.

name: 1ο Φάλανθος Trail
description: Ο Φάλανθος Trail είναι ο πρώτος ορεινός αγώνας τρεξίματος στο Μαίναλο, που διοργανώνεται από τον Σύλλογο Αρκάδων Ορειβατών Οικολόγων. Ο αγώνας αναδεικνύει το πλούσιο φυσικό και πολιτιστικό περιβάλλον της ορεινής Αρκαδίας, προωθώντας την προστασία της βιοποικιλότητας και του τοπίου. Η διαδρομή εκμεταλλεύεται το εκτεταμένο δίκτυο μονοπατιών του Μαινάλου, προσφέροντας μια μοναδική εμπειρία σε δρομείς και πεζοπόρους. Ο Φάλανθος Trail 29km αποτελεί επίσημο κριτήριο για τον Olympus Marathon, επιβεβαιώνοντας την ποιότητα και το κύρος του αγώνα.

name: 15ος Ιπποκράτειος Αγώνας Δρόμου
description: The 15th Hippocratic Road Race is a popular running event held in the city of Larissa, with a 10 km race, a 3 km Fun Run, and a 1,000-meter children’s race. The 10 km course is paved, with no significant uphill sections, and passes along the bed of the Peneus River and by city monuments, offering runners a beautiful experience. The race has a family-friendly character, and minors may participate under their parents’ responsibility. Participants receive a technical T-shirt, electronic timing, a commemorative medal, and water.
course_highlights: Paved course with no significant uphill sections
Route along the bed of the Peneus River
Passes by monuments in the city of Larissa
additional: Participant benefits: technical T-shirt, electronic timing, commemorative medal, and water. A parental or guardian declaration of responsibility is required for minors. Start and finish at the Ancient Theatre of Larissa. The children’s race is free to enter, with commemorative medals for all finishers.

name: 1ο Kotroni Trail
description: The 1st Kotroni Trail Run is a new mountain running event held in Kapandriti, Attica. It features 20 km, 12 km and 5 km routes, with natural trails, forest roads and varied terrain, offering an authentic trail running experience. The event also includes a 1 km children’s race, making it accessible to everyone. The start and finish are at the Kapandriti indoor gymnasium, and the route is marked and supported by volunteers. The event welcomes hundreds of runners and mountain running enthusiasts, creating a festive atmosphere with music and traditional dancing.
course_highlights: 20 km, 12 km and 5 km routes featuring natural trails and forest roads
A cleared and marked route with refreshment points
Lush vegetation and varied terrain (dirt, rocks, streams)
additional: The start and finish are at the Kapandriti indoor gymnasium. There is a 1 km children’s race, with more than 40 children taking part. The event includes a pre-pasta party and a music stage featuring The Retro Sofa. The total entry limit is 400 participants, with 100 places for the 20 km and 300 for the 12 km and 5 km races. Group entries are available for teams of more than 10 people. The routes include trail running and paths, with an emphasis on nature conservation and cultural heritage. The event also includes cultural and environmental activities, as well as a 1 km children’s race.

name: 3ο Koziakas Trail
description: The 3rd Koziakas Trail is a mountain race held in the beautiful village of Elati, Trikala, with distances of 25.75 km, 8 km, and 1 km for young athletes. The course starts and finishes in Elati, crossing fir forests and the alpine landscapes of Koziakas. The race is dedicated to the conservation of the Egyptian vulture, an endangered bird species in Greece. The area is a popular mountain tourism destination with many natural and cultural attractions. This year, the event is included in the ITRA listings, giving the race international recognition.
course_highlights: Routes through beautiful fir forests
Alpine landscapes of Mount Koziakas
Start and finish in Elati, Trikala
additional: Trail races of 25.75 km, 8 km, and 1 km for children; part of ITRA; natural landscapes, bird conservation, and environmental awareness.

name: 5ο Koutouki Trail Run
organizer: Δήμος Παιανίας, Σύνδεσμος Προστασίας & Ανάπτυξης Υμηττού (ΣΠΑΥ)
description: The 5th Koutouki Trail Run in Paiania offers scenic dirt trails on Mount Hymettus, with 10 km and 1 km options. The event welcomes hundreds of runners who enjoy the natural surroundings and beauty of the mountain. It is ideal for runners of all levels looking for a distinctive trail-running experience in a friendly, well-organized setting.
course_highlights: Dirt trails on Mount Hymettus
Scenic natural surroundings
10 km and 1 km options
additional: The event includes two distances, 10 km and 1 km, on dirt trails on Mount Hymettus. No information was found about prices, start times, or registration. Course details: approximately 10,000 m, on trails and forest roads. Difficulty: moderate, with small elevation changes. Water and first-aid stations are provided. Volunteers will monitor the course, and there will be a 1,000 m children's race. Participation also includes exercises and kilometers on trails and “χιλιόχρονα”.

name: 9ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Ιωαννίνων
description: The 9th Ioannina Half Marathon is a distinctive road race held around Lake Pamvotida and the historic center of the city of Ioannina. It offers races for everyone, from the 21 km half marathon to 10 km and 5 km races, a 1 km children’s race, and a 1 km race for people with disabilities. The event is dynamic and comprehensive, attracting many participants and featuring strong performances, establishing it as an important event in the Greek running scene. The races take place on May 15 and 16, 2027, with starts and finishes on the city’s lakeside.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Pamvotida
Passes through the historic center of Ioannina
Lakeside scenery with beautiful views
additional: The 1 km children’s race takes place on 15/05/2027 at 17:00 for children aged 3–12, with free registration and limited places. There are also 10 km and 5 km races and a 1 km race for people with disabilities, with specific start times. The event includes refreshment stations and is supported by volunteers. Late registration is available for a limited period before the race. The event is supported by the Municipality of Ioannina and the Region of Epirus, and includes activities and events in the city, attracting runners and visitors from all over Greece.

name: 9ος Λαϊκός Δρόμος «Παναγιώτης Αφαλής»
description: The 9th Panagiotis Afalis Community Road Race in Neapoli, Thessaloniki, is an annual sporting event that promotes sports and community participation. The race offers runners of all ages the opportunity to enjoy a route through the city, fostering community spirit and healthy living. The event is named after Panagiotis Afalis, honoring his memory and contribution to the local community. The Municipality of Neapoli-Sykies actively supports the event, providing a well-organized and welcoming sporting experience.
course_highlights: A route through the city of Neapoli, Thessaloniki
Welcoming to runners of all levels
Organizational support from the Municipality of Neapoli-Sykies
additional: The event includes running and walking in Neapoli, Thessaloniki, with participation from organizations and clubs, and requires a signed registration form. It is held with safety measures and medical support, and includes traffic interruptions and bus diversions.

name: 10ο Panorama Charity Fun Run «Μελίνα Λαζαρίδου»
description: The 10th Panorama Charity Fun Run “Melina Lazaridou” is a charity road race organized by the Municipality of Pylaia-Chortiatis in collaboration with SEGAS and the “Panorama Lions” sports club. The event features three routes—10 km, 5 km, and 2 km—through the streets of Panorama, finishing at the Olympic Sports Center. The race has a charitable purpose, with proceeds going to charitable associations and organizations. Everyone is welcome to take part, and runners of all ages turn out in large numbers, creating a celebration of sport and solidarity.
course_highlights: Three routes: 10 km, 5 km, and 2 km
Routes through the streets of Panorama
Finish at the Olympic Sports Center
additional: The event is supported by SEGAS and the “Panorama Lions” sports club. Proceeds go to charitable associations such as the Northern Greece Parents’ Association of Children with Neoplastic Diseases “Lampsi,” the Friends of Papageorgiou Hospital Association “Antirida,” and “SOS Children’s Village Filyro.” Registration is available online or in person at the Panorama Olympic Sports Center every day from 17:00 and on weekends from 11:00. Routes with special traffic arrangements, participation open to all ages, proceeds for charitable causes, collaboration with SEGAS and local clubs.

name: «Τρέξε για τη ζωή» για τη γιορτή της Μητέρας
description: “Run for Life” is a sporting event organized by Lesvos Runners in Mytilene to mark Mother’s Day. It’s a day full of energy, smiles, and love, where runners and walkers are invited to join a large group at Tsamakia Grove. The event is open to everyone, regardless of ability, and promotes well-being and social participation through sport.
course_highlights: Route through Tsamakia Grove in Mytilene
Friendly, family-oriented setting for runners and walkers
Event dedicated to Mother’s Day
additional: The event takes place at Tsamakia Grove, starting at 11:00 a.m. No specific distances or categories are listed; participation is encouraged for everyone, regardless of ability. The event has a friendly, social character and celebrates Mother’s Day. It includes running or walking, with the aim of promoting health and the local community, and takes place on the Tsamakia pedestrian path on May 16, 2027.

name: Kassios Dias
description: Kassios Dias is a challenging technical mountain race held on the trails of northeastern Corfu, offering two distances of 25 and 12 kilometers. The routes pass through traditional semi-mountainous villages and the unique ecosystem of Erimitis, a protected NATURA area, combining mountain scenery with coastal beauty. The 25 km route passes caves and peaks with panoramic views, while the 1,200 m children’s race gives children the chance to experience the joy of running. The race is organized by the Kassios Dias Running and Hiking Association to promote sports and volunteerism.
course_highlights: 25 km route with +1,300 m of elevation gain, passing through the Peristerograva Cave
Passage through the protected NATURA ecosystem of Erimitis
Panoramic views from the summit of Matagonas (640 m elevation)
additional: Race-bib collection and new in-person registrations take place on Thursday and Saturday in Corfu and Kassiopi, as well as on race day before the start. The start and finish are at Kassiopi Harbor. A pre-race meal (Pasta Party) is held on Saturday. Registration is not required for the 1,200 m children’s race. Car access to Kassiopi Harbor on race day is limited due to traffic restrictions. Paid private parking is available, along with free parking spaces on a nearby peripheral road. On-site registration is also available, and the event offers accommodation and transport options to make participation convenient for runners. The area is a popular summer destination with easy access via the airport, road networks, and ferries.

name: Kifissia Runners In The Night
description: Kifissia Runners in the Night is an exciting 5-kilometer night race held in the center of Kifissia, starting and finishing at the Zirineio Municipal Stadium. Now in its fourth year, the event offers a unique running experience along the city’s illuminated streets, welcoming summer with a major celebration of sport. The race is organized by the Municipality of Kifissia in cooperation with the Region of Attica and is aimed at runners looking for a lively, energetic night route.
course_highlights: 5 km night race in the center of Kifissia
Start and finish at the Zirineio Municipal Stadium
Route along the city’s main streets, which are illuminated
additional: The race includes chip timing and a race number sent by email. Volunteers can take part and support the event. Registration and volunteer options are available. It is a major celebration of sport in the heart of Kifissia, with runners of all ages and abilities taking part.

name: Megalopolis Theater Run
description: The Megalopolis Theater Run is a road race held in Megalopolis, Arcadia, dedicated to the city’s ancient theater, the largest theater in the ancient Greek world. The race includes a 10 km route with a newly updated course, as well as 5 km and 1 km routes for everyone, offering a unique running experience in a historic setting. The organizers invite runners and volunteers to take part and embrace this celebration of sport and culture. The race is organized by the Municipality of Megalopolis in cooperation with the Peloponnese Region and the Arcadia Chamber of Commerce.
course_highlights: 10 km route with a newly updated course
5 km and 1 km routes for everyone
Dedicated to the ancient theater of Megalopolis, the largest ancient theater
additional: A volunteer program is available for residents and anyone interested. The race is organized by the Municipality of Megalopolis in cooperation with the Peloponnese Region and the Arcadia Chamber of Commerce. The event includes multiple routes, registration for runners and volunteers, and takes place at a historic site dedicated to ancient Greek theater.

name: Sohos Mountain Games
organizer: Αθλητικός Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος «Σώκος Ερμής» και Τοπική Κοινότητα Σοχού
description: The Sohos Mountain Games are the largest mountain running race held in Sochos, Thessaloniki, offering an unforgettable trail-running experience amid natural beauty and a variety of routes. Participants can choose from 30km, 10km, 5km, and a 1-mile route for children, with all races starting and finishing in the central square of Sochos. The race combines sport, local tradition, and a social gathering, with a party, DJ, and traditional kourbani after the finish. It is a celebration for all runners, from elite athletes to families and children.
course_highlights: 30km route with 1,300m of elevation gain, moderate difficulty
10km route with 520m of elevation gain, moderate difficulty
5km Fun Run around Sochos, suitable for everyone
additional: All races start from the central square of Sochos. Race amenities include a technical T-shirt, Buff, Pre-Race Pasta Party, race bib, electronic timing, finisher’s medal, full refreshments, medical services, a traditional after-race meal, and an electronic participation certificate. There is also a big celebration with a DJ and traditional kourbani after the race. A discounted package is available for unemployed people, university students, school students, people with disabilities, and members of the Armed Forces and Security Forces. The event includes multiple trail routes, post-race activities, a party, free transport for early registrations, and a warm welcome.

name: 26ος Ευχίδειος Άθλος
description: The Euhideios Athlos is a historic ultradistance race that crosses the region between Delphi and Plataea, honoring the feat of the long-distance messenger Euchidas. Runners pass through historic battlefields and natural landscapes, with routes featuring uphill stretches on Mount Helicon and panoramic views of the Gulf of Corinth. The race offers a unique experience combining sport, history, and culture, with starts and finishes at significant historic sites. The event includes three ultradistance routes, covering different levels of difficulty and distance.
course_highlights: 107.5 km route from Plataea to Delphi, passing historic battlefields
Climbs on mythical Mount Helicon with panoramic views of the Gulf of Corinth
A short 5 km section on a dirt road along the Mornos Canal
additional: The 215 km Euhideios Ultra-Athlos starts at 07:00. A pasta party and technical briefing are held the previous day. The route is mainly paved, except for a short 5 km dirt-road section. There are checkpoints and aid stations along the route. After the finish, a Delphic Light lighting ceremony, awards ceremony, and reception take place at the European Cultural Centre of Delphi. The event features multiple routes, historical and cultural significance, and a focus on showcasing the area’s natural beauty. Registration usually opens in late October or early November.

name: Business Run Varna
description: IHB Business Run Varna is the largest team-building race in Bulgaria, held at the BulYard shipyard and Bulport Logistics in Varna. It is a relay race for teams of four, with each participant running 4 km before passing the baton to the next runner. The event combines sporting spirit and corporate teamwork, bringing together many companies and their employees in a dynamic, friendly format. In addition to the main race, there is also a Kids Run for children aged 4 to 12, supported by certified coaches.

name: EcoRun Moieciu ~ 2026
description: EcoRun Moieciu este un eveniment de alergare montană de top în România, ce se desfășoară în Moieciu de Sus. Concursul include curse de Maraton, Semi și Cros, precum și o cursă pentru copii, EcoKids. Traseele sunt compuse în proporție de 90% din drumuri forestiere și poteci montane, oferind o experiență autentică de alergare în natură, cu peisaje spectaculoase și o comunitate pasionată. Evenimentul promovează practici sustenabile și se desfășoară anual în luna mai, reunind alergători de toate nivelurile.

name: Turnu Roșu Challenge
description: Turnu Roșu Challenge este o competiție de alergare submontană ce se desfășoară pe poteci marcate în Turnu Roșu și pe dealurile de la poalele Munților Făgăraș, oferind un cadru natural spectaculos și o provocare pentru toate nivelurile de pregătire. Evenimentul include trei curse: semimaraton de 21 km, cros de 11 km și hiking de 7 km, fiecare adaptat pentru diferite tipuri de participanți, de la experimentați la cei care doresc o experiență relaxantă. Organizatorii pun accent pe siguranță, recuperare și socializare, oferind facilități precum sesiuni de stretching, masaj post-alergare, camping și activități pentru copii. Este o ocazie excelentă de a te bucura de natură, sport și comunitate în județul Sibiu.

name: Crosul Cetăților Suceava
description: Crosul Cetăților Suceava este o cursă de alergare populară ce se desfășoară în orașul Suceava, oferind participanților o experiență sportivă în aer liber, cu trasee adaptate pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile de pregătire. Evenimentul include curse pentru copii, o cursă populară și o cursă de cros, promovând mișcarea și spiritul comunitar. Participanții pot alerga pe trasee ce trec prin zone istorice și pitorești, înconjurate de cetăți și peisaje locale. Organizatorii asigură un kit de participare și premii pentru concurenți, încurajând implicarea și performanța sportivă.

name: Run to the Hills
description: Run To The Hills este o cursă de alergare montană organizată în Crasna, Jud. Sălaj, care are loc pe 16 mai 2026. Evenimentul invită pasionații de alergare să exploreze dealurile pitorești din zonă, oferind o experiență sportivă în natură. Este o oportunitate excelentă pentru alergători de toate nivelurile să se bucure de peisaje frumoase și de o atmosferă prietenoasă.

name: SEMIMARATON FETESTI
description: Semimaratonul Fetești este un eveniment sportiv anual care aduce împreună alergători din regiune pentru curse de diferite distanțe, inclusiv semimaraton și crosuri. Organizatorii, Asociația Sportivă Feteștiul Aleargă, promovează sportul și sănătatea în comunitate, oferind o experiență plăcută și competitivă. Evenimentul are o tradiție în zonă și se desfășoară pe trasee variate, potrivite pentru toate nivelurile de alergători.

name: Nebeski visovi – 4. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: Trka Nebeski visovi na Zlatiboru predstavlja četvrto kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju, organizovanu od strane Planinarskog kluba Tornik iz Čajetine. Učesnici mogu birati između dve kružne staze: duže crvene staze od 21 km sa 1400 metara uspona namenjene seniorima i kraće plave staze od 10 km sa 500 metara uspona za juniore. Staze vode kroz netaknutu prirodu Zlatibora, prolazeći preko vrhova Ljujaš, Orlić, Jelova gora, Bandera-Tornik i Liska, pružajući atraktivne i divlje predele. Trka okuplja takmičare iz cele Srbije i inostranstva, a bodovanje u Nacionalnoj seriji je regulisano pravilima Planinarskog saveza Srbije, koji je član Svetske asocijacije za planinsko trčanje.

name: Nebeski visovi 2026
description: Planinarski klub "Tornik" iz Čajetine i Planinarski savez Srbije pozivaju vas da učestvujete u nezaboravnoj skajrejs trci "Nebeski visovi" na bajkovitom Zlatiboru u selu Jablanica. Ova trka je prva u godini u okviru nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju pri Planinarskom savezu Srbije i namenjena je sportistima, rekreativcima i ljubiteljima prirode. Trka nudi dve kružne staze sa startom i ciljem kod škole u centru sela Jablanica, koje prolaze kroz predele sa spektakularnim pogledima. Učesnici mogu birati između crvene staze od 21 km sa 1400 m kumulativnog uspona i plave staze od 10 km sa 500 m uspona.

location: Κεντρική Πλατεία Πύργου, Πύργος, Ηλεία, Greece

description: The 5th “5ο RUN PYRGOU” road race in Pyrgos, Elis, offers a celebration of sport for all ages, with 5 km, 2 km, 1 km and 500 m routes. The start and finish are at Pyrgos Central Square, with categories for adults and children, as well as special categories for people with disabilities. The race is co-organized by Pirgos AthleticEvents and the Municipality of Pyrgos, with the aim of promoting exercise and participation by the local community. The event awards medals and cups to category winners, creating a friendly and encouraging atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: 5 km, 2 km, 1 km and 500 m routes at Pyrgos Central Square
Categories for all ages, from toddlers to adults, as well as people with disabilities
Start and finish at the central square, in an urban setting
additional: Medals are awarded to the first three finishers in each category, and cups to the overall category winners. Minors aged 15–18 may participate with parental consent. All routes start at Pyrgos Central Square at different times between 18:30 and 20:30. The race is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Pyrgos and includes various routes and categories for all ages and athletic levels. Participation promotes health and well-being, while electronic timing and results make it easier to track runners’ performance.

name: 8ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Κάστρου Διδυμοτείχου «Κώστας Γκατσιούδης»
description: The 8th Didymoteicho Castle Road Race “Kostas Gatsioudis” is an annual road race held in Didymoteicho. It includes 10 km, 5 km and 1 km races, a race for people with disabilities, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. The race began in 2016 on the initiative of military personnel, with the support of the Municipality of Didymoteicho and the Division. It is an important sporting and cultural event for the area, honoring the memory of Kostas Gatsioudis.
course_highlights: 10 km, 5 km and 1 km races, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay
Includes a race for people with disabilities
Takes place at the historic Didymoteicho Castle
additional: The event honors the memory of Kostas Gatsioudis and General Charalambos Lalousis, and includes celebratory events. The course passes through the city’s historic castle, and participation is open to everyone, with registration via Google Form.

name: Ποσειδώνια
organizer: Δήμος Πόρου, Γυμναστική Ένωση Πόρου Τροιζηνίας

description: The Poseidonia races in Poros are a popular running event that attracts more than 900 runners from across Greece and abroad. They are organized by the Municipality of Poros and the Gymnastics Association of Poros Troizinia, offering races over different distances on the picturesque island of Poros. The event includes courses ranging from 300 meters to 10 kilometers, with electronic timing and free participation in all events. After the races, participants are treated to a free Pasta Party, creating a friendly and festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Courses from 300 m to 10,000 m on a picturesque island
Electronic timing for athletes in the 5 km and 10 km races
Free Pasta Party after the races
additional: Registration includes a race T-shirt, a bottle of water, a banana, electronic timing, and a commemorative medal. Athletes traveling from Piraeus and Aegina receive a 50% discount on ferry tickets. The race office is open on Friday afternoon and Saturday morning for collecting race bibs, bags, and T-shirts. Travel to Poros is available by road and ferry. The event includes road races and mountain running, children’s races and family activities, with electronic timing and events for everyone.

name: Goulinas Trail
description: The Goulinas Trail mountain running race is held in the area of Spercheiada, Phthiotis, with the aim of showcasing the region through sport and a love of nature. It includes three routes of different lengths and elevation gains, offering an unforgettable experience to all participants. The start and finish are in Spercheiada’s central square, and the race emphasizes protecting the natural environment and sustainability. The event promotes fair play, cooperation, and a healthy lifestyle through sport.
course_highlights: Three routes: 6 km, 12 km, and 30 km, with elevation gains of 220 m, 700 m, and 2,000 m, respectively
Start and finish in Spercheiada’s Central Square
A nature-sensitive setting, with an emphasis on protection and a low environmental footprint
additional: All routes start and finish in Spercheiada’s Central Square. The 30 km race has a 7-hour finish time limit and an intermediate cutoff at 12.5 km, at 2 hours and 45 minutes. The race is environmentally friendly, with measures to reduce its impact on the natural environment. It includes different routes focused on nature and adventure, and offers information about accommodation and registration.

name: ApriltsiRun
location: Априлци, Община Априлци, гр. Априлци, кв. "Острец, ул. "Цанко Дюстабанов" 12
organizer: Община Априлци, Сдружение „Троян в бъдещето“, НД „Традиция“ – 34-ти Пехотен Троянски полк
description: ApriltsiRun is a mountain race inspired by the heroic events of the April Uprising of 1876. The race follows historic trails around Maragidik Peak and Botev Peak, along which the insurgents traveled 150 years ago. The courses offer varying levels of difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain-running enthusiasts. The event combines sport, nature, and history, marking the anniversary of the uprising with panoramic routes and a charitable cause.

name: Маратон Варна
description: Varna Marathon is one of the most exciting sporting events in the maritime capital, combining challenge, emotion, and unforgettable moments. The course runs along Varna’s beautiful coastline, offering fresh air and picturesque views of the sea. The event attracts both local and international athletes, creating an atmosphere of sporting passion and support. Varna Marathon is a test of endurance and strength of spirit that inspires participants to achieve new personal goals.

name: Маратон на приятелството Плевен
description: The Friendship Marathon Pleven is a traditional event taking place on May 17, 2026, in the center of Pleven. The race includes a marathon, half marathon, 10.55 km race, relay, and the Vidas Run Kids children’s marathon. The certified courses pass through scenic parts of the city and Kaylaka Park. The event combines sport with a charitable cause supporting medical students. Organizers provide aid stations, medical services, and a full program for race day.

name: Спици и Бодли 2026
description: Spokes and Thorns 2026 is a cross-country mountain biking and duathlon event held at the foot of the Stara Planina Mountains near Kazanlak. The event offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both beginner and advanced cyclists. In addition to the sporting competition, participants and guests can enjoy a festival featuring live music, outdoor cinema, yoga, horseback riding, and other activities. The event combines sport, entertainment, and community in an unforgettable atmosphere.

name: Timotion
price_range: Participație între 75 RON și 1.200 RON, în funcție de cursă
