description: Timotion is the largest charitable sporting event in western Romania, bringing together thousands of participants, volunteers, and supporters each year to run, cycle, and do good for the community. The event offers a variety of races for all ages and fitness levels, from cycling and a half marathon to children’s races and fun races on wheels. By taking part, runners and cyclists support community projects and help foster solidarity and hope in the region. Timotion is a movement of hearts united for good, with a tradition spanning more than 10 years and a continuously growing community.
course_highlights: The timed 15 km SMW cycling race is for experienced participants
A 21 km half marathon and 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km fun runs for various age categories
Special races for children and fun races on wheels, also accessible to people with reduced mobility
additional: Races are timed and have specific time limits; children’s races require a legal guardian to accompany participants; the cycling race is for non-electric bicycles; accessible races are available for people with reduced mobility; races take place on Bd. Ion C. Brătianu; races start in waves between 08:00 and 17:30. Multiple races on May 10, including cycling, a half marathon, and recreational races; fundraising component; volunteering opportunities

name: Accenture Heroes Challenge
description: Accenture Heroes Challenge este o competiție intensă de teste de forță, viteză, agilitate și skill-uri, desfășurată în Parcul Sportiv Universitar Iuliu Hațieganu din Cluj-Napoca. Ediția a doua, programată pentru 17 mai 2026, provoacă participanții să își depășească limitele printr-un traseu cu obstacole. Evenimentul oferă două distanțe, 6 km și 12 km, pentru a satisface atât alergătorii experimentați, cât și pe cei care doresc o provocare mai scurtă.

name: Crosul Sport4All
description: Crosul Sport 4 all este un eveniment sportiv de alergare organizat anual la Lugoj, destinat tuturor vârstelor și nivelurilor de pregătire. Evenimentul include curse ne-cronometrate pentru copii și cursa populară de 2 km, precum și curse cronometrate de 4 km și 6 km pentru participanții mai mari. Traseele sunt bucle în jurul Universității Europene Drăgan și pe străzile centrale ale orașului, oferind o experiență urbană plăcută. Participanții primesc medalii de participare, iar cursele sunt organizate cu categorii de vârstă pentru cursele cronometrate. Evenimentul este susținut de Primăria Lugoj și Universitatea Europeană Drăgan, cu 400 de locuri gratuite oferite de sponsorul Mondial S.A.

name: MARATONUL NISIPULUI Run&Fun
description: Maratonul Nisipului Run & Fun, ce va avea loc pe 17 mai 2026 la Plaja Zoom Beach din Constanța, este un eveniment sportiv care combină competiția cu distracția și promovarea unui stil de viață sănătos. Evenimentul oferă șase curse variate, de la maratonul de 42 km până la alergări recreative pentru întreaga familie, desfășurate pe nisipul litoralului românesc. Participanții se pot bucura de trasee spectaculoase cu briza mării, într-o atmosferă plină de energie și comunitate. Maratonul este o sărbătoare a mișcării, naturii și aventurii, adresată atât alergătorilor profesioniști, cât și amatorilor.

name: Prima Evadare
description: Prima Evadare este cel mai mare maraton de ciclism cross country din România, desfășurat anual pe un traseu clasic între București și Snagov. Concursul oferă o experiență prietenoasă și accesibilă, cu o distanță de aproximativ 55 km prin păduri și drumuri de țară, fără diferențe mari de nivel. Evenimentul adună pasionați de ciclism din toată țara, oferind o atmosferă energică și prietenoasă, ideală pentru deschiderea sezonului de maratoane MTB.

name: Somborski polumaraton
description: Somborski polumaraton je tradicionalna trka koja se održava u Somboru, sa novom trasom koja prolazi kroz prelepe delove grada. Ova manifestacija okuplja veliki broj trkača iz zemlje i inostranstva, promovišući zdrav način života i rekreativno trčanje. Organizatori se trude da trka bude dobro organizovana i prijatna za sve učesnike, sa posebnom pažnjom na atmosferu i druženje. Trka je deo bogatog programa aktivnosti Atletsko rekreativnog kluba Somaraton, koji neguje dugogodišnju tradiciju trčanja u Somboru.

name: 6ο City Trail Αγρίνιο
description: Ο 6ος City Trail Αγρινίου είναι ένας αγώνας δρόμου 16,4 χιλιομέτρων που διοργανώνεται από τον Σύλλογο Δρομέων Υγείας Αγρινίου σε συνεργασία με τον Δήμο Αγρινίου. Ο αγώνας πραγματοποιείται στα πλαίσια των εκδηλώσεων για τον εορτασμό του πολιούχου Αγίου Χριστοφόρου, με αφετηρία και τερματισμό την κεντρική πλατεία Δημοκρατίας της πόλης. Παράλληλα, την ίδια μέρα διεξάγονται και αγώνες 6 χλμ. και 1 χλμ. για μικρότερους δρομείς. Η διαδρομή περιλαμβάνει μονοπάτια και χωματόδρομους εντός του δασυλλίου Αγίου Χριστοφόρου και του Παπαστράτειου Δημοτικού Πάρκου, με σηματοδότηση για την ασφάλεια των συμμετεχόντων.

name: 13ο Paggaio Trail Run
description: Ο 13ος Paggaio Trail Run διοργανώνεται από τον Ελληνικό Ορειβατικό Σύλλογο Καβάλας και προσφέρει δύο αγώνες ορεινού τρεξίματος: έναν απαιτητικό αγώνα 27 χιλιομέτρων για έμπειρους δρομείς και έναν αγώνα 10 χιλιομέτρων για λιγότερο έμπειρους. Οι διαδρομές ξεκινούν και τερματίζουν στο χωριό Δωμάτια, στους πρόποδες του Παγγαίου, και διασχίζουν μονοπάτια, δασικούς δρόμους και λίγα μέτρα άσφαλτου. Το όρος Παγγαίο προσφέρει μοναδικά φυσικά τοπία και μια αξέχαστη εμπειρία σε όσους αγαπούν το ορεινό τρέξιμο. Η διοργάνωση καλωσορίζει τόσο έμπειρους όσο και νέους δρομείς να ανακαλύψουν τις ομορφιές της περιοχής μέσα από τον αγώνα.

name: 1ο «Το Καλωσόρισμα των Πελαργών»
description: The 1st “Welcoming the Storks” road race in Aiginio, Pieria, is a spring sports celebration held under the auspices of the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros. The event includes 11-kilometer and 5-kilometer races, as well as a 1,000-meter children’s race, offering athletes and visitors an opportunity to take part. The welcoming town of the Storks welcomes runners on a route that combines natural beauty and sporting spirit, promoting mass participation in sports and helping participants discover the region.
course_highlights: 11-kilometer race: Kolindros–Katachas–Aiginio route
5-kilometer race: circular route in Aiginio
1,000-meter children’s race: circular route in Aiginio
additional: The event takes place as part of the 1st Stork Festival and includes sports activities aimed at promoting mass participation in sports and helping participants discover the region. The event is supported by local clubs and organizations. Races for different levels and age groups; event on May 23, 2027; accompanying activities and environmental awareness.

name: 4ος Axios Running Festival
description: The Axios Running Festival is a multi-day sporting and cultural celebration held in the Axios Valley, offering a unique experience for runners of all ages and abilities. The event includes 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 1-mile road races, with certified courses and accompanying social, cultural, and environmental events. The race combines sport, tourism, and history, showcasing the region and supporting the local community. The event is held under the auspices of the Region of Central Macedonia and follows World Athletics regulations.
course_highlights: Half marathon starting at the Koufalia Town Hall and finishing at the Balkan Wars Military Museum
Courses that cross the Axios Valley, the Axios Dam, and the old Thessaloniki–Evzoni National Road
Courses certified in accordance with World Athletics regulations
additional: The race is held on the first Sunday of April each year (in this case, May 23, 2027) and forms part of a two-day, wide-ranging experience featuring environmental, cultural, and social events. Participation certificates can be printed for all distances. The event provides high-quality safety and support services for runners of all ages and abilities. It includes road races, health activities, and a walk, with an emphasis on environmental awareness.

name: 5ο Belles Historic Trail
description: The Belles Historic Trail is a distinctive mountain-running event that combines the natural beauty and historical memory of the Neou Petritsi area in Serres. The routes cross trails rich in natural vegetation, historic forts, and offer magnificent panoramic views, providing a unique experience for runners of all levels. The event includes races of different distances, from 1 km for children to 22.66 km for experienced athletes, with a welcoming atmosphere and local delicacies at the finish. Belles Historic Trail is a celebration of sport, culture, and nature that brings the community and visitors together.
course_highlights: Routes on trails with abundant natural vegetation and waterfalls
Historic forts and trails of the Battle of the Forts (1941)
Panoramic views of Lake Kerkini and Mount Belles
additional: Electronic timing with prompt, reliable results. Refreshment stations along the routes. Commemorative gifts for all athletes (windbreaker jacket, buff, socks). Medical coverage throughout the races. Traditional local delicacies at the finish. Children’s races on Sunday at 11:30. Race office and packet pickup on race day from 10:00 to 14:00 and 16:00 to 17:30. The event includes trail and on-road races for children and athletes of different levels, and offers medals and local cuisine to participants.

description: The 5th Godzilla Xanthi Trail is a challenging mountain race held in Xanthi, offering three different routes of 30 km, 14 km, and 7 km. The 30 km route features technical trails and significant elevation gain, while the shorter routes suit runners with different experience levels, with the 7 km route serving as an ideal introduction to mountain running. The race is organized by the Xanthi Runners Athletic Club in collaboration with the Municipality of Xanthi and the Region of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace, offering a unique sporting experience amid the area's natural surroundings.
course_highlights: 30 km route with 28 km of trails and 1,850 m of elevation gain
14 km route with 12 km of trails and 600 m of elevation gain
Easy, circular 7 km route, ideal as an introduction to mountain running
additional: The start and finish are at Thilia. Awards ceremonies take place at 11:30 for the 7 km race and at 14:30 for the 30 km and 14 km races. A volunteer follows the last runners to provide support. Bib pickup is at Xanthi's central square on the Saturday before the race and from early morning on race day at the start area. Group registration is available for clubs and groups of runners. There are three routes of varying difficulty, with the start and finish in the Ilia area, full refreshments, and awards. The 30 km route is particularly challenging and technical, suitable for experienced runners.

name: 6ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Φαλανναίων
description: The 6th Falannai Road Race is a sporting event held in Falani, Larissa, offering an opportunity to take part in a road race that promotes mass participation in sports and a healthy lifestyle. The race is organized by the Thessaloniki Health Runners’ Association, an organization with a long tradition of supporting runners, mountaineers, and cyclists. The event emphasizes social responsibility, solidarity, and a love of nature, fostering sportsmanship and a community of sports enthusiasts. The race is a celebration for runners and sports enthusiasts in the area.
course_highlights: 21.1 km, 5 km, and 1 km routes for children and people with disabilities
In collaboration with the Municipality of Larissa and local organizations
Focus on social cohesion and volunteerism
additional: An event featuring 21.1 km and 5 km routes, as well as a 1 km route for children and people with disabilities, in collaboration with the Municipality of Larissa and local organizations

name: 8ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Ειρήνης «Γρηγόρης Λαμπράκης»
description: The 8th Grigoris Lambrakis Peace Run is a 23-kilometer road race organized by the Arcadia Peace Committee in honor of Grigoris Lambrakis, a peace activist and martyr. The race takes place in Tripoli and follows routes connecting the city with areas such as Agios Sostis, Episkopi, Alea, and Kerasista. Participation is free, and the race is part of the Arcadia Peace Committee’s annual sporting events. It is an event with historical and social significance that honors the memory and work of Grigoris Lambrakis.
course_highlights: A 23-kilometer route from Tripoli to Agios Sostis, Episkopi, Alea, and Kerasista, and back to Tripoli
Areas of historical and natural interest in Arcadia
A race centered on the birthplace of Grigoris Lambrakis
additional: Participation in the race is free. It is organized by the Arcadia Peace Committee and is part of the committee’s annual sporting events. The 2026 race was scheduled for Sunday, May 17, at 18:00 in Tripoli. Routes through various parts of Tripoli, participation by the Arcadia Peace Committee, a historical and social context, and references to previous editions.

name: 13ος Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμους «Γεώργιος Αποστολάκης»
description: The 13th Popular Road Race “Georgios Apostolakis” is held in Nea Chalkidona in honor of the late Mayor Giorgos Apostolakis, who left an indelible mark on the local community. The race attracts many participants and is a celebration of sport and local tradition. The event honors his contribution and love of sport, while promoting social cohesion and health through physical activity.
course_highlights: 1,000 m and 10,000 m routes in an urban setting
Organized by GEORGIOS APOSTOLAKIS PARK
Includes road races and gymnastics for all ages
additional: 1,000 m and 10,000 m routes, age categories, road races and gymnastics, date: 23/05/2027

name: 22ος Δρόμος Θυσίας
description: The 22nd Sacrifice Road Race in Naousa is a running event honoring the historic heroic city and its unique traditions. The course gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the natural surroundings of Mount Vermio and the area’s rich cultural heritage. With its beautiful trails and welcoming atmosphere, Naousa is an ideal destination for runners of all ages and abilities. The race combines athletic challenge with historical remembrance and local hospitality.
course_highlights: A course at the foothills of Mount Vermio
Passing by Naousa’s historic and cultural landmarks
Natural surroundings with fresh air and beautiful trails
additional: Naousa offers welcoming accommodation and local cuisine featuring Xinomavro wine and traditional dishes. The area is accessible by road from Thessaloniki, 90 km away, and is suitable for family excursions and adventures in nature. The event emphasizes historical remembrance, with online and in-person registration, and medals and commemorative gifts for all runners.

name: Dental Run
organizer: Athens Dental Students' Association, Greek Pharmaceutical Students' Federation, Δήμος Ζωγράφου
description: Dental Run 2026 is an inclusive road race taking place at Goudi Park on May 17. Runners of all levels are invited to take part in a 5-kilometer race, a relaxed walk, or a children’s race. The event aims to promote health and smiles, and also offers non-athletes the opportunity to participate as volunteers. The start is scheduled for 09:00 in the morning, and the event is open to everyone, with support from well-known dental care product companies.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route at Goudi Park
Option of a relaxed walk or a children’s race
Inclusive event open to runners and volunteers
additional: Those who do not wish to run can participate as volunteers. The event is supported by companies including Sensodyne, Corega, Parodontax, Elmex-Colgate, Curaprox, and Dole. It is organized to raise awareness about health, with participation options including a 5-kilometer race, a walk, and a children’s race, as well as opportunities to volunteer.

name: 5 ος Αγώνας Ολοι Μαζί Ολοι Ισοι
description: The 5th “All Together—All Equal” road race is organized by the Region of Central Greece with the assistance of the “Gefyra” (Bridge) support structure and the support of the Municipality of Lamia and the Fthiotida Runners’ Association “Trachina.” The race takes place at Lamia Castle and aims to raise awareness about people with disabilities. It features three routes of 800 m, 2.5 km and 5 km. These are non-competitive routes, and there is no timing. Participation is free for people with disabilities and their companions.
course_highlights: 800 m, 2.5 km and 5 km routes at Lamia Castle
Start and finish at the same location at the Castle
Routes suitable for people with disabilities and their companions; non-competitive
additional: The 2.5 km and 5 km routes are open to people with disabilities and companions aged over 12. The 800 m route is for people with disabilities of any age and primary school children (ages 6–12). There is no timing, and the race is symbolic in nature. The schedule includes registration opening at 10:00, the 800 m start at 11:00, and the 2.5 km and 5 km starts at 11:30, with the event ending at 12:30. The event has a social purpose and includes children and adults, awareness-raising and cultural activities, and support from the Municipality of Lamia and the Fthiotida Runners’ Association.

name: Маратон Каланджа
description: Kalandzha Marathon is a celebratory event marking 10 years since its inception in 2026. It takes place in the village of Sinemorets and offers mountain running distances of 42, 21, 13 km, and 3 km for children, as well as mountain biking distances of 42 and 21 km. The courses pass through the scenic routes of Strandzha Nature Park, bringing together sport, nature, and community. The event includes race packs, an awards ceremony, and a party, creating a festive atmosphere for participants.

name: Dac Warrior
description: Dac Warrior 2026 is a unique obstacle race in Romania, taking place on May 23 in Tohani, Gura Vadului, Prahova. The courses are challenging, with significant elevation gain and a variety of obstacles designed to test participants’ physical endurance and willpower. The event offers an experience of initiation and reconnection with the spirit of the Dacian ancestors, combining athletic effort with tradition and authentic nature. Participants can choose from several events, ranging from 6 km to 21 km, each with its own challenges and obstacles. The atmosphere is one of camaraderie and competition, and after the race participants are invited to discover the local culture and enjoy its traditions and rituals.
course_highlights: Ultimate Run: 21 km with 1,060 m of elevation gain and over 30 obstacles
Legend Run: 11.6 km with 690 m of elevation gain and 25 obstacles
Brave Run: 7.35 km with 348 m of elevation gain and 20 obstacles
additional: Registration validation and race-kit pickup take place on Friday, May 22, 2026, between 16:00 and 20:00 at Domeniul Satul Dacilor. The courses feature a variety of obstacles, including low fences, log jumps, rings, sandbags, a log pyramid, ropes, parallel bars, monkey bars, a muddy trench, a wall traverse, and a surprise obstacle. There are age- and gender-based prize categories, with cash prizes for the top finishers. The race is recommended for experienced participants, especially the Ultimate Run, which is a challenging OCR. The event offers different distance categories and courses and is open to both amateur and advanced runners.

name: JIDVEI WINELAND TRAILS
description: Jidvei Weinland Trails este un eveniment sportiv unic desfășurat pe domeniul Castelului Bethlen-Haller, în inima Transilvaniei. Concursul combină alergarea și ciclismul pe trasee pitorești ce străbat podgoria Jidvei, oferind participanților peisaje spectaculoase și o experiență autentică în mijlocul naturii. Evenimentul include curse pentru toate nivelurile de pregătire, de la copii la adulți, și oferă activități recreative și oenogastronomice pentru întreaga familie. Este o sărbătoare a sportului, culturii și tradiției locale, cu o atmosferă prietenoasă și sigură pentru toți participanții.

name: Obciniada Night Run
organizer: Obciniada / Asociația Ținuturi Durabile / Asociația Club Sportiv Bucovina între Obcini
description: Obciniada Night Run este o cursă de alergare nocturnă în inima Bucovinei, ce oferă trasee spectaculoase și o atmosferă de festival sub stele. Evenimentul este organizat pentru a promova mișcarea în aer liber și un stil de viață sănătos, implicând comunitatea locală și susținând educația copiilor defavorizați. Participanții pot alege între mai multe distanțe, de la semimaraton la curse pentru copii, bucurându-se de o experiență autentică în natură, cu puncte de hidratare, masă caldă și premii. Festivalul combină sportul cu o atmosferă prietenoasă și responsabilă față de mediu.

name: Tour de Tur
description: Tour de Tur este o competiție anuală de mountain bike și trail running care se desfășoară în zona Lacului Mujdeni, Comuna Orașu Nou, județul Satu Mare. Evenimentul oferă trasee variate pentru toate nivelurile, de la curse de maraton MTB la alergare trail, fiind dedicat atât sportivilor profesioniști, cât și amatorilor pasionați de natură și aventură. Ediția a XX-a din 2026 promite o experiență sportivă completă, cu trasee bine marcate și diferențe de nivel semnificative, într-un cadru natural pitoresc. Organizatorii invită toți participanții să se înscrie online și să se bucure de atmosfera competitivă și prietenoasă a evenimentului.

name: 1. Tibužde Trail
description: 1. Tibužde Trail is a trail race held in Tibužde, Vranje. Runners can choose between two course distances, 27 km and 7 km, offering challenging terrain and beautiful scenery. The event starts in the morning and lasts all day, giving participants a unique trail-running experience.
course_highlights: A 27 km course with 3,000 metres of elevation gain
A shorter 7 km course with 3,000 metres of elevation gain
Natural terrain around Tibužde
additional: The event runs from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Terrain: mountainous; registration open; several categories, including a children’s race; shared lunch after the race.

name: Dragutin Tomašević
description: Memorijalna atletska trka Dragutin Tomašević održava se u selu Bistrica kod Petrovca na Mlavi u znak sećanja na prvog srpskog olimpijca. Ova jubilarna 21. trka okuplja trkače svih uzrasta i kategorija, pružajući priliku za takmičenje u muškoj i ženskoj konkurenciji, kao i po starosnim grupama. Učesnici dobijaju čipovane startne brojeve i "Joma" Dry fit majice, a organizator obezbeđuje prevoz i svečanu večeru. Trka je poznata po svojoj tradiciji i podršci lokalne zajednice, stvarajući prijatnu atmosferu za sve trkače.

name: Ivanjica Trail
description: Ivanjica Trail je jedinstvena trail trka u Srbiji koja okuplja trkače različitih nivoa spremnosti kroz nekoliko staza različitih dužina i težina. Trke se održavaju u prelepim prirodnim predelima Ivanjice i Golije, sa vidikovcima, livadama, šumama i potocima, pružajući nezaboravno iskustvo trčanja u prirodi. Posebno se ističe Golija PREMIUM trka sa startom na vrhu Golije i ULTRA 66K dvodnevna etapna trka koja spaja tri planine i nudi izazov za iskusne trkače. Organizatori obezbeđuju startne pakete, osveženje, ručak, prevoz i smeštaj za učesnike, stvarajući prijatnu i podržavajuću atmosferu.

name: ONERUN 2026
description: One Run je međunarodna trka koja se održava osmu godinu zaredom, istovremeno u više zemalja i kontinenata. Događaj je poznat po tome što je dva puta upisan u Ginisovu knjigu rekorda kao najveći polumaraton sa sinhronizovanim startom na svetu. Trka je otvorena za sve, sa četiri dostupne distance, i promoviše zdravlje, pristupačnost i zajedništvo kroz sport i aktivnosti na otvorenom. Ove godine trčimo u Velikom Gradištu, Srbija, 23. maja, sa ciljem da se po prvi put u Srbiji postane deo novog napada na Ginisov rekord.

name: 13ος Πράσινος Ημιμαραθώνιος Λευκάδας
description: The 13th Green Lefkada Half Marathon is a night race organized by the Lefkada «Filandros» Athletic Club in collaboration with the Municipality of Lefkada and the Region of the Ionian Islands. The event includes 21.1 km and 8 km races, as well as a 1 km children’s race for ages 6–12. The start and finish are at the Lefkada Cultural Center, and the course runs around the lagoon, offering a unique running experience with sunset views. The race is held under the auspices of the EAS SEGAS Epirus and EOSLMA-Y.
course_highlights: Night race starting at 19:45
Course around the Lefkada lagoon
Start and finish at the Lefkada Cultural Center
additional: Schedule of events includes bib and chip collection, a pasta party, and awards. Children’s races have separate start times. The 8 km race starts at 17:45 and the 1 km children’s race at 16:30. Distances: 21.097 m and 8 km; races for children ages 6–12; parallel activities; courses in a protected NATURA area.

name: 22ος Δρόμος Θυσίας «Αγγελής Γοβιός»
location: Κεντρική πλατεία Ψαχνών, Ψαχνά, Ευβοίας, Greece
description: The “Angelis Govios” Road of Sacrifice is a historic road race being held for the 22nd year in Psachna, Evia, organized by the Psachna Runners and Walkers Association under the auspices of the Municipality of Dirfys-Messapia. The race includes 15 km, 5 km, and 1 km routes for children and people with disabilities, honoring the memory of the great Evian revolutionary military leader Angelis Govios and the late Mayor Giorgos Psathas. The race starts in Psachna’s central square, and entry is free, with ample refreshments provided. The 15 km route is 50% unpaved, with a total elevation gain of +131 meters, while the 5 km and 1 km routes are entirely on asphalt with minimal elevation gain.
course_highlights: 15 km route with 50% unpaved terrain and +131 m elevation gain.
5 km and 1 km routes on asphalt with minimal elevation gain.
Start in Psachna’s central square.
additional: Registration takes place on race day at the start area and is free. Registration opens at 15:00. Ample refreshments are provided for runners. The event takes place on 29 May 2027, with the race starting at 17:00. It includes routes for all ages and levels, promoting sport and historical remembrance.

name: Run For Stroke
location: Μητροπολιτικό Πάρκο «Αντώνης Τρίτσης», Αγίοι Ανάργυροι, Αττική, Greece
description: The Run For Stroke road race is organized by Stroke Hope Urban Non-Profit Company in cooperation with NeuroLife IKE, with the aim of raising awareness about prevention and supporting people affected by stroke. The event takes place at Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park and includes a 5 km race for runners and a 1 km race for children and people with disabilities. The race began in 2024 and aims to connect physical activity with health and social awareness. Technical direction is provided by WeRun, with support from RUNAWAY.
course_highlights: Routes within Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park
5 km dirt route consisting of two 2.5 km laps
1 km route for children and people with disabilities
additional: Eligibility: 5 km for people over 12 years of age with a medical certificate of fitness. 1 km for children aged 6–12, people with disabilities, and patients. The race includes runners and walkers. Technical direction by WeRun, with support from RUNAWAY. The event will take place on Saturday, May 23, 2026, starting at 18:30, at Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park. The terrain includes park trails and promotes health and social awareness.

name: Ursa Trail
description: The Ursa Trail in Metsovo is a challenging mountain race offering distances for all runners, from the 100 km ultramarathon with 5,700 m of elevation gain to shorter distances of 40 km, 21 km, and 11 km, as well as the 4.6 km Katara Vertical race. The course crosses beautiful trails and mountains in the area, offering unique natural scenery and technical challenges. The race is ITRA-certified and is an important event for mountain-running enthusiasts in Greece. The organizers provide for athletes’ safety and support, with aid stations and technical assistance along the course.
course_highlights: 100 km ultramarathon with 5,700 m of elevation gain
40 km, 21 km, and 11 km races, plus a 4.6 km vertical race
Beautiful mountain trails in Metsovo with technical challenges
additional: Races start at different times depending on the distance. Aid stations and technical support are available along the courses. The race is ITRA-certified and awards UTMB points for the 100 km ultramarathon. Information about accommodation and transport in the area is also provided. Ursa Trail also includes children’s races and special challenges, such as the 65.6 km URSA CHALLENGE with 4,810 m of elevation gain. The event combines racing and hiking, with an overnight stay in Metsovo and the involvement of volunteers and local organizations.

name: Semimaraton Casa Bună Sânpetru
description: Semimaraton Casa Bună Sânpetru este un eveniment sportiv organizat cu scop caritabil, care oferă participanților oportunitatea de a alerga pe trasee variate și pitorești în zona Sânpetru, Brașov. Evenimentul este recunoscut pentru atmosfera prietenoasă, organizarea impecabilă și sprijinul acordat familiilor defavorizate prin Casa Bună Sânpetru. Traseele includ opțiuni de dificultate diferită, potrivite atât pentru începători, cât și pentru alergători experimentați, oferind peisaje frumoase și provocări sportive. Participarea la acest semimaraton înseamnă nu doar o experiență sportivă, ci și o contribuție la o cauză nobilă.

name: Semimaraton Galați
description: Semimaraton Galați este un eveniment filantropic-sportiv care combină performanța sportivă cu responsabilitatea socială, reunind alergători profesioniști și amatori, familii și voluntari. De peste 12 ediții, evenimentul susține cauze comunitare locale prin taxele de participare și donații, finanțând proiecte dedicate educației, sănătății și incluziunii sociale. Traseele variate și atmosfera comunitară fac din Semimaraton Galați o experiență unică, care aduce sportul mai aproape de comunitate și promovează solidaritatea. Ediția din 2026 continuă această tradiție, oferind curse pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile de pregătire.

name: Crosul Copiilor
description: Crosul Copiilor 2026 este o competiție dedicată copiilor cu vârste între 0 și 14 ani, desfășurată în Parcul Central din Baia Mare. Evenimentul oferă curse adaptate pe categorii de vârstă, de la Baby Run pentru cei sub 4 ani, până la curse cronometrate competitive pentru grupele mai mari. Este o cursă plină de energie, bucurie și susținere din partea părinților, unde fiecare copil este încurajat să participe și să se bucure de alergare. Organizatorii limitează numărul participanților pentru a asigura o experiență plăcută și sigură pentru toți.

name: Trail trka Tibuzde 2026
location: село Тибужде, 5 км од града Врање
description: 1. Tibužde Trail је трка у природи која се одржава у селу Тибужде, близу Врања. Трка нуди два различита растојања, 27 км и 7 км, и пружа учесницима прилику да уживају у изазовном терену и лепотама природе. Почетак трке је ујутру у 7 сати, а догађај траје до 17 сати, пружајући одличну атмосферу за све љубитеље трчања и природе.

name: Epidavrios Dromos Theater 2 Theater
location: Ancient Theatre of Epidaurus, Epidavros, Greece

name: Ultrabug
description: Ultrabug is a fully supported, 3-day ultramarathon held on scenic mountain trails in Romania’s Carpathian Mountains, in the Fundu Moldovei area. The main route covers 100 km across mountain trails, mineral-water streams and villages with a rich culture, and is suitable for all fitness levels, including first-time ultra participants. The event also includes shorter alternative races, such as Marathon XFun, Ultra XFun and Fun Run, offering participants a range of options. After the race, participants are invited to an awards ceremony and a traditional party with local food. Ultrabug is internationally recognised, awards iTRA points and has been voted among the 50 best ultramarathons abroad.
course_highlights: A 100 km route across mountain trails, mineral-water streams and traditional villages
Spectacular scenery with green pastures and the authentic sounds of bells and running water
Alternative routes of 42 km + 8 km, 50 km + 8 km, and an 8 km race open to all ages
additional: A jacket/hoodie is included only for registrations made by 1 May 2026. The event awards finishers 3 iTRA points. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a party with traditional food, including BBQ with polenta, cheese and homemade bread. The race is open to runners, hikers and walkers, with a minimum age of 18 for the 100 km race; the 8 km race is open to all ages. The event includes accommodation at Casa Ileana in Fundu Moldovei, awards iTRA points and attracts international participants.

name: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra
description: DECATHLON TRAKIA UTRA is a mountain running event that recreates the spirit of the ancient Thracian lands through the magic of nature and sport. The race offers a variety of distances suitable for beginners, advanced runners, and experts, including ultralong courses with stunning views and challenges. It is an event that combines sporting spirit, history, and a love of nature, creating an unforgettable experience for all participants. Join us and discover the magic of Thrace in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains.

name: Мемориал "Йорданка Аризанова"
description: The “Yordanka Arizanova” Memorial is an annual competition dedicated to the memory of the legendary coach Yordanka Arizanova, who developed hundreds of accomplished athletes. The tournament is held at Plovdiv Stadium and includes events such as the 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, and 400 m hurdles, in which the coach achieved her greatest successes. The competition brings together both young and established athletes to honor her legacy and contribution to Bulgarian athletics.

name: Transylvania 100
location: Castelul Bran, Bran, Brașov County, Romania
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain running event offering five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, held in the Bucegi Mountains. The routes cross narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines, with numerous climbs and descents, all starting and finishing at Bran Castle, in the shadow of the legendary Dracula. The event is recognised as a UTMB Index race and promotes values such as respect, solidarity and self-sufficiency in mountain running. Participants must have prior mountain-running experience for the longer races, and everyone who finishes within the time limits receives a special souvenir.
course_highlights: Routes through narrow trails and ancient forests
Course across mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines
Start and finish near Bran Castle
additional: SportHG technical T-shirts are available until 1 May 2026, after which they will be replaced by neck warmers. Participation limits and prior experience are mandatory for races over 20 km. All races are solo, with strict self-sufficiency rules between checkpoints. The event includes races for different experience levels, with prizes for winners and medals for all finishers. Participation requires trail-running experience, and registration is online, with limited places.

name: Maratonul Internațional Sibiu
location: Piața Mare, Sibiu, Sibiu County, Romania

price_tiers.distance: Pași pentru oraș by Bilstein 3.35 km

description: Sibiu International Marathon is Romania’s largest philanthropic running event, reaching its 15th edition in 2026. The event combines the joy of running with support for community projects, with runners able to choose to support various local causes through their entry fee. The event features multiple races for all ages and levels, from the full marathon to children’s races, held in Sibiu’s Great Square and surrounding areas. It is a movement that unites and inspires communities, with a strong tradition and significant social impact.
course_highlights: Multiple races: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, relay and children’s races
Start and finish in Great Square, Sibiu
A philanthropic event supporting local community projects
additional: Entry fees are considered donations supporting community projects. The event includes races for all ages, including children’s races and a relay. The registration deadline is 4 May 2026. It features multiple races, a registration deadline of 4 May 2026, donation-based fees, and a focus on social and community causes.

name: BRASOV MARATHON Eveniment organizat de CPNT Brașov
description: Brașov Marathon is one of Romania’s largest mountain running events, held in the heart of the Carpathians, around the city of Brașov. The courses include the 10K Cross, Half Marathon, Marathon, and Ultra Marathon, crossing the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs and offering impressive views and a unique combination of sport and nature. The event starts in Piața Sfatului, passes historic and natural landmarks, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit, offering ITRA and UTMB points. It is a celebration of health and sport, open to runners of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Mountain routes across the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs
Start and finish in Piața Sfatului, passing the Black Church and the Weavers’ Bastion
Panoramic views of Brașov and the surrounding area
additional: Race kits can be collected in Piața Sfatului, with specific hours for each race. The Ultra Marathon starts at 08:00, while the Half Marathon starts in two waves. Mandatory gear checks apply to the Ultra Marathon, Marathon, and Half Marathon. The event also includes races for children and teenagers, held over three days. The start area offers refreshments between 10:30 and 23:00. The event includes races for children and people with special abilities, and is dedicated to promoting running, nature, and the local community.

name: Crosul Teiușului
description: Crosul Teiușului este un eveniment sportiv dedicat promovării mișcării în aer liber, a alergării montane și a unui stil de viață sănătos, adresat tuturor vârstelor și nivelurilor de pregătire. Evenimentul oferă trasee variate, de la curse pentru copii până la semimaraton, într-un cadru natural autentic din Teiuș, Alba. Promovează incluziunea, spiritul de fair-play și participarea activă a comunității, oferind acces gratuit tuturor participanților. Este o tradiție locală care crește anual, aducând împreună sportivi și susținători pentru o experiență memorabilă.

name: Giarmata În Mișcare
description: Giarmata on the Move is an annual sporting event that brings together the communities of Giarmata and Cerneteaz to support social and educational causes and animal protection. In 2026, the event will take place on May 30 and will offer running races and cycling tours for all ages, from children to adults. Participants can choose from a half marathon, races of various distances, cycling tours, and children’s races, all helping to support local community projects. The event is organized by LOGS together with local partners and supported by major sponsors.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon for adults (ages 16+)
10.5 km and 5 km races for adults and young people
Races and tours for children aged 4 to 12
additional: The event includes races for all ages, from young children (400 m) to the half marathon. Participation supports community projects for children with disabilities, education, and animal protection. Donations can also be made separately by bank transfer or PayPal to the LOGS Association. The organizers provide support and information by email for payment confirmations and registration questions. The event includes donations and social projects, is supported by several local partners, and aims to promote health and civic engagement.

name: Thermal Trail Race
description: Thermal Trail Race este o cursă de alergare în aer liber ce promovează un stil de viață sănătos și respectul față de natură. Evenimentul are loc la Băile 1 Mai, cu startul și finishul în parcarea de la Avenul Betfia (Crater). Sunt disponibile două probe: Cross de 14 km și Mini de 7 km, oferind o experiență de trail running în peisajul natural al capitalei apelor termale. Aceasta este ediția a 13-a a evenimentului, care adună pasionați de alergare și natură într-un cadru prietenos și activ.

name: Forest Run
description: Baneasa Forest Run este o cursă de alergare 100% trail în Pădurea Băneasa, Cluj-Napoca, care oferă o experiență autentică în natură. Evenimentul include patru probe: semimaraton, cros de 11 km, alergare rapidă de 6 km și Family Run de 3 km, necompetitivă, pentru familii. Cursa este dedicată tuturor nivelurilor de alergători, de la începători la avansați, și pune accent pe bucuria alergării în pădure. Organizat de o echipă pasionată, evenimentul oferă și planuri de antrenament și antrenamente de grup pentru pregătire optimă.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://baneasaforestrun.ro/): 2026-11-01 — "Băneasa Forest Run — 1 noiembrie 2026" (was estimated 2027-06-05)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Băneasa Forest Run — 1 noiembrie 2026

name: Mokra Gora Trail
description: Mokra Gora Trail is a new regional hiking trail that runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia. The trail is part of the Via Dinarica network and offers a unique opportunity for adventure tourism and exploration of the Balkans’ unspoiled nature. It was developed with the support of the Institute for Territorial Economic Development and the Regional Cooperation Council, with the aim of promoting cross-border tourism and preserving the region’s natural beauty. The trail is known for its Via Ferrata attractions, which offer exciting experiences for hikers and nature lovers.
course_highlights: The trail runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting three countries: Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia
It is part of the Via Dinarica network, known for its unspoiled nature and mountain landscapes
Via Ferrata sections offer adventure opportunities for hikers
additional: The trail is part of the Via Dinarica cross-border project and was developed to promote sustainable tourism and improve infrastructure. No race price or registration details are listed, indicating that the focus is on the hiking trail rather than a competition. The contact organization is the Regional Cooperation Council, headquartered in Sarajevo. The project is linked to the development of regional hiking trails, including Via Ferrata, GPS mapping and the installation of signage, with the aim of promoting sustainable tourism and cooperation in the region.

name: Tour de Fruška
description: Tour de Fruška je jedan od najatraktivnijih sportskih događaja u regionu, koji se održava u prelepom ambijentu Fruške gore, u Vrdniku. Ova manifestacija spaja sport, prirodu i turizam, pružajući učesnicima jedinstveno iskustvo vožnje kroz netaknutu prirodu i prelepe pejzaže. Događaj okuplja ljubitelje biciklizma i aktivnog odmora, promovišući zdrav način života i turističke potencijale Vojvodine.

name: Ozren i Devica 2026
description: Planinarska akcija Devica - Ozren, organizovana od strane PSK Pobeda, vodi učesnike na uspon na planinu Devicu, jednu od najlepših i najsevernijih balkanskih planina. Staza vodi kroz bujnu vegetaciju i krečnjačke formacije sa mnogobrojnim pećinama, uključujući uspon na Soko grad i vidikovac Golem kamen, a završava se šumskom stazom ka Ozrenu i vodopadu Ripaljka. Akcija je jednodnevna, sa polaskom iz Beograda u ranim jutarnjim časovima i povratkom uveče. Učesnici moraju imati overenu knjižicu Planinarskog saveza Srbije za 2026. godinu i adekvatnu opremu za planinarenje.

name: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3
description: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3 is an exciting series of races held in Mionica, offering a range of distances for runners of different levels. The races include mountain and cycling marathons, as well as shorter courses, all set in the beautiful natural surroundings of Stara Planina. This event attracts nature and sports enthusiasts, offering challenging and scenic routes. You are welcome to take part and enjoy the unique atmosphere and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: A variety of courses from 7 km to 60 km
Mountain and cycling marathons on Stara Planina
Beautiful natural landscapes and challenging terrain

name: 6ο Vasiliki Lefkada
description: Οι 6οι Αγώνες Vasiliki Lefkada Road & Mountain Races 2026 θα πραγματοποιηθούν στις 30-31 Μαΐου στη Βασιλική Λευκάδας. Πρόκειται για διήμερο αγώνων δρόμου και ορεινού τρεξίματος που διοργανώνονται από την Τουριστική Εταιρεία Λευκάδας και τον Σύλλογο Τουρισμού και Πολιτισμού της ευρύτερης περιοχής. Οι διαδρομές περιλαμβάνουν αγώνες για παιδιά με πατίνια, έναν εκρηκτικό διάθλο 3.500 μέτρων με κολύμβηση και τρέξιμο, καθώς και τον κλασικό αγώνα δρόμου 13.000 μέτρων που ξεκινά από την παραλία Πόρτο Κατσίκι. Η εκκίνηση του μεγάλου αγώνα δρόμου είναι στις 18:00, προσφέροντας μια μοναδική αθλητική εμπειρία σε ένα πανέμορφο φυσικό περιβάλλον.

name: 7 Hills Run
description: 7 Hills Run is part of the RunBG Trail Series and takes place in the village of Zhelyava, Sofia. This is a challenging race that attracts mountain running and nature enthusiasts. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy beautiful landscapes and varied terrain in the Sofia area. The organizers provide professional organization and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.

name: Купа Мургаш 2026
description: Murgash Cup 2026 is the 17th edition of a mountain biking cross-country marathon (XCM) race held in the village of Zhelyava. The race offers three main routes of varying lengths and elevation gain, suitable for different categories of riders, including hobby riders and e-bikes. The routes pass through scenic and challenging terrain, including the famous Zhelyava Trail, which is popular with cyclists. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes, and the event is suitable for intermediate and well-prepared cyclists.

name: Crosul Copiilor
location: Veneția de Jos, Brașov County, Romania

name: Stazama Vuka Karadžića
description: Stazama Vuka Karadžića je kružna trka dužine 25 km sa ukupnim usponom od 1000 metara. Staza vodi od Vukove spomen-kuće kroz hladovinu stoletnih Manastirskih šuma, pored šumskih potočića i vodopada do Manastira Trinoša iz 13. veka, zatim preko Male Tronoše i Lisine do Zajače, odakle stazom Manastirskih sveća ide do Velike Bobije i etno kompleksa Miličin konak, pa nazad do Tršića i Vukove kuće gde je cilj. Ova trka pruža jedinstvenu priliku da se uživa u prirodnim lepotama i kulturno-istorijskim znamenitostima regiona.

name: Kros Trka Carica
description: Kros trka Carica je tradicionalna trka u prirodi održana u Malom Staparu, koja okuplja trkače svih uzrasta, od dece do takmičara starijih od sedamdeset godina. Glavna trka ima dužinu od 6,4 km, a pre nje se održavaju dečije trke sa oko četrdesetoro učesnika. Ova manifestacija neguje tradiciju sporta, druženja i boravka u prirodi, a organizatori pozivaju sve da učestvuju i uživaju u ovom sportskom događaju. Trka je uvertira u Trku prijateljstva koja se održava u Kuli, čime se nastavlja sportska tradicija i zajedništvo.

name: 5TH EVRYTANIA TRAIL RACES
description: Οι διοργανωτές του 5ου Evrytania Trail Races σας προσκαλούν να τρέξετε στα ελατοσκέπαστα μονοπάτια της ορεινής Ευρυτανίας, σε ένα από τα καθαρότερα οικοσυστήματα της Ευρώπης. Οι αγώνες προσφέρουν μια μοναδική ευκαιρία να γνωρίσετε τη μαγεία της φύσης, να δροσιστείτε στα κρυστάλλινα νερά του Κρικελλοπόταμου και να απολαύσετε τη φιλοξενία των παραδοσιακών χωριών που λειτουργούν ως σταθμοί ανεφοδιασμού. Η διοργάνωση περιλαμβάνει αγώνες διαφορετικών αποστάσεων, κατάλληλους για αρχάριους και έμπειρους δρομείς, με όμορφες και απαιτητικές διαδρομές που συνδυάζουν μονοπάτια, χωματόδρομους και δρόμους.

name: 2οι Ορεινοί Αγώνες Τρεξίματος Χαλκιόπουλοι Βάλτου
organizer: Σύλλογος Χαλκιοπουλιτών Αθήνας – Πειραιά «ΑΓΙΟΣ ΑΝΔΡΕΑΣ Ο ΕΡΗΜΙΤΗΣ»
description: Οι 2οι Ορεινοί Αγώνες Τρεξίματος στα μονοπάτια των Βαλτινών Αγωνιστών - Chalkiopoulo Trail Run 2026 θα διεξαχθούν την Κυριακή 31 Μαΐου 2026 στο Νέο Χαλκιόπουλο Βάλτου Αιτωλοακαρνανίας με ώρα εκκίνησης τις 9 το πρωί. Η διοργάνωση γίνεται από τον Σύλλογο Χαλκιοπουλιτών Αθήνας - Πειραιά «Άγιος Ανδρέας ο Ερημίτης», τον Πολιτιστικό και Μορφωτικό Σύλλογο Χαλκιοπούλων, την τοπική Κοινότητα Χαλκιοπούλων και τον Δήμο Αμφιλοχίας. Οι αγώνες περιλαμβάνουν δύο αποστάσεις, 27 και 10 χιλιομέτρων, που διασχίζουν τα πανέμορφα ορεινά τοπία των Χαλκιοπούλων και του Βάλτου, προσφέροντας μια μοναδική εμπειρία ορεινού τρεξίματος.

name: 5ο Posidonia Running Event
description: Ο 5ος Posidonia Running Event θα πραγματοποιηθεί στις 31 Μαΐου 2026 στον Πειραιά, προσφέροντας μια διαδρομή 5 χιλιομέτρων που διασχίζει τους δρόμους της πόλης. Η διοργάνωση απευθύνεται σε δρομείς από όλο τον κόσμο και συνδυάζει τον αθλητισμό με την υποστήριξη φιλανθρωπικών σκοπών, καθώς τα έσοδα θα διατεθούν στο Δήμο Πειραιά και τους συνεργαζόμενους φιλανθρωπικούς φορείς. Η εκκίνηση και ο τερματισμός θα γίνουν στο Δημοτικό Θέατρο Πειραιά, με ώρα εκκίνησης στις 09:00 π.μ. Το γεγονός αποτελεί μέρος της διεθνούς ναυτιλιακής έκθεσης Posidonia 2026 και υπόσχεται μια μοναδική εμπειρία για τους συμμετέχοντες.

name: 6ο Karya Olympus Trail
description: Ο Karya Olympus Trail είναι ένας ορεινός αγώνας τρεξίματος που διεξάγεται στην Καρυά, προσφέροντας μια μοναδική εμπειρία σε δρομείς που αγαπούν τη φύση και την πρόκληση των βουνών. Ο αγώνας αναδεικνύει την ομορφιά του Ολύμπου και της γύρω περιοχής, συνδυάζοντας απαιτητικά μονοπάτια με εκπληκτική θέα. Είναι μια εκδήλωση που προσελκύει δρομείς κάθε επιπέδου, με στόχο την ανάδειξη του αθλητισμού και της τοπικής παράδοσης. Η διοργάνωση είναι φιλόξενη και υποστηρίζει τους συμμετέχοντες σε κάθε βήμα της διαδρομής.

name: 42ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Διστόμου
description: Ο 42ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Διστόμου είναι ένας αγώνας δρόμου μνήμης που διοργανώνεται την Κυριακή 31 Μαΐου 2026 στο Δίστομο, τιμώντας τη μνήμη της σφαγής του 1944. Η διαδρομή των 11,2 χιλιομέτρων ξεκινά από τον ιστορικό τόπο Καρακόλιθος και καταλήγει στην πλατεία Εθνικής Αντίστασης. Ο αγώνας προσφέρει δωρεάν συμμετοχή και περιλαμβάνει παιδικό αγώνα 1,1 χλμ. με εκκίνηση την ίδια ώρα. Η διοργάνωση φροντίζει για τη μεταφορά των δρομέων, τη χρονομέτρηση, τη ιατρική κάλυψη και τη διατροφή κατά μήκος της διαδρομής και στον τερματισμό.

name: Karya Olympus Trail
description: Ο αγώνας Karya Olympus Trail 2026 προσφέρει μια μοναδική εμπειρία ορεινού τρεξίματος στην ειδυλλιακή κοιλάδα της Καρυάς, κάτω από την προστασία του Ολύμπου. Οι διαδρομές ακολουθούν σηματοδοτημένα μονοπάτια με διαφορετικές αποστάσεις και θετική υψομετρική, κατάλληλες για δρομείς όλων των επιπέδων. Η διοργάνωση περιλαμβάνει αγώνες 25, 13 και 5 χιλιομέτρων, καθώς και παιδικούς αγώνες, με παροχές όπως ηλεκτρονική χρονομέτρηση, αναμνηστικά μετάλλια και τεχνικά μπλουζάκια. Η εκκίνηση γίνεται νωρίς το πρωί, ενώ οι απονομές πραγματοποιούνται στον χώρο εκκίνησης-τερματισμού. Η περιοχή προσφέρει φυσική ομορφιά και ιστορικό ενδιαφέρον, καθιστώντας τον αγώνα μια ολοκληρωμένη αθλητική και πολιτιστική εμπειρία.

name: Titnata Trail
description: Το Titnata Trail 13km είναι ένας σύντομος αγώνας ορεινού τρεξίματος που διεξάγεται στην Καρυά, Ελλάδα. Η διαδρομή των 13 χιλιομέτρων περιλαμβάνει +760 μέτρα ανάβαση, προσφέροντας μια απαιτητική ανηφορική πρόκληση σε σηματοδοτημένο μονοπάτι. Ο αγώνας ξεκινά στις 08:50 και έχει όριο συμμετοχών 200 δρομέων. Οι συμμετέχοντες που τερματίζουν λαμβάνουν αναμνηστικό τεχνικό T-shirt.

name: Karya Mini Trail
description: Ο αγώνας Karya Mini Trail αποτελεί μέρος του Karya Olympus Trail που διεξάγεται στην Καρυά, μια ειδυλλιακή κοιλάδα στον Όλυμπο. Η διαδρομή των 5 χιλιομέτρων ακολουθεί σηματοδοτημένο μονοπάτι με θετική υψομετρική 285 μέτρων, προσφέροντας μια όμορφη εμπειρία ορεινού τρεξίματος. Η διοργάνωση περιλαμβάνει επίσης μεγαλύτερες διαδρομές και παιδικούς αγώνες, με παροχές όπως ηλεκτρονική χρονομέτρηση, αναμνηστικά και τροφοδοσία. Η Καρυά, με την πλούσια ιστορία και φυσική ομορφιά της, προσφέρει ένα μοναδικό περιβάλλον για τους δρομείς και τους επισκέπτες.

name: Macin Mountain Fun ~ 2026
description: Măcin Mountain Fun este o competiție montană de ciclism și alergare care se desfășoară în peisajul spectaculos al Munților Măcin. Traseele oferă o varietate de dificultăți, de la rute tehnice și solicitante pentru cicliști experimentați, până la trasee mai accesibile pentru amatori. Evenimentul pune accent pe siguranță, fair play și distracție, fiind potrivit pentru pasionații de sport în aer liber care doresc să se bucure de natură și provocări sportive. Înscrierile se fac online, iar organizatorii asigură o experiență bine organizată și prietenoasă.

name: Humanitarna IT trka „Štafeta srcem”
description: Humanitarna IT trka „Štafeta srcem“ održaće se 5. juna 2026. godine u Niškoj tvrđavi. Ovaj događaj okuplja IT zajednicu i ljubitelje trčanja u humanitarnoj atmosferi, promovišući solidarnost i podršku kroz sport. Trka je prilika za druženje, aktivan život i doprinos zajednici u prelepom ambijentu tvrđave.

name: Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Νέας Σμύρνης
organizer: δήμος Νέας Σμύρνης και Περιφέρεια Αττικής
description: Ο Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Νέας Σμύρνης 2026 είναι ένας αγώνας δρόμου 5 χιλιομέτρων που διοργανώνεται από τον Δήμο Νέας Σμύρνης σε συνεργασία με την Περιφέρεια Αττικής και τον Εμπορικό Σύλλογο Νέας Σμύρνης, στο πλαίσιο της Παγκόσμιας Ημέρας Περιβάλλοντος. Ο αγώνας έχει αθλητικό, οικολογικό και ψυχαγωγικό χαρακτήρα, με στόχο την προώθηση της προστασίας του περιβάλλοντος και της βιώσιμης ανάπτυξης. Η διαδρομή διεξάγεται στον άξονα της οδού Ελ. Βενιζέλου με αφετηρία και τερματισμό στην οδό Ομήρου 54. Μετά τον αγώνα ακολουθεί συναυλία και party, ενώ τα καταστήματα της περιοχής συμμετέχουν με ειδικές προσφορές και εκπτώσεις.

name: Salomon Vitosha Trail
description: Salomon Vitosha Trail 2026 is a mountain race offering a unique experience in the wild nature of Vitosha. The race includes three distances of varying difficulty and elevation gain, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Aleko Hut, and the courses cross varied terrain, including an ascent of Cherni Vrah—the highest point on Vitosha. The organizers aim to develop trail-running culture in Bulgaria and encourage an active lifestyle.

name: Национален шампионат под 18 г.
description: The U18 National Championships in Stara Zagora is a prestigious athletics competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The event brings together young athletes under 18 who compete in various track events. It is part of the national calendar and provides an opportunity for young athletics talents to compete and develop.

name: XRun
description: X-Run is a running competition held in Oradea on June 6, 2026, organized by the Xterra Sport Bihor Sports Club Association. The 21 km course offers a complete experience, with refreshment stations providing still water, isotonic drinks, cola, ice, fresh fruit, and energy bars. Participants receive a race pack containing a personalized technical shirt, race number, and electronic timing chip. Medical assistance is provided along the course by ambulances and specialized personnel. Race pack pickup takes place on Friday, June 5, 2026, from 16:00 to 20:00.
course_highlights: 21 km course in Oradea, Bihor County
Refreshment stations with drinks and energy snacks
Medical assistance along the course from ambulances and specialized personnel
additional: Race pack pickup takes place on Friday, June 5, 2026, from 16:00 to 20:00. The race pack includes an official personalized technical shirt, race number, and electronic timing chip. Medical assistance is provided by specially equipped ambulances and medical staff at key points along the course. Participants must present a signed declaration of responsibility and their identity card or passport. The entry fee is non-refundable if a participant withdraws, but the entry can be transferred until 16.05.2026. The event will take place on June 6, 2026, with participant facilities including race packs, hydration stations, and medical support.

name: Bușteni Ultra Race
description: Bușteni Ultra Race is a mountain running competition held on spectacular routes in the Bucegi and Baiului Mountains, offering impressive panoramic views. The event features four distances with significant elevation gain, designed to test participants’ physical and mental limits. The atmosphere is one of community and mutual support, while careful organization ensures a safe and professional experience. Participants can reconnect with nature and take on the challenge of an authentic endurance race.
course_highlights: Alpine routes with impressive panoramic views
Significant elevation gain for each distance
Marked routes and well-stocked aid stations
additional: Race kit pickup is on Friday 05.06.2026, between 15:00 and 22:00, for BBB Ultra 60; mandatory gear checks apply, and pickup is for participants only. For the other distances, kits can be picked up on Saturday 06.06.2026, between 7:00 and 9:30. The kit includes a personalized technical shirt for the first 800 participants, timing with a single-use chip, aid stations along the route and at the start/finish, a finisher medal for those who finish within the time limits, and products provided by sponsors. There are time limits for each distance and an awards ceremony at 18:00. The routes include aid and support points, with categories and prizes for different distances. The event promotes an authentic mountain trail experience and participant safety.

name: msg Maraton Apuseni
organizer: Clubul Alpin Român Filiala Cluj și msg Maraton Apuseni
description: .msg Maraton Apuseni este un eveniment emblematic de alergare montană care se desfășoară în peisajele pitorești ale Munților Apuseni, în zona Buscat Resort, Județul Cluj. Concursul oferă cinci trasee variate, de la ultramaraton și maraton, până la semimaraton, cros și o cursă family dedicată copiilor și părinților. Participanții se bucură de o experiență autentică în natură, traversând păduri dese, creste spectaculoase și sate tradiționale, într-o atmosferă prietenoasă și festivă. Evenimentul este organizat de Clubul Alpin Român Filiala Cluj și sărbătorește în 2026 cea de-a 15-a ediție, promițând provocări sportive și momente de socializare în ritmul muntelui.

name: Maraton Apuseni ~ 2026
description: .msg Maraton Apuseni este un eveniment emblematic de alergare montană care se desfășoară în inima Munților Apuseni, oferind trasee variate pentru toate gusturile și nivelurile de experiență. Participanții pot alege între ultramaraton, maraton, semimaraton, cros și o cursă family, bucurându-se de peisaje pitorești, poteci umbrite, creste spectaculoase și sate tradiționale. Evenimentul sărbătorește 15 ani de tradiție și comunitate, fiind organizat de Clubul Alpin Român Filiala Cluj, cu o atmosferă prietenoasă și festivă. Este o oportunitate unică de a alerga în natură, de a-ți testa limitele și de a te conecta cu alți pasionați de alergare montană.

name: Măcin Mountain Fun
description: Măcin Mountain Fun este o competiție montană de ciclism organizată în zona Greci, județul Tulcea, care pune accent pe distracție și fair play. Traseele sunt montane, solicitante, dar accesibile, oferind participanților o experiență autentică în natură. Evenimentul este destinat atât cicliștilor experimentați, cât și celor care doresc să se bucure de o zi activă în aer liber, într-un cadru prietenos și bine organizat.

name: Festivalul Sporturilor Iași
description: Festivalul Sporturilor Iași este un eveniment sportiv dedicat tuturor, de la începători la competitori avansați, desfășurat în orașul Iași și zonele limitrofe. Include probe diverse precum alergare pe potecă, mountain bike, orientare sportivă, alergare pe șosea, cursa copiilor și cursa persoanelor cu abilități speciale. Participanții se pot bucura de un weekend plin de mișcare, cu trasee provocatoare, cronometraj electronic și premii pentru categoriile Open. Festivalul promovează mișcarea pentru toată lumea, oferind și un trofeu multisport pentru cei care participă la toate probele. Startul și sosirea se desfășoară la Hotel La Castel și Palatul Culturii.

name: MARATON APUSENI
description: .msg Maraton Apuseni este un eveniment emblematic de alergare montană care se desfășoară în inima Munților Apuseni, oferind trasee variate pentru toate gusturile și nivelurile de experiență. Participanții pot alege între ultramaraton, maraton, semimaraton, cros și o cursă family, bucurându-se de peisaje pitorești, poteci umbrite, creste spectaculoase și sate tradiționale. Evenimentul sărbătorește 15 ani de tradiție și comunitate, fiind organizat cu pasiune de Clubul Alpin Român Filiala Cluj. Atmosfera de festival și provocarea sportivă se îmbină pentru a crea o experiență memorabilă în natură.

name: ROMANAȚI Trail Run, editia a V-a ~ 6 iunie 2026
description: Romanați Trail Run este o cursă vibrantă de alergare montană ce se desfășoară în Caracal, transformând orașul în capitala trail running-ului pentru o zi. Evenimentul oferă trei trasee provocatoare, potrivite pentru toate nivelurile de alergători, cu o atmosferă prietenoasă și o comunitate pasionată de mișcare. Cursa are un caracter sportiv și caritabil, promovând valorile sportului și spiritul de echipă. Startul competiției este programat la ora 10:00, iar participanții pot alege între semimaraton și două curse de cros.

name: Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail
description: Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail je trka koja se održava u čast prvog srpskog olimpijca, Dušana Miloševića, i trči se najlepšim stazama Rudnika. Trka je posvećena njegovoj hrabrosti i upornosti, a cilj je da se kroz trčanje oda počast njegovom nasleđu i srpskom duhu. Na raspolaganju su tri staze: brza i kraća Vihor staza, zahtevnija Rudnik staza sa strmim usponima i spustovima, i revijalna Domaćinska staza za one koji žele da uživaju u prirodi bez takmičenja. Trka je prilika za slavlje istorije, hrabrosti i zajedništva.

name: Serbia EPIC VRNJAČKA BANJA #4
description: UCI XCO trka u Andrevlju je uzbudljivo takmičenje koje okuplja elite i juniore u muškoj i ženskoj konkurenciji. Održava se ispred hotela Ceptor u prelepom ambijentu Andrevlja i traje četiri dana, pružajući vrhunsku atmosferu i intenzivnu konkurenciju. Takmičari mogu očekivati elektronsko merenje vremena, kompletnu markaciju staze i bogat takmičarski paket sa majicom, medaljom i osveženjem na stazi. Ovo je događaj koji kombinuje sportsku strast i prirodne lepote Srbije.

name: Global Day Run
description: Ο Global Day Run Patras 2026 είναι ένας φιλικός αγώνας δρόμου που διοργανώνεται στην Αγυιά της Πάτρας, με σκοπό να προωθήσει το τρέξιμο ως μέσο βελτίωσης της σωματικής και ψυχικής υγείας. Η διοργάνωση περιλαμβάνει αγώνες 8 χλμ, 4 χλμ και παιδικό αγώνα 1 χλμ, απευθυνόμενους κυρίως σε αρχάριους δρομείς και απλούς αθλούμενους που θέλουν να αθληθούν στη φύση με την παρέα τους. Ο αγώνας αποτελεί μέρος της παγκόσμιας γιορτής τρεξίματος, ενθαρρύνοντας τη συμμετοχή οικογενειών και φίλων χωρίς ανταγωνισμό. Η εκκίνηση γίνεται το απόγευμα του Σαββάτου 6 Ιουνίου 2026 στην παραλία της Αγυιάς.

name: Rhodo Rock
description: Rhodo Rock is a remarkable ultramarathon held in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains, near the town of Momchilgrad. This unique sporting event brings together participants from around the world who love the challenges of mountain trails and the beauty of nature. The race offers a variety of routes featuring peaks, valleys, rivers, and forest trails, suitable for both professional athletes and outdoor adventure enthusiasts. Participants can look forward to an exciting experience and an atmosphere that combines sport and nature.

name: Business Run Sofia
description: Business Run Sofia is the largest team-building event in Bulgaria, bringing together employees from different companies for a corporate relay race. Teams have 4 participants, each of whom runs 4 laps of 1.2 km, for a total of 4.8 km. In addition to the relay, there are also a Power Walk, CEO Dash, and Kids Run. Every participant receives insurance, a medal, and gifts. The event is a great opportunity to strengthen team bonds and enjoy active recreation with colleagues.

name: Tinca Cross
description: Tinca Cross este un concurs de alergare organizat de ACS Bihorul Oradea în parteneriat cu Primăria Tinca și Consiliul Local, ce se desfășoară în data de 7 iunie 2026. Evenimentul include probe de cros pe distanțele de 5 km și 10 km, potrivite pentru alergători de anduranță cu vârsta minimă de 14 ani. Traseul pornește de pe stadionul comunal Tinca și se desfășoară pe o buclă de 2,5 km în pădurea aferentă stadionului, cu finish pe stadion. Participanții sub 18 ani au nevoie de acordul scris al unui părinte sau tutore. Se oferă premii în bani și diplome pentru locurile fruntașe.

name: Village Trail
description: Village Trail 2026 je treća po redu trka koja se održava u Višnjici, na periferiji Beograda, 7. juna 2026. godine. Trka nudi spoj sporta, prirode i avanture, sa dve staze koje vode kroz prelepe pejzaže, uključujući vidikovac sa pogledom na Dunav i Beograd. Start i cilj su kod restorana Dunavska terasa, a događaj je pogodan za iskusne trkače i početnike. Pored trke, za najmlađe i porodice je obezbeđen animacioni program, dok trkače očekuje podrška volontera i after-run žurka.

name: 1ο Vlasti Wind Trail
description: Ο αγώνας Vlasti Wind Trail είναι μια ξεχωριστή διοργάνωση ορεινού τρεξίματος που λαμβάνει χώρα στο φυσικό περιβάλλον της Βλάστης Κοζάνης. Συνδυάζει την αθλητική εμπειρία με την προώθηση της αρμονικής συνύπαρξης ανθρώπου και φύσης, δίνοντας έμφαση στις Ανανεώσιμες Πηγές Ενέργειας και τη βιώσιμη ανάπτυξη. Η διοργάνωση αποτελεί γιορτή βιωσιμότητας και τοπικής συνεργασίας, ενισχύοντας την τοπική κοινωνία και προβάλλοντας την αξία της καθαρής ενέργειας. Οι διαδρομές προσφέρουν μια μοναδική εμπειρία σε ένα πανέμορφο φυσικό τοπίο, με σεβασμό στο περιβάλλον και την τοπική παράδοση.

name: 2ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Κουρούτας
description: Ο 2ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Κουρούτας 2026 προσκαλεί δρομείς να τρέξουν σε μια διαδρομή όπου ο δρόμος συναντά το κύμα, προσφέροντας μοναδική θέα στο Αιγαίο. Ο αγώνας περιλαμβάνει διαδρομές 10 χλμ, 4.300 μ. και παιδικό αγώνα 1.000 μ., με ηλεκτρονική χρονομέτρηση και συλλεκτικό μετάλλιο για όλους τους τερματίσαντες. Η διοργάνωση εξασφαλίζει ιατρική κάλυψη από τον Ερυθρό Σταυρό και κυκλοφοριακή ασφάλεια από την Τροχαία Αμαλιάδας και εθελοντές. Η εκκίνηση και οι απονομές γίνονται στην Κεντρική Πλατεία Κουρούτας, δημιουργώντας μια φιλόξενη ατμόσφαιρα για όλους τους συμμετέχοντες.

name: 2o Sykourio Trail
organizer: Δήμος Τεμπών και ο Σύλλογος Εμποροβιοτεχνών Συκουρίου
description: Ο 2ος αγώνας Sykourio Trail είναι ένας αγώνας ορεινού τρεξίματος που διοργανώνεται στην περιοχή Συκούριο του δήμου Τεμπών, στον Κίσσαβο, στις 7 Ιουνίου 2026. Περιλαμβάνει τρεις διαδρομές διαφορετικής δυσκολίας και μήκους, που διασχίζουν μονοπάτια, χωματόδρομους και άσφαλτο, προσφέροντας μια ολοκληρωμένη εμπειρία ορεινού τρεξίματος. Ο αγώνας απευθύνεται σε δρομείς όλων των ηλικιών, με ειδική διαδρομή για παιδιά εντός του οικισμού. Η διοργάνωση εξασφαλίζει ηλεκτρονική χρονομέτρηση, τροφοδοσία και υδροδοσία κατά τη διάρκεια της διαδρομής και στον τερματισμό.

name: 4ος Συκάρειος Δρόμος
description: Ο 4ος Συκάρειος Δρόμος είναι ένας αγώνας δρόμου που διεξάγεται στο Κρυονέρι Αττικής την Κυριακή 7 Ιουνίου 2026. Προσφέρει δύο αποστάσεις, 15 χλμ. και 5,5 χλμ., με εκκίνηση και τερματισμό στην Πύλη Δημοτικής Ενότητας Κρυονερίου. Ο αγώνας απευθύνεται σε δρομείς διαφόρων ηλικιών και προσφέρει αναμνηστικά μετάλλια σε όλους τους τερματίσαντες, καθώς και βραβεία στους πρώτους άνδρες και γυναίκες. Η διοργάνωση δίνει έμφαση στην ασφάλεια και την υποστήριξη των δρομέων με σταθμούς τροφοδοσίας κατά μήκος της διαδρομής.

name: 4ο Argithea Mountain Race
description: Ο 4ος Argithea Mountain Race είναι ένας απαιτητικός ορεινός αγώνας που διεξάγεται στην περιοχή του Πετρίτου, Καρδίτσας, στις 7 Ιουνίου 2026. Περιλαμβάνει διάφορες διαδρομές, όπως το Argithea Skyrace 30 χλμ με 2000 μ. υψομετρική διαφορά, τον αγώνα Vlachogiannis 15 χλμ με 700 μ. ανάβαση, καθώς και οικογενειακό αγώνα 5 χλμ και παιδικό αγώνα 1 χλμ. Υπάρχει επίσης η διαδρομή Lakos Vertical 3,6 χλμ με 700 μ. ανάβαση που προσφέρει μοναδική εμπειρία σε μονοπάτια μέσα σε ελατόδασος με θέα τις κορυφές των Αγράφων. Ο αγώνας προσελκύει δρομείς που αγαπούν το βουνό και την πρόκληση, προσφέροντας παράλληλα και δραστηριότητες για όλη την οικογένεια.

name: 5ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Aqua Mare
description: Ο 5ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Aqua Mare διοργανώνεται στα Μέγαρα, με εκκίνηση και τερματισμό στην παραλία Βαρέα, μπροστά από το beach bar AQUA MARE. Οι συμμετέχοντες έχουν τη δυνατότητα να επιλέξουν ανάμεσα σε δύο διαδρομές, 10 χλμ. και 5,3 χλμ., τρέχοντας δίπλα στο κύμα σε μια όμορφη παραθαλάσσια διαδρομή. Η διοργάνωση προσφέρει μια ευχάριστη αθλητική εμπειρία με δωρεάν μεταφορά και συλλεκτικό μπλουζάκι για τους δρομείς. Η εκκίνηση γίνεται νωρίς το πρωί, δημιουργώντας μια ημέρα γεμάτη αδρεναλίνη και χαλάρωση.

name: 6ο Raches Run
description: Ο 6ος Raches Run - Agroinvest είναι μια αθλητική εκδήλωση που διοργανώνεται από τον Διαδραστικό Σύλλογο Ραχών ΑΛΟΠΗ στην παραλία Ραχών Φθιώτιδας. Περιλαμβάνει αγώνες δρόμου 10.000 μέτρων, 5.000 μέτρων και 1.000 μέτρων για παιδιά, προάγοντας τον αθλητισμό και την κοινωνική αλληλεγγύη. Ο αγώνας αναδεικνύει την ομορφιά και την ιστορία της περιοχής, ενώ ενισχύει τη σύνδεση των συμμετεχόντων με το χωριό και την τοπική κοινότητα.

name: Artemida Sunset Run
description: Ο Artemida Sunset Run είναι ο πρώτος αγώνας δρόμου που διοργανώνεται στην Αρτέμιδα, προσφέροντας διαδρομές 5 και 10 χιλιομέτρων κατά το ηλιοβασίλεμα. Οι διαδρομές είναι προκαθορισμένες και οριοθετημένες σε δημόσιους δρόμους, με εκκίνηση και τερματισμό στο Δημοτικό Γήπεδο Αρτέμιδος. Η διοργάνωση περιλαμβάνει ηλεκτρονική χρονομέτρηση, μετάλλια συμμετοχής, μπλουζάκι διοργάνωσης και βραβεύσεις ανά ηλικιακή κατηγορία. Ο αγώνας απευθύνεται σε δρομείς ηλικίας από 15 ετών και άνω, με όριο συμμετοχών 300 δρομείς συνολικά για τις δύο αποστάσεις.

name: Kilkis Trail
description: Ο αγώνας Kilkis Trail διοργανώνεται από τον Σύλλογο Δρομέων Υγείας Κιλκίς και προσφέρει μια ποικιλία διαδρομών, συμπεριλαμβανομένου του κύριου trail 20 χιλιομέτρων, ενός δρόμου υγείας 4,8 χλμ, σκυταλοδρομίας 4x4,8 χλμ και παιδικού αγώνα 1 χλμ. Η διαδρομή του Kilkis Trail κινείται σε μονοπάτια και χωματόδρομους γύρω από την πόλη του Κιλκίς, με μικρές κλίσεις και τεχνικά σημεία, καλύπτοντας υψομετρική διαφορά περίπου 850 μέτρων. Η εκκίνηση και ο τερματισμός γίνονται στον θερινό κινηματογράφο Κιλκίς, προσφέροντας μια όμορφη και απαιτητική εμπειρία για τους δρομείς. Ο αγώνας πραγματοποιείται την Κυριακή 7 Ιουνίου 2026 και είναι ανοιχτός σε δρομείς όλων των επιπέδων.

name: Pedală în Bănie ~ 2026
description: Pedală în Bănie este un eveniment sportiv cu tradiție în regiunea Dolj, dedicat pasionaților de mountain bike și alergare trail. Evenimentul, desfășurat în zona Palilula din Craiova, oferă trasee inspirate de tema „JURASSIC”, cu provocări care testează forța, viteza și rezistența participanților. Cu curse variate pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile, Pedală în Bănie promovează sănătatea, spiritul comunitar și protecția mediului, fiind o experiență completă de competiție și aventură în natură. Atmosfera prietenoasă și organizarea atentă fac din acest eveniment o sărbătoare a sportului și a mișcării în aer liber.

name: Тепе Джамборе 2026 Tepe Jambore
location: Летен театър, Пловдив, Пловдивска област, България
description: Tepe Jambore is a sports and cultural marathon in Plovdiv, combining running, movement, and culture across the city center and its hills. The event offers a unique urban adventure with artistic and cultural performances, including jazz music, theater, and dance, turning running into a celebration of sport and culture. The routes pass through landmark city locations, hills, paths, and green spaces, and are suitable for all ages and fitness levels. This is not a standard race, but an experience that brings the community together and supports causes for people facing social disadvantage.
course_highlights: Champions’ Jambore — 13 km with 450 meters of elevation gain, passing over all of Plovdiv’s hills
Laid-Back Jambore — 7 km with 250 meters of elevation gain
Kids’ Jambore — 1 km in Bunardzhik Park, on a safe route in a supervised environment
additional: The event includes cultural stops featuring theater, music, dance, beer and wine with snacks, performers, and surprises. The start-finish area hosts a party with music and entertainment. Participants can volunteer with the Jambore Squad, helping support participants and the event organization. Corporate teams take part in a competition that celebrates team spirit and raises donations for the “Plovdiv112” volunteer formation. The routes include 13 km, 7 km, and 1 km options; the event is part of Plovdiv’s 2026 cultural calendar and offers entertainment for the whole family.

name: ДИВОТО ЗОВЕ МАДЖАРОВО 2026
description: Wild Calls Madzharovo is an annual event combining cycling and trail running in the scenic Eastern Rhodopes. It takes place in the town of Madzharovo, situated in the crater of an ancient volcano and surrounded by unique natural landscapes and historic landmarks. The courses offer a variety of distances and challenges suitable for both recreational and elite athletes. Organized by the Dimitar Madzharov Cycling Club, the event aims to showcase the region’s beauty and bring sports enthusiasts together in a spirit of adventure and respect for nature.
course_highlights: Trail running with up to 900 m of elevation gain and panoramic views of Botev Peak
Routes passing through dense forests and old trails, and near a waterfall
Unique natural scenery in a volcanic crater, close to the Arda River and its striking meanders
additional: Start and finish at the square in front of the Municipality in Madzharovo. Services include chip timing, mountain rescue, emergency medical assistance, a tasty lunch in the festival area, and the option to camp in the Arda River canyon or at a campsite in the town park. Multiple MTB, duathlon, and trail running distances; starts on June 13 and 14, 2026, including children’s races and eco activities.

name: Национален шампионат под 14г
description: The National Championship for under-14 competitors in Gabrovo is a two-day athletics event that brings together more than 300 young athletes from across the country. Held at Hristo Botev Stadium, it gives the youngest talents an opportunity to compete in classic track and field events. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sports calendar and takes place alongside the international Nikola Valchanov Tournament. It is a significant event that supports the development of young athletes and promotes athletics in the region.

name: Турнир "Никола Вълчанов"
description: The Nikola Valchanov Athletics Tournament in Gabrovo is a traditional sporting event held at Aprilov Stadium. It features 17 events, including sprint races and shot put, for age groups ranging from under 14 to men and women. The organizers are Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATHLET athletics club. The event attracts both young and experienced athletes and opens officially at 11:00.

name: Отвъд Мостъ / Beyond the Bridge
description: Beyond the Bridge is a unique bike-and-run event in Lovech that combines a sporting challenge with historical and natural landmarks. Participants cross four iconic bridges and follow scenic routes that include the Devetashko Plateau, the Kakrina Inn, Hisarya Fortress, and the Bash Bunar and Stratesh parks. The event is suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners, with 20% of the fees going to a charitable cause. It’s an opportunity to enjoy nature and history and experience an unforgettable adventure.

description: The Northern Marathon is a sporting event that brings together nature and spirit in northern Romania, offering spectacular routes for runners of all levels. The event promotes health, community, and adventure, taking place amid the impressive natural landscapes of Botoșani and its surroundings. Participants can choose from several races, including marathon, trail, and MTB, enjoying a complete experience that combines sport with tourism and local culture.
course_highlights: Spectacular routes through northern Romania
A variety of races: marathon, trail, and MTB
Natural landscapes and authentic local communities

The organizer will decide whether race-day registrations will be allowed and will announce this in advance. Spectacular routes, outdoor event, community participation

name: Retezat Sky Race
description: Retezat SkyRace este o cursă de skyrunning desfășurată în peisajul spectaculos al Munților Retezat din România, oferind alergătorilor o experiență provocatoare pe trasee montane tehnice și variate. Evenimentul combină provocările terenului accidentat cu frumusețea naturală a crestelor, văilor și lacurilor alpine, fiind dedicat pasionaților de alergare montană și aventură. Organizată cu atenție la siguranță și respect pentru mediu, cursa oferă o comunitate pasionată și oportunități de socializare și autodepășire. Pe 13 iunie 2026, participanții vor putea experimenta o adevărată aventură montană în inima Retezatului.

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului (Deda)
description: Maraton Scaunul Domnului este o cursă montană provocatoare desfășurată în Rezervația Naturală Scaunul Domnului, aproape de Deda, Mureș. Evenimentul oferă mai multe probe, inclusiv maraton de 42 km, semimaraton de 21 km, cros de 10 km, precum și curse pentru familii și copii. Traseele combină urcări susținute, drumuri forestiere și segmente cu priveliști spectaculoase, fiind potrivite pentru alergători montani dornici de aventură și natură. Siguranța este o prioritate, cu verificări obligatorii de echipament și puncte de control pe traseu.

name: Maratonul Sării
description: Maratonul Sării este un eveniment sportiv care combină alergarea și ciclismul mountainbike, desfășurat în peisajul natural și istoric al orașului Târgu Ocna, județul Bacău. Participanții pot alege între curse de trail running de 10 km și 21 km, precum și o cursă de mountainbike de 30 km, toate având startul și finishul în Piața Primăriei. Un element unic al competiției este parcurgerea unui segment de 7 km prin galeriile subterane ale Salinei Târgu Ocna, oferind o experiență inedită și beneficii pentru sănătate datorită aerului ionizat. Evenimentul promovează un stil de viață activ și responsabil față de natură, implicând și acțiuni de plogging pentru ecologizarea traseelor.

name: Maraton Tarcău
location: Mănăstirea Tarcău, comuna Tarcău, jud. Neamţ
description: Maraton Tarcău este o competiție anuală desfășurată în peisajul natural al zonei Tarcău, Neamț, care oferă probe de maraton, semimaraton și cros. Evenimentul pune accent pe pregătirea fizică și echipamentul adecvat, asigurând o experiență sportivă completă și sigură. Participanții pot beneficia de kitul de participare oferit cu o zi înainte de concurs și trebuie să respecte regulamentul oficial al competiției. Timpurile limită pentru parcurgerea traseelor sunt bine stabilite pentru fiecare probă, asigurând un ritm competitiv și organizat.
