name: Semimaratonul Eroilor Invictus
description: Semimaratonul Eroilor Invictus, care va avea loc pe 23 mai 2026 în Bistrița, este un eveniment sportiv dedicat comemorării Zilei Eroilor și promovării activităților sportive de masă. Evenimentul aduce împreună comunitatea locală și sportivii amatori, oferind o cursă de semimaraton și alte probe sportive. Traseul pornește din Piața Centrală și străbate principalele artere ale orașului, fiind organizat sub patronajul Principelui Radu și cu sprijinul mai multor instituții și asociații locale. Participanții sunt încurajați să citească regulamentul, să se înscrie și să doneze pentru susținerea cauzei.

name: Atinge OMU
description: Atinge Omu este un concurs de alergare montană ce se desfășoară în Munții Bucegi, pe traseul Peștera - Vf. Omu - Peștera. Evenimentul are loc în prima decadă a lunii iunie, când peisajul este dominat de culmile înroșite de rododendron. Cursa oferă alergătorilor o combinație de intensitate și frumusețe naturală, iar la final participanții sunt răsplătiți cu bulz perpelit și jintiță. Este o experiență montană autentică, cu startul de la telecabina Peștera și o atmosferă prietenoasă și tradițională.

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului
description: Maraton Scaunul Domnului este o cursă montană provocatoare ce se desfășoară în Rezervația Naturală Scaunul Domnului, în apropiere de Bistra Mureșului. Evenimentul oferă mai multe probe, inclusiv maraton de 42 km cu diferență de nivel de peste 2100 m, semimaraton, cros de 10 km, precum și curse pentru familii și copii. Traseul maratonului trece prin peisaje spectaculoase, cu puncte de alimentare și control, și include porțiuni de drum forestier, trasee nemarcate și zone cu belvedere. Siguranța este o prioritate, cu verificare obligatorie a echipamentului și timpi limita pentru fiecare probă. Atmosfera este completată de festivități de premiere și un foc de tabără după concurs.

name: The Color Run Iași
description: The Color Run Iași 2026 este o cursă de 5 kilometri necronometrată, plină de culoare și energie pozitivă, care celebrează sănătatea, bucuria și originalitatea. Participanții pornesc în haine albe și sunt colorați cu pudră la fiecare kilometru, terminând cursa într-un nor vibrant de culori. Evenimentul are loc în fața Palatului Culturii din Iași și oferă o atmosferă de festival cu muzică și distracție pentru toate vârstele, fiind perfect pentru o zi memorabilă alături de prieteni și familie. Este o experiență accesibilă tuturor, inclusiv copiilor și persoanelor cu dizabilități, cu opțiuni de înscriere gratuite sau cu kit complet.

name: PENIEL TRAIL RUN
description: Peniel Trail Run este un eveniment de alergare în natură, desfășurat pe trasee de trail în zona Bistrița, care promovează sănătatea prin mișcare, comunitate și adevăr. Evenimentul oferă curse pentru toate nivelurile, de la semimaraton pentru alergătorii experimentați, la curse de 10 km și 5 km, precum și o cursă pentru copii. Peniel Trail Run este mai mult decât o competiție sportivă, fiind o chemare la o viață trăită deplin pentru trup, minte și duh, cu un mesaj profund de direcție și relație vie cu Dumnezeu. Numele Peniel simbolizează „locul întâlnirii”, unde sportul, comunitatea și credința se întâlnesc autentic și relevant pentru generația de astăzi.

name: Stara Planina 2026
description: Stara Planina Skijanje 2026 je četvorodnevni zimski program koji nudi skijanje, sankanje, šetnje i druženje na netaknutoj prirodi Stare planine. Uživajte u adrenalinu i prelepim pejzažima na skijalištu Babin zub sa preko 13 kilometara uređenih staza različitih težina, uključujući stazu za slobodnu vožnju i sistem veštačkog osnežavanja. Program je namenjen skijašima i ljubiteljima zimskih sportova, sa polaskom iz Beograda i Niša i smeštajem u konaku Ždrma. U slučaju manjka snega, organizuju se pešačke ture, čineći ovaj događaj dostupnim i za one koji vole prirodu i aktivan odmor.

name: 5ο Livadia Night Run
description: Το 5ο Livadia Night Run είναι ένας νυχτερινός αγώνας δρόμου που διεξάγεται στη Λιβαδειά, κοντά στις πηγές Erkinas στην περιοχή Κρύα. Ο αγώνας περιλαμβάνει τρεις αποστάσεις: 10 km κύριος αγώνας, 5 km και 1 km για μαθητές, καλύπτοντας όλες τις ηλικίες και επίπεδα δρομέων. Η εκκίνηση γίνεται στις 20:00 και η χρονομέτρηση γίνεται με ηλεκτρονικό chip από την CHRONOLOG. Ο αγώνας διοργανώνεται από τον Athletic Swimming Club of Livadeia σε συνεργασία με τον Δήμο Λιβαδειάς, προσφέροντας μια τοπική αθλητική εμπειρία σε ένα όμορφο φυσικό περιβάλλον.

name: 5ο Olympic Day Run
description: Ο 5ος Αγώνας Olympic Day Run στην Αρχαία Ολυμπία είναι ένα μοναδικό και επίσημο Ολυμπιακό δρομικό γεγονός που τιμά την Ελλάδα ως γενέτειρα των Ολυμπιακών Αγώνων. Ο αγώνας φέρνει κοντά Ολυμπιονίκες, Παραολυμπιονίκες και διακεκριμένους αθλητές, δημιουργώντας μια μεγάλη Ολυμπιακή δρομική ομάδα. Η διοργάνωση περιλαμβάνει αγώνες δρόμου 8.000μ, 4.000μ και 1.500μ, με διαδρομές που περνούν μέσα από τον αρχαιολογικό χώρο και το αρχαίο στάδιο της Ολυμπίας, προσφέροντας μια μοναδική αθλητική και πολιτιστική εμπειρία. Η εκδήλωση πραγματοποιείται υπό την αιγίδα της Ελληνικής Ολυμπιακής Επιτροπής και άλλων σημαντικών φορέων, με στόχο την ανάδειξη της Ολυμπιακής κληρονομιάς.

name: 10ο Πέρασμα Του Αποστόλου Παύλου
organizer: Δημο Πυδνας Κολινδρου και Αθλητικός Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Δρομέων Ν. Πιερίας «ΥΓΕΣ»
description: Ο 10ος Επετειακός Αγώνας Δρόμου «Το Πέρασμα του Αποστόλου Παύλου» διοργανώνεται από την Ιερά Μητρόπολη Κίτρους, Κατερίνης και Πλαταμώνος, τον Δήμο Πύδνας Κολινδρού και τον Αθλητικό Πολιτιστικό Σύλλογο Δρομέων Ν. Πιερίας «ΖΕΥΣ». Ο αγώνας έχει μήκος 10.000 μέτρα και διεξάγεται σε ασφαλτοστρωμένη διαδρομή που περνά μέσα από τα χωριά Μεθώνης και Μακρυγιάλου. Η εκκίνηση γίνεται από τον Ιερό Ναό Αποστόλου Παύλου στην κεντρική πλατεία Μεθώνης και ο τερματισμός στην Αρχαία Πύδνα. Πρόκειται για μια όμορφη διαδρομή με μικρές ανηφόρες και κατηφόρες, σηματοδοτημένη σε όλο το μήκος της.

name: Triglav Skyrun
description: Triglav Skyrun is a unique mountain race held in Central Balkan National Park, Bulgaria. The course passes three iconic mountain huts—Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka—and includes a climb to the third-highest peak in the Balkan Mountains, Golyam Kademliya (2,275.4 m). The race offers three distances of varying difficulty, all starting from the picturesque village of Tazha, the starting point for all three routes. This event is for lovers of mountain running and nature, combining challenge with the beauty of the wild mountains.

name: Бягай бос с усмивка
description: Run Barefoot with a Smile is a unique event held in picturesque Belogradchik. The course offers the opportunity to run barefoot, combining sport and enjoyment amid nature. The event is suitable for anyone who wants to experience the freedom and joy of running without shoes in beautiful, inspiring surroundings.

name: Crosul Supereroilor
description: The Superheroes Run is an energizing race that brings together thousands of participants in Cluj-Napoca as part of Sports Festival. The event promotes team spirit and fun, offering a unique sporting experience in the heart of the city. Participants can enjoy a vibrant atmosphere and challenges on routes adapted for all ages and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Urban route in the Cluj Arena area
Part of Sports Festival
Friendly, energizing atmosphere for all ages
additional: The 2025 edition took place at Cluj Arena, and half of the registration fee was donated to the Via Transilvanica project of the Tășuleasa Social Association. Registration details and the fee for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Topoloveni Summer Tour ~ 2026
description: Topoloveni Summer Tour este un eveniment dedicat cicliștilor amatori din România, organizat de Riders Club. Participanții pot alege să se bucure de o plimbare în aer liber sau să concureze pentru a-și câștiga locul în clasamentele naționale de ciclism pentru amatori. Traseul este pregătit cu grijă pentru a proteja mediul natural, iar marcajele vor fi limitate pentru a respecta pădurile și zonele naturale. Evenimentul oferă oportunități pentru toate vârstele, inclusiv curse pentru copii și opțiuni pentru familii cu discounturi speciale. În cazul condițiilor meteo nefavorabile, cursa poate fi reprogramată pentru o dată de rezervă.

name: Run for Heroes
description: Run for Heroes este o cursă caritabilă anuală care se desfășoară pe 14 iunie 2026 în Parcul Herăstrău, București, pe Șoseaua Kiseleff. Evenimentul aduce împreună alergători de toate vârstele, familii și animale de companie pentru a susține servicii gratuite de psihoterapie. Traseele sunt accesibile și prietenoase, cu o atmosferă plină de energie, distracție și solidaritate, unde fiecare kilometru alergat contribuie la o cauză nobilă. Participanții primesc kituri tematice de supereroi și se bucură de o zi completă de activități sportive și recreative.

name: Sunrise Marathon
description: Sunrise Marathon u Bačkoj Palanci je događaj koji podržava misiju Sunrise Association, organizacije koja pruža besplatne letnje dnevne kampove za decu obolelu od raka i njihove braće i sestre. Trkači se pozivaju da se pridruže Team Sunrise i kroz trčanje i prikupljanje sredstava doprinesu vraćanju radosti i sreće deci koja se bore sa ovom bolešću. Učešćem u trci, učesnici dobijaju priliku da podrže jedinstvene programe i kampove koji donose osmehe i nadu deci širom sveta.

name: Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail pruža jedinstveno iskustvo trčanja uz reku Gradac, poznatu po svojoj netaknutoj prirodi i kristalno čistoj vodi. Staza vodi kroz kanjon bogat divljim životinjama i raznovrsnim terenima, uključujući šumske staze, kamenite obale i prelaze preko potoka. Ova trka je spoj prirodne raskoši i avanture, idealna za trkače koji žele da iskuse trail trčanje u njegovom najživopisnijem obliku. Održava se u Valjevu, Srbiji, i deo je serijala West Serbia Trails koji povezuje planine, reke i doline zapadne Srbije.

name: 9. Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail je deo serije West Serbia Trails događaja koji se održavaju u prelepim prirodnim pejzažima zapadne Srbije. Ova trka nudi staze od 10 km i 19 km koje vode pored reke Gradac, jedne od najčistijih reka u Evropi, poznate po netaknutoj prirodi. Učesnici imaju priliku da iskuse netaknutu prirodu Srbije, trčeći kroz šumske i planinske predele koji su često dostupni samo pešacima. Ovaj događaj je idealan za ljubitelje trčanja i prirode koji žele da testiraju svoje sposobnosti u autentičnom ambijentu.

name: 8ο Γράμμος Mountain Run
description: Ο 8ος Grammos Mountain Run είναι ένας απαιτητικός αγώνας ορεινού τρεξίματος που διεξάγεται στην πανέμορφη περιοχή των Μαστοροχωρίων, στο χωριό Πληκάτι του Δήμου Κόνιτσας. Περιλαμβάνει δύο διαδρομές, 21 χλμ. και 10 χλμ., με εκκίνηση και τερματισμό στην πλατεία του χωριού. Η διαδρομή των 21 χλμ. κινείται στην κορυφογραμμή της οροσειράς του Γράμμου με συνολική υψομετρική διαφορά πάνω από 1680 μέτρα, προσφέροντας μια μοναδική εμπειρία σε δρομείς με καλή φυσική κατάσταση και εμπειρία σε ορεινό περιβάλλον. Ο αγώνας ξεκινά στις 10:00 π.μ. για τα 21 χλμ. και στις 10:30 π.μ. για τα 10 χλμ., με πλήρη υποστήριξη και παροχές στους συμμετέχοντες.

name: Зелените пирамиди 2026 - бягане и колоездене
organizer: Колездачен клуб „Берое“ и Творчески колектив „На улицата“
description: Green Pyramids 2026 is the third edition of a running and cycling event held in Bedечka Park and on the southern slopes of Sredna Gora near Stara Zagora. The event offers a range of distances for children and adults, including a trail half marathon, and is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival. The courses pass by the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the Green Pyramids and are suitable for different fitness levels. Participants receive a race pack with a race number and course support.
course_highlights: 21 km trail half marathon passing the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the “Green Pyramids”
Cross-country cycling routes of 21, 33 and 65 km near the city
Routes of varying difficulty, suitable for all fitness levels
additional: Participation is free for children up to 12 years old. The event is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival, June 19–21, in Bedечka Park. The 33 km route is ridden twice for the 65 km distance. The 33 km and 65 km routes are part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation’s Bulgaria Cup, with different categories. The festival includes sporting competitions, workshops, music, cinema and food; a new location has been added—the Cypress Grove.

name: Национален шампионат
description: The XVI Bulgarian National Folklore Championship “Euro Folk 2026” takes place in Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria. This is a traditional event organized by the European Association of Folklore Festivals (EAFF), with the aim of preserving, developing, and promoting Bulgarian and European folklore through festivals and competitions. The championship includes various categories such as dance, choirs, songs, orchestras, and customs, with an emphasis on authentic and arranged folklore performances. The event is part of EAFF’s long-standing tradition and is held annually in the historic Bulgarian capital, Veliko Tarnovo.

name: Roșia Montană Marathon
description: Roșia Montană Marathon is a sporting, environmental, and socio-cultural event held in the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană, Alba County. The 13th edition, in 2026, celebrates the area’s nature, history, and cultural heritage, offering a variety of routes for runners of all levels. Races include a marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and children’s race, on courses that combine mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and historic architecture in a setting that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes with elevation changes on mountain trails and local roads
A mix of mountain and road running
Natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage
additional: The event takes place from 19–21 June 2026, with race-kit pickup at Central Square on the day before the race. The programme also includes cultural and social activities, such as creative workshops and concerts. The routes are designed for both mountain and road runners. The event features cultural and environmental activities, community projects, and educational initiatives, offering an opportunity to support the area’s natural and cultural heritage.

name: Maratonul Roșia Montană - Cursa Copiilor ~ 2026
description: Maratonul Roșia Montană este o sărbătoare a naturii, istoriei și patrimoniului cultural, desfășurată în inima Munților Apuseni, în comuna Roșia Montană. Traseele variate, ce includ cărări montane, drumuri comunale și porțiuni asfaltate, oferă o experiență unică atât alergătorilor montani, cât și celor de alergare stradală. Evenimentul include curse pentru toate vârstele, inclusiv Cursa Copiilor, care se desfășoară pe trasee adaptate pe categorii de vârstă, în centrul istoric al localității. Participanții pot admira pe parcurs peisajele naturale și patrimoniul arhitectural vechi de secole.

name: Crosul Hoia
description: Crosul Hoia GlobalLogic este o cursă de alergare organizată în Cluj-Napoca, care oferă participanților oportunitatea de a alerga pe potecile răcoroase din Pădurea Hoia. Evenimentul include probe de 15 km, 7 km, 3 km și o probă dedicată familiilor, fiind potrivit pentru alergători de toate vârstele și nivelurile. Organizatorii Runners Club promovează o atmosferă prietenoasă și susțin comunitatea locală de alergători. Crosul are loc în iunie, schimbând asfaltul urban cu natura și oferind o experiență de alergare în aer liber.

name: Urlea Super Vertical
location: Sat. Breaza, Com. Lisa, Jud. Brașov
description: Urlea Super Vertical este o cursă montană extremă, ce se desfășoară în peisajele sălbatice ale Munților Făgăraș, oferind o experiență unică de alergare verticală și coborâre intensă. Este prima și singura ștafetă sus-jos din România, unde un partener urcă și celălalt coboară, adăugând un element inovator și spectaculos competiției. Traseul de 12 km cu o diferență de nivel de 1833 m pune la încercare atât rezistența, cât și tehnica alergătorilor, pe drum forestier, poteci prin păduri și pășuni alpine. Evenimentul este dedicat celor care caută adrenalină pură și o provocare montană intensă, cu un sistem revoluționar de premiere care recompensează performanța individuală și pe echipe.

name: Maratonul Târnavei
description: Maratonul Târnavei este un eveniment de trail running organizat de Asociația Târnăveni Cycling în colaborare cu Ruck Ventilatoare, desfășurat în municipiul Târnaveni, județul Mureș. Ajuns la a 10-a ediție, maratonul promovează un stil de viață sănătos și alergarea în natură, având ca scop creșterea educației ecologice și conștientizarea beneficiilor sportului în aer liber. Startul și finish-ul sunt amplasate în incinta companiei Ruck Ventilatoare, iar competiția include mai multe trasee de trail running pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile. Evenimentul reunește o comunitate de sportivi pasionați de alergare și respect față de mediul înconjurător.

name: Ultramaraton Palić
description: Ultramaraton Palić je državno i međunarodno prvenstvo u ultramaratonu koje se održava u Paliću, pod organizacijom Ultramaratonskog saveza Srbije. Trka obuhvata više disciplina: 6, 12 i 24-časovne trke, kao i trke na 50 km i 100 km, sa startom i ciljem na Velikoj terasi. Takmičenje je namenjeno svim ultramaratoncima koji poštuju pravila, a učesnici se takmiče u apsolutnoj i uzrasnim kategorijama. Pored takmičarskog duha, trka nudi bogatu okretu stanicu, zajednički ručak i nagrade za najbolje, kao i specijalne nagrade za najmlađeg i najstarijeg učesnika.

name: Trka prijateljstva Kula
description: Trka prijateljstva u Kuli je tradicionalna manifestacija koja se održava od 2009. godine i promoviše sport, prijateljstvo, porodične vrednosti i rekreaciju. Ova trka okuplja amaterske, rekreativne i profesionalne trkače iz regiona i šire, stvarajući jedinstvenu zajednicu trkača. Tokom godina, trka je postala najmasovniji sportski događaj u opštini Kula, sa preko 6.000 učesnika i ukupno pretrčanih 34.000 kilometara. Organizatori kontinuirano unapređuju događaj, nagrade i organizaciju kako bi trka bila još bolja i privlačnija za sve učesnike.

name: 9ο Koufalia Hill Run «Δήμητρα Ιορδανίδου»
description: Ο αγώνας Koufalia Hill Run «Δήμητρα Ιορδανίδου» είναι μια ξεχωριστή διοργάνωση που συνδυάζει τη φυσική ομορφιά του λόφου των Κουφαλίων με την αθλητική πρόκληση. Περιλαμβάνει διαδρομές 6 και 10 χιλιομέτρων κυρίως σε χωμάτινα μονοπάτια μέσα σε πευκοδάσος, με ανηφόρες και κατηφόρες που προσφέρουν μοναδικές εικόνες, όπως το μοναστήρι του Γρηγορίου Παλαμά και το σπήλαιο του Γκαβάνα. Ο αγώνας έχει οικογενειακό χαρακτήρα, με παράλληλες εκδηλώσεις για παιδιά και γονείς, και στόχο την προώθηση του αθλητισμού και της επαφής με τη φύση στην τοπική κοινότητα. Η διοργάνωση τιμά τη μνήμη της Δήμητρας Ιορδανίδου, που εμπνεύστηκε τον αγώνα και τον καθιέρωσε ως θεσμό.

name: Beyond Kerkini Running Experience
description: Το Beyond Kerkini Running Experience είναι ένας μοναδικός αγώνας δρόμου που διεξάγεται στο Λιμανάκι Λιθοτόπου, δίπλα στη λίμνη Κερκίνη. Προσφέρει διαδρομές που συνδυάζουν διαφορετικά τοπία και τερέν, από επίπεδες ασφάλτινες διαδρομές μέχρι απαιτητικά ορεινά μονοπάτια. Κάθε διαδρομή προσφέρει μια ξεχωριστή οπτική εμπειρία στο φυσικό κάλλος της περιοχής, με την ευκαιρία να τρέξετε ανάμεσα σε νερόβραχους και τοπία που εναλλάσσονται από το ξημέρωμα μέχρι το ηλιοβασίλεμα. Η διοργάνωση περιλαμβάνει επίσης δωρεάν δράσεις για οικογένειες και παιδιά, καθιστώντας το γεγονός μια ολοήμερη αθλητική εμπειρία για όλους.

name: PIRIN RUN
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site. The race offers several distances for skyrunning and mountain-running enthusiasts, with impressive views and challenging terrain. Participants can enjoy a unique experience in Bulgaria’s natural surroundings, combining sport and adventure. The event takes place in Bansko and attracts runners from around the world.

name: XL kmrun - Парк Врана
description: XL Vrana is a race on the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun and held in Vrana Park in Sofia. The course is well known and consists of a loop approximately 5 km long with minimal elevation gain. Participants can choose between three distances—short (5 km), medium (10 km), and long (15 km)—making it suitable for runners of different levels.

name: Шуменско плато 2026
description: Shumensko Plateau 2026 is a race taking place on June 21, 2026, in Shumensko Plateau Nature Park. The start and finish are near the Monument to the Founders of the Bulgarian State in the city of Shumen. Organized by Ilchov Bair Cycling Club, the event features cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running. Participants compete on different courses and are required to follow safety and environmental protection rules. The race is suitable for enthusiasts of mountain biking and running in natural surroundings.

name: ISKRA Trail Kosmaj
description: Iskra Kosmaj Trail je trail trka koja se održava na prelepoj planini Kosmaj, pružajući učesnicima priliku da uživaju u gustim šumama i zadivljujućim pogledima. Trka je prilika za sjajan izlet i druženje u trkačkom selu koje se nalazi u zoni starta i cilja. Na raspolaganju su tri distance, a trka je otvorena za trkače, šetače i nordijske hodače svih uzrasta uz saglasnost roditelja za mlađe od 18 godina. Organizator garantuje sigurnost i dobru atmosferu, a učesnici dobijaju startni paket sa majicom ako se prijave na vreme.

name: 3ο Panetoliko Mountain Trail Run
description: Το 3ο Panetoliko Mountain Trail Run σας προσκαλεί να ανακαλύψετε την άγρια και ανεξερεύνητη ομορφιά του Παναιτωλικού Όρους μέσα από τρεις εντυπωσιακές διαδρομές. Οι αγώνες προσφέρουν μια μοναδική εμπειρία ορεινού τρεξίματος με ελατοσκεπείς πλαγιές, καταρράκτες, αλπικές κορυφές και γραφικά μονοπάτια. Η διοργάνωση απευθύνεται τόσο σε έμπειρους δρομείς όσο και σε νέους φίλους του αθλητισμού, με ηλεκτρονική χρονομέτρηση, παροχές τροφοδοσίας και μεταφορά από και προς την πόλη του Αγρινίου. Ζήστε τη μαγεία του βουνού και δημιουργήστε αξέχαστες αναμνήσεις.

name: 3ο Galatsi Night Run
description: Το 3ο Galatsi Night Run είναι μια νυχτερινή δρομική διοργάνωση που πραγματοποιείται στο Γαλάτσι, Αθήνα, με αφετηρία και τερματισμό το Κλειστό Ολυμπιακό Γυμναστήριο Γαλατσίου - ΠΑΛΑΙ. Η διαδρομή των 5 χλμ κινείται στον κεντρικό οδικό άξονα της πόλης, τη Λεωφόρο Βεΐκου, ενώ υπάρχει και παιδικός αγώνας 1 χλμ για μαθητές δημοτικών σχολείων εντός του περιβάλλοντος χώρου του ΠΑΛΑΙ. Η διοργάνωση προωθεί τη συμμετοχή των πολιτών στον αθλητισμό και τη σωματική άσκηση, με έμφαση στην ασφάλεια και την ευχάριστη εμπειρία για όλους τους συμμετέχοντες.

name: 5ο Orestis Run
description: Ο 5ος Αγώνας Δρόμου ΟΡΕΣΤΗΣ στην Ορεστιάδα είναι μια αθλητική εκδήλωση που προσελκύει δρομείς και λάτρεις του αθλητισμού από την περιοχή. Ο αγώνας προσφέρει μια ευκαιρία για συμμετοχή σε μια οργανωμένη διαδρομή μέσα στην πόλη, προωθώντας την υγεία και την αθλητική δραστηριότητα. Η διοργάνωση είναι φιλική και ανοιχτή σε όλους, με στόχο την ενίσχυση της τοπικής κοινότητας και την προώθηση του αθλητισμού. Η εκδήλωση έχει καθιερωθεί ως μια σημαντική αθλητική στιγμή για την περιοχή της Ορεστιάδας.

name: Go Florina – Run The City Experience
description: Ο Δήμος Φλώρινας και η GoEvents διοργανώνουν το διήμερο δρομικών αγώνων GO FLORINA - RUN THE CITY, ένα αθλητικό και πολιτιστικό γεγονός που συνδυάζει τον αθλητισμό με την ομορφιά της πόλης της Φλώρινας. Οι αγώνες πραγματοποιούνται στις 20 & 21 Ιουνίου με εκκίνηση και τερματισμό την Πλατεία Γεωργίου Μόδη. Προσκαλούνται δρομείς κάθε ηλικίας και επιπέδου να συμμετάσχουν σε διαδρομές μέσα στην πόλη και κατά μήκος του ποταμού Σακουλέβα, απολαμβάνοντας την ιδιαίτερη ατμόσφαιρα της περιοχής. Οι διαδρομές περιλαμβάνουν αγώνες 10 χλμ, 5 χλμ, νυχτερινό αγώνα 3 χλμ και συμμετοχικό αγώνα 1 χλμ για οικογένειες και παιδιά.

name: 25ο «Στα Χνάρια του Απόστολου Παύλου»
description: Ο 25ος Αγώνας Δρόμου και Δυναμικού Βάδην «Στα Χνάρια του Αποστόλου Παύλου» διοργανώνεται από τον Δήμο Κορινθίων και αναβιώνει συμβολικά τη διαδρομή που ακολούθησε ο Απόστολος Παύλος στην περιοχή. Ο αγώνας πραγματοποιείται την Κυριακή 21 Ιουνίου 2026, ξεκινώντας από το αρχαίο λιμάνι των Κεχριών και τερματίζοντας στην κεντρική πλατεία της Αρχαίας Κορίνθου. Η διαδρομή έχει μήκος 11,4 χιλιόμετρα και περιλαμβάνει τρεις σταθμούς υποστήριξης κατά μήκος της. Πρόκειται για μια ιστορική και πολιτιστική διαδρομή που συνδυάζει αθλητισμό και παράδοση.

name: SNF Nostos Run
description: Ο SNF Nostos Run 2026 είναι ένας αγαπημένος βραδινός αγώνας δρόμου που διοργανώνεται από το Ίδρυμα Σταύρος Νιάρχος, επιστρέφοντας στις 23 Ιουνίου για να γιορτάσει τα 30 χρόνια κοινωφελούς δράσης του ΙΣΝ. Ο αγώνας περιλαμβάνει διαδρομές 10 χλμ., 6 χλμ. και 1 χλμ. για αθλητές Special Olympics, με εκκίνηση από το Παναθηναϊκό Στάδιο και τερματισμό στο Κέντρο Πολιτισμού Ίδρυμα Σταύρος Νιάρχος. Η διοργάνωση δίνει έμφαση στην προσφορά και την αλληλεγγύη, καθώς το ΙΣΝ θα προσφέρει τριπλάσιο ποσό από το συνολικό χρηματικό ποσό που θα συγκεντρωθεί από τις συμμετοχές για την ενίσχυση μη κερδοσκοπικών οργανισμών. Κατά τη διάρκεια της διαδρομής, οι συμμετέχοντες θα απολαύσουν μουσική από μπάντες κρουστών και DJ set στον τερματισμό, ενώ η χρονομέτρηση είναι επίσημη αλλά ο αγώνας δεν έχει αγωνιστικό χαρακτήρα.

name: Rodnei Sky Race
description: Rodnei Sky Race este o competiție montană de alergare desfășurată în Munții Rodnei, în zona Borșa, Maramureș. Evenimentul oferă trei trasee distincte, adaptate pentru diferite niveluri de experiență: traseul Puzdrelor, cel mai dificil, destinat alergătorilor experimentați; traseul Gărgălău, o provocare medie pentru alergători pregătiți; și traseul Musceta, un traseu rapid cu diferență mare de coborâre. Cursa face parte din Circuitul Carpaților și pune accent pe experiența alergării în natură, printre peisaje montane spectaculoase. Organizatorii invită familiile și pasionații de sporturi montane să participe la un weekend activ în aer liber.

name: Sinaia Mountain Run
description: Sinaia Mountain Run by Constantina Diță este o cursă montană spectaculoasă cu startul și sosirea în Piața Primăriei Sinaia. Traseele trec prin zone pitorești precum Cota 1000 și Cota 1400, oferind alergătorilor o experiență montană autentică și provocatoare. Evenimentul este deschis atât alergătorilor de elită, cât și pasionaților de alergare montană, cu curse de 10K și 21K. Participanții primesc kit de concurs cu număr, chip de cronometrare și medalie, iar organizatorii oferă galerii foto digitale gratuite.

name: CROSUL ORASULUI MIOVENI 1485
description: Crosul Orașului Mioveni este un eveniment sportiv anual organizat de Asociația Invictus Mioveni în parteneriat cu Primăria și Centrul Cultural al orașului Mioveni. Evenimentul reunește alergători de toate vârstele, de la copii de 3 ani până la seniori de 78 de ani, pe trasee variate de 2,5 km, 5 km și 10 km, plus curse speciale pentru cei mici. Atmosfera este vibrantă, cu muzică, aplauze, demonstrații SMURD și momente artistice, oferind o zi dedicată sănătății, comunității și distracției sportive. Crosul este o sărbătoare a mișcării și a spiritului comunitar, susținută de sponsori importanți precum TEMAD, WD-40 România și UHU România.

name: CROSUL HOIA FORTECH
description: Crosul Hoia GlobalLogic este o cursă de alergare organizată în Pădurea Hoia, Cluj-Napoca, care oferă participanților oportunitatea de a alerga pe poteci răcoroase în natură. Evenimentul include probe de 15 km, 7 km, 3 km și o probă dedicată familiilor, fiind potrivit pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile de pregătire. Organizatorii Runners Club promovează o atmosferă prietenoasă și susțin comunitatea locală de alergători. Crosul este o ocazie excelentă de a schimba asfaltul urban cu aerul curat și peisajele frumoase ale pădurii.

name: Crosul Oraşului Mioveni 1485 - Ed. a - IV - a ~ 2026
description: Crosul Orașului Mioveni este un eveniment sportiv organizat de Invictus România, dedicat promovării spiritului de solidaritate și curaj, în special în rândul militarilor răniți. Evenimentul are loc în centrul civic al orașului Mioveni și face parte dintr-o serie de competiții sportive cu caracter caritabil și comemorativ. Participanții sunt încurajați să se alăture pentru a susține valorile de onoare și respect, într-un cadru prietenos și motivant.

name: Noćni maraton
organizer: Tletsko rekreativni klub “Fruška gora” – Novi Sad
description: Noćni maraton u Novom Sadu je jedna od najposećenijih trka u Srbiji i predstavlja jedinstvenu noćnu atletsko-rekreativnu manifestaciju. Glavna trka je maraton na 42 km, koji zahteva posvećenost i mentalnu snagu, dok polumaraton okuplja najviše učesnika i pruža posebnu energiju noćne trke. Pored toga, tu su minimaraton za najmlađe i nordijsko hodanje, čineći događaj dostupnim za sve uzraste i nivoe spremnosti. Trka je postala tradicija i ponos Novog Sada, sa pažljivo organizovanim paketima za takmičare i bogatim sadržajem na stazi i posle trke.

name: TORNIK RACE 2026
description: Tornik Race je jedinstvena trkačka avantura na Zlatiboru koja kombinuje adrenalinske izazove sa očuvanjem prirode. Trke su prilagođene svim generacijama i nivoima, sa stazama od 6km, 15km, 25km, kao i dečijim trkama. Učesnici mogu uživati u prirodnim lepotama Tornika, testirati svoju izdržljivost i doprineti očuvanju životne sredine kroz Plogging trku. Organizatori teže stvaranju zajednice strastvenih trkača i ljubitelja prirode, pružajući nezaboravno iskustvo i zdrav sportski duh.

name: 17. Noćni maraton
description: Noćni maraton u Novom Sadu je jedna od najposećenijih trka u Srbiji i predstavlja jedinstvenu noćnu atletsko-rekreativnu manifestaciju. Glavna trka je maraton na 42 km, koji zahteva posvećenost i mentalnu snagu, dok polumaraton okuplja najviše učesnika i pruža posebnu energiju noćne trke. Pored toga, tu su minimaraton za najmlađe i nordijsko hodanje, što trku čini dostupnom svima. Organizatori iz ARK Fruška gora kontinuirano unapređuju događaj, koji je postao tradicija i ponos Novog Sada.

name: 2. Dr Milk TORNIK RACE
description: Tornik Race je jedinstvena trkačka avantura na Zlatiboru koja kombinuje adrenalinske izazove sa očuvanjem prirode. Trke su prilagođene svim generacijama i nivoima, sa stazama od 6km, 15km, 25km i dečijim trkama. Učesnici mogu uživati u prirodnim lepotama Tornika, testirati svoju izdržljivost i doprineti očuvanju životne sredine kroz Plogging trku. Organizatori teže stvaranju zajednice strastvenih trkača i ljubitelja avanture, pružajući nezaboravno iskustvo i podstičući zdrav sportski duh.

name: 2ο Silk City Run
description: Το 2ο Silk City Run στο Σουφλί είναι ένας αγώνας δρόμου που καλεί ερασιτέχνες και έμπειρους δρομείς, οικογένειες και νέους να απολαύσουν μια μοναδική διαδρομή μέσα στην πόλη του μεταξιού. Το τρέξιμο στους δρόμους του Σουφλίου δεν είναι απλώς ένας αγώνας, αλλά ένα ταξίδι προς έναν πιο υγιή, ισορροπημένο και δημιουργικό τρόπο ζωής. Ο Δήμος Σουφλίου υποδέχεται με ζεστασιά όλους τους συμμετέχοντες, προσφέροντας μια ευκαιρία για ανανέωση και ενεργητικότητα.

name: 22ος Olympus Marathon
description: Ο Olympus Marathon είναι ένας μοναδικός αγώνας ορεινού τρεξίματος 44 χιλιομέτρων με θετική υψομετρική διαφορά +3350 μέτρων, που διεξάγεται στο μυθικό βουνό του Ολύμπου. Η διαδρομή ξεκινά από τον αρχαιολογικό χώρο του Δίου και ακολουθεί μονοπάτια μέσα από δάση, αλπικά λιβάδια και κορυφές, φτάνοντας μέχρι το Λιτόχωρο. Ο αγώνας τιμά την αρχαία παράδοση των προσκυνητών που ανέβαιναν στον Όλυμπο για να τιμήσουν τον Δία, προσφέροντας μια μοναδική εμπειρία στους δρομείς που ακολουθούν τα ίχνη της ιστορίας στο βουνό των θεών. Είναι πιστοποιημένος αγώνας SKYRUNNING και αποτελεί μια πρόκληση για έμπειρους ορεινούς δρομείς.

name: Porto Heli Night Run
description: Ο Δήμος Ερμιονίδας και η Δημοτική Κοινότητα Πορτοχελίου σας προσκαλούν στη μεγάλη γιορτή αθλητισμού «Porto Heli Night Run» που θα πραγματοποιηθεί το Σάββατο 27 Ιουνίου 2026. Ο αγώνας είναι αφιερωμένος στη μνήμη του Μίνωα Κυριακού και περιλαμβάνει διαδρομές για όλους, από trail run 11 χλμ και night run 5 χλμ, μέχρι παιδικούς αγώνες και αγώνα για ΑΜΕΑ. Κάθε συμμετέχων θα λάβει αναμνηστικό μπλουζάκι και μετάλλιο, προσφέροντας μια μοναδική αθλητική εμπειρία στο όμορφο Πορτοχέλι.

name: Крос-триатлон „По стъпките на траките“
description: The “In the Footsteps of the Thracians” cross triathlon is the inaugural edition of a race offering a unique experience in the mystical Valley of the Thracian Kings near Koprinka Reservoir, Kazanlak. Participants will take on challenging swimming, cycling, and running courses amid beautiful scenery and varied terrain. The event is suitable both for amateurs looking to test their strength and willpower and for those seeking outdoor fun. Organized by the Trayana-Triathlon Sports Club of Stara Zagora, the race promises unforgettable views and an atmospheric experience.

name: Витоша 100км
description: Vitosha 100 km is a mountain ultramarathon held around Vitosha Mountain in 9 stages, passing through picturesque villages and natural landmarks. The race offers a challenge for runners, cyclists, and duathletes, combining long distances with varied terrain. The organizers emphasize protecting nature and holding a zero-waste race. Participants receive race packs and special surprises, and the event is supported by local partners and sponsors.

name: Tara Ultra Trail 2026
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail 2026 je planinska trejl trka koja se održava u Nacionalnom parku Tara, Bajina Bašta, prvog vikenda jula. Trka nudi više distanci prilagođenih različitim nivoima spremnosti, od vertikalnog uspona do ultra duge staze od 62 km sa značajnim usponima. Staze vode kroz skrivene i atraktivne delove Tare, pružajući trkačima nezaboravno iskustvo prirode i izazov za telo i duh. Pored trka, u cilju se organizuje celodnevni outdoor festival i prateći kulturni događaji, stvarajući jedinstvenu atmosferu za sve učesnike i posetioce.

name: Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships
organizer: Balkan Mountaineering Union (BMU), Planinarski savez Srbije (PSS), Tara Ultra Trail, Planinarski klub Tara
description: Prvo Balkansko prvenstvo u planinskom i trail trčanju održaće se od 2. do 4. jula 2026. godine u Nacionalnom parku Tara i Bajinoj Bašti, Srbiji. Takmičenje obuhvata četiri trke: Mountain Uphill, Mountain Classic, Mountain Trail i U18 Mountain Classic, koje okupljaju najbolje planinske trkače Balkana. Staze su raznovrsne i zahtevne, sa spektakularnim pejzažima i tehničkim usponima, pružajući pravi izazov i uživanje u prirodi. Organizatori su Balkan Mountaineering Union, Planinarski savez Srbije, Tara Ultra Trail i Planinarski klub Tara. Pozivamo sve trkače da se pridruže i proslave planinsko i trail trčanje u srcu Srbije.

name: Troyan Run
distance_verbose: 70 km, 69 km, Маратон, 28 km, 12 km, 5 km, 3000 метра
description: TroyanRun is a mountain race held in the Troyan Balkan, dedicated to the work of Vasil Levski. The race offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain-running enthusiasts. It is organized by the “Troyan in the Future” association, which works to promote the area’s historical and natural heritage and encourage a healthy lifestyle through sport. The event also includes a street art festival and charitable initiatives.

name: Вършец ултра
description: Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a variety of distances suitable for experienced ultrarunners, beginners, and children. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Varshets, with the start in front of Hotel Medicus. Participants can choose between the 48 km ultra distance and shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. The race combines sport, nature, and an opportunity for an active getaway in the national resort of Varshets.

name: Камчийски пясъци
description: Kamchiyski Pyasatsi is a unique running event taking place on July 4, 2026, along Bulgaria’s longest beach, between Kamchiya Resort Complex and Shkorpilovtsi. The course is entirely on sand and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchiya River, with rescue equipment and assistance facilities provided. The race offers two main distances—10 km and 21.1 km—as well as a 2.2 km children’s run. It is organized by the Green Step club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.

name: Carpathia Trails
distance_verbose: 100 km, 58 km, 57 km, 50 km, Maraton, 36 km, 23 km, 5 km
description: Carpathia Trails is a mountain running race taking place on July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Resort in Fundata, crossing three mountain ranges: the Bucegi Mountains, the Leaota Mountains, and the Piatra Craiului Mountains. The event offers six individual race options, ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon, suitable for all experience levels. Participants can enjoy spectacular scenery and a unique experience in nature in a friendly, well-organized setting. Registration is limited and available online until June 23, 2026.
course_highlights: Routes crossing three mountain ranges: Bucegi, Leaota, and Piatra Craiului
Distances ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon
Spectacular natural scenery in the Cheile Grădiștei area
additional: All races start on the same day, July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Resort, the event’s hub. Registration is limited and available online. The organizer may award wildcards to recognized athletes. The event is supported by participant donations, sponsors, and partners. The code of conduct is mandatory for all participants to protect the trails and ensure safety. Participation is through an online form, with limited registration and the possibility of wildcards for recognized athletes. The event takes place on July 4, 2026, in Cheile Grădiștei, Fundata, Brașov.

name: Cozia Mountain Run
description: Cozia Mountain Run este o competiție de alergare montană ce se desfășoară în Masivul Cozia, pe malul stâng al Oltului, în stațiunea balneoclimaterică Călimănești-Căciulata. Evenimentul, organizat de Asociația Pegas Triatlon Club cu sprijinul autorităților locale, promovează alergarea montană, tradițiile locale și strângerea de fonduri umanitare. Participanții parcurg trei trasee montane cu caracter dificil, neamenajate, care necesită experiență și abilități montane. Atmosfera este una prietenoasă și energizantă, iar după cursă toți alergătorii sunt invitați la masa de prânz la Mănăstirea Turnu.

name: Legendele Nemirei
description: Legendele Nemirei este un concurs de alergare montană desfășurat în Slănic Moldova, ce oferă trasee spectaculoase prin păduri răcoroase și pe culmile masivului Nemira. Participanții se bucură de un traseu bine marcat, cu peisaje naturale sălbatice și provocări alpine, potrivit pentru alergători cu experiență. Evenimentul este apreciat pentru organizarea atentă, voluntarii dedicați și atmosfera prietenoasă, fiind o experiență memorabilă pentru iubitorii de alergare montană.

name: 4ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Κακολύρι 1944
organizer: Δήμος Κύμης – Αλιβερίου και Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Ταξιαρχών
description: Ο 4ος Δρόμος Θυσίας «Κακολύρι 1944» είναι ένας αγώνας δρόμου που τιμά τη μνήμη των θυμάτων του ολοκαυτώματος του χωριού Ταξιάρχες το 1944. Διοργανώνεται από τον Δήμο Κύμης - Αλιβερίου και τον Πολιτιστικό Σύλλογο Ταξιαρχών, με την υποστήριξη πολιτιστικών συλλόγων και κοινοτήτων της περιοχής. Περιλαμβάνει έναν ημιμαραθώνιο 21 χλμ, έναν αγώνα 5 χλμ και έναν παιδικό δρόμο 1,2 χλμ, με διαδρομές που διασχίζουν ιστορικά χωριά και φυσικά τοπία. Ο αγώνας προσφέρει ηλεκτρονική χρονομέτρηση, αναμνηστικά μετάλλια και μπλουζάκια, καθώς και πλήρη υποστήριξη με σταθμούς τροφοδοσίας και ιατρική κάλυψη.

name: Вършец рън
description: Varshets Run and Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a variety of distances suitable for experienced runners as well as beginners and children. The event takes place in the picturesque resort town of Varshets, with the start in front of the Medicus Hotel. The courses include a 48 km ultra distance, as well as shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners, offering opportunities for participants of different levels. Registration is through the runbulgaria.org platform, and race packs are collected at the Varshets Municipality.

name: Treska Trail
description: Pridružite se avanturističkoj pešačkoj turi sa Kežman Mountain Houses do vrha Treska na Kopaoniku. Ova kratka staza od 650 metara vodi do impresivnog vrha na 1622 metra nadmorske visine, sa prelepim panoramskim pogledima na okolne planine i doline. Staza je dobro obeležena i pogodna za sve goste, a uspon traje oko 30 minuta, pružajući priliku za uživanje u prirodi i fotografisanje. Organizovane ture su dostupne za sve goste smeštaja, sa prevozom do početne tačke staze.

name: 48. Trka oko Avale
description: Atletska trka oko Avale je tradicionalna manifestacija koju organizuje Savez atletskih veterana Srbije. Trka se održava u prelepom ambijentu Avale i okuplja trkače različitih uzrasta i nivoa pripremljenosti. Ova trka je prilika za sportsko druženje i promociju atletike među veteranima i rekreativcima. Start i cilj trke su na atraktivnoj lokaciji, a staza pruža izazove i uživanje u prirodi.

name: 8ο Skloupo Trail Run
description: Ο 8ος Skloupo Trail Run είναι ένας αγώνας ανώμαλου δρόμου που διεξάγεται στο γραφικό Αμπελοχώρι (Σκλούπο) του Δήμου Βορείων Τζουμέρκων. Περιλαμβάνει τρεις διαδρομές: 13,5 χλμ, 5 χλμ και Kids Race 1 χλμ, προσφέροντας μια μοναδική εμπειρία μέσα σε δάση με έλατα και κωνοφόρα, με έντονες ανηφόρες και κατηφόρες. Η διαδρομή συνδυάζει χωμάτινα μονοπάτια και ασφάλτινα τμήματα, με όμορφα φυσικά τοπία και ιστορικά σημεία του χωριού. Ο αγώνας απευθύνεται σε δρομείς όλων των ηλικιών, με ιδιαίτερη φροντίδα για τους μικρούς συμμετέχοντες.

name: Zalău Ultra Trail
description: Zalău Ultra Trail is a mountain running competition held over three days in the heart of the Sălaj Mountains. The event offers a variety of races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, including a 103 km ultra race with over 5,000 m of elevation gain. ZUT is more than a competition: it is a platform that brings together athletes, the local community, and nature, promoting a spirit of adventure and respect for the environment. The routes are challenging and spectacular, offering an authentic trail-running experience amid impressive natural landscapes.
course_highlights: 103 km ULTRA course with 5,255 m of elevation gain
Well-equipped aid and checkpoint stations along the route
A variety of races, from a 2.5 km children’s race to a 103 km ultra
additional: The event takes place over 3 days, with multiple races suited to different levels of fitness. The Last Man Standing race is a special endurance competition with 6.7 km laps every hour, eliminating participants who do not finish in time. There are prize categories for children and Cross races. Mandatory equipment is specified in the regulations, and aid stations provide water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and hot food along the ultra course. Multiple race distances, including races for children and charity events; an emphasis on promoting local values and community spirit; the event also includes an environmental awareness component.

name: Stâna de Vale Trail Race
description: Stâna de Vale Trail Race is a mountain running competition held amid the spectacular scenery of the Carpathian Mountains, at the Stâna de Vale resort in Bihor County. The event is part of the EMA Off-Road Running 2026 circuit and offers races for all levels, from beginner routes to demanding mountain ultramarathons. Participants can enjoy well-marked routes, full support along the course, and a friendly post-race atmosphere. The race weekend also includes an 8 km vertical race, a classic 11 km race, and a long 33 km race with significant elevation gain.
course_highlights: A 33 km mountain route with 1,500 m of positive elevation gain, featuring technical sections and panoramic views
An 11 km route suited to beginners and intermediate runners, through forests and gentle hills
An 8 km vertical race with 1,100 m of elevation gain, featuring a continuous, demanding climb
additional: The event takes place on 10–11 July 2026, with race-pack collection at Hotel Iadolina, Stâna de Vale. The Vertical 8K starts on Friday at 10:00, while the 33 km and 11 km races start on Saturday at 08:30 and 09:30. The organizers provide a post-race meal and a party after the awards ceremony. Participation in the EMA circuit requires a valid license for the 35–79 age category. The routes are on mountain terrain, and the event includes timing. Participants can choose between two distances to suit their fitness level.

name: Jadovnički Ultramaraton 2026
description: Jadovnički ultramaraton 2026 je jedinstvena trail manifestacija u zapadnoj Srbiji, koja okuplja zaljubljenike u prirodu, izdržljivost i ekstremne trke. Održava se 10. i 11. jula u Prijepolju, sa startom i ciljem na Platu Doma kulture. Sve staze su nove i ne ponavljaju se u odnosu na prethodno izdanje, a trke su prilagođene različitim nivoima spremnosti i trkačkim kategorijama. Učesnici dobijaju startni paket sa majicom, promotivnim materijalom i finišerskom medaljom, a organizacija pruža i podršku za smeštaj i obroke.

name: Национален шампионат под 20 г.
description: The Under-20 National Championships, organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, is a prestigious competition that brings together Bulgaria’s best young athletes. It takes place at a stadium in Sofia and offers young athletes an opportunity to develop and showcase their talents in athletics. The competition is part of the BAF’s 2026 sports calendar and is held under the auspices of Bulgaria’s leading athletics organization, which has a long-standing tradition and international recognition.

name: TRI Legend Batak 2026
description: TRI Legend Batak 2026 is a triathlon event taking place on July 11, 2026, at Batak Reservoir. The race offers three distances: Legend, Turbo, and Legend Relay, suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners. The course is marked and has aid stations, while the atmosphere is filled with camaraderie and challenge. This is a place where the race happens with you, not just for you.

name: Predeal Forest Run
description: Predeal Forest Run is a mountain running event held in Predeal, Brașov, on July 11, 2026. The event offers five trail-running routes suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 13 km to 38 km. The routes pass through forests, mountain trails, and areas with spectacular scenery, offering a complete mountain-running experience. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and active running community, making it an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the Piatra Mare Mountains.
course_highlights: 100% trail-running routes through forests and along mountain trails
Challenging climbs, including more than 500 m of elevation gain over 4 km on K24
Spectacular scenery at Poiana Stanei Pietricica, Vf. Piatra Mare, and Cabana Garbova
additional: The event includes five races: K13 Cros, K24 Semimaraton, K32 Piatra Mare, K38 Maraton, and Family Run (non-competitive). The start is at the base of the Clăbucet ski slopes. The routes are marked with yellow tape bearing the red Predeal Forest Run logo and are supported by volunteers. Cut-off times and aid stations are set for the competitive races. The race kit will be announced later. Participants can register in various race categories, and the event promotes a social cause. Registration details and rules are available on the official website.

name: Jadovnički ultramaraton
description: Jadovnički ultramaraton je prvi put organizovan od strane Udruženja građana „Jadovnik“ na istoimenoj planini. Trka ima za cilj da istakne lepotu i bogatstvo flore i faune planine Jadovnik, koja je do sada bila malo poznata javnosti. Ovaj ultramaraton predstavlja jedinstvenu priliku za trkače da iskuse izazov i posebnu draž trčanja u netaknutoj prirodi. Organizatori žele da očuvaju i promovišu ovu planinu kroz sport i zajedništvo.

name: XL kmrun - Сеславци
description: XLkmrun is an organized, non-professional athletics race over middle and long distances, offering a challenge for runners of varying fitness levels. The event takes place in Sofia and is part of the 5KM RUN initiative, which promotes a healthy lifestyle through free but organized running. It is an opportunity for anyone interested to take part in a sporting atmosphere that supports diversity and community.

name: 4ος Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Μυτιλήνης
description: Ο 4ος Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Μυτιλήνης είναι ένας δημοφιλής νυχτερινός αγώνας δρόμου που διεξάγεται στην πόλη της Μυτιλήνης. Η διαδρομή των 5 και 10 χιλιομέτρων διασχίζει τον ιστό της πόλης, ξεκινώντας και τερματίζοντας στα Τσαμάκια, με μεγάλο μέρος της να περνάει από πεζόδρομους για ελάχιστη όχληση στην κυκλοφορία. Ο αγώνας διοργανώνεται από τον Σύλλογο Δρομέων Λέσβου Lesvos Runners σε συνεργασία με το Δήμο Μυτιλήνης και άλλους τοπικούς φορείς, προσφέροντας μια μοναδική εμπειρία τρεξίματος υπό το φως της νύχτας. Μεγάλη συμμετοχή και ζεστή ατμόσφαιρα χαρακτηρίζουν τον αγώνα, που αποτελεί πλέον θεσμό για το νησί της Λέσβου.

name: 15ος Faethon Skyrace
description: Ο 15ος Faethon Skyrace «Απόστολος Τσουρέκας» θα διεξαχθεί στις 12 Ιουλίου 2026 στον Κοκκινοπηλό του Ολύμπου. Πρόκειται για έναν απαιτητικό αγώνα ορεινού τρεξίματος που προσφέρει δύο διαδρομές: το Faethon SkyRace 23 χλμ με +1800μ υψομετρική διαφορά σε αλπικό τερέν και το Faethon Trail 14 χλμ με +400μ, που διασχίζει ιστορικά μονοπάτια και καταπράσινα δάση. Η διοργάνωση περιλαμβάνει επίσης τον παιδικό αγώνα Faethonaki Run 1 χλμ, που δίνει την ευκαιρία στα παιδιά να γνωρίσουν το ορεινό τρέξιμο. Η εκκίνηση γίνεται από την κεντρική πλατεία του χωριού Κοκκινοπλός και η διοργάνωση φέρει το όραμα και την αγάπη για τον Όλυμπο και το ορεινό τρέξιμο.

name: Faethon Skyrace
description: Ο Faethon Skyrace είναι ένας απαιτητικός αγώνας ορεινού τρεξίματος που διεξάγεται στον μυθικό Όλυμπο, στην περιοχή Κοκκινοπηλός. Η διαδρομή των 24 χιλιομέτρων με υψομετρική διαφορά +1800 μέτρων προσφέρει μια μοναδική εμπειρία σε μονοπάτια, αλπικό τερέν και κορυφές πάνω από 2000 μέτρα. Ο αγώνας ξεκινά από την κεντρική πλατεία του χωριού και έχει χρονικό όριο 6 ώρες, με ενδιάμεσους σταθμούς ανεφοδιασμού. Η διοργάνωση απευθύνεται σε έμπειρους αθλητές με καλή φυσική κατάσταση και εμπειρία σε αγώνες βουνού.

name: Трявна ултра
description: Tryavna Ultra is an ultramarathon race offering challenging distances in the beautiful Balkan Mountains around the town of Tryavna. The event includes 100 km, 42 km, and 21 km races, as well as cycling routes and a duathlon. The courses feature varied terrain and numerous aid stations to ensure participants’ comfort and safety. The organizer is the iRun association, which has extensive experience organizing sporting events and building a sports community.

name: Maraton Bate Toaca
description: Maraton Bate Toaca este o cursă montană anuală desfășurată în zona Durău, NT, parte din Circuitul Carpaților. Evenimentul oferă două trasee principale: Cursa Dochia de 18 km cu o diferență de nivel de aproximativ 1500 m și Cursa Bate Toaca de 31 km cu o diferență de nivel de aproximativ 2700 m. Traseele trec prin peisaje spectaculoase, inclusiv Cabana Dochia, Vf. Lespezi și Vf. Toaca, oferind o experiență montană autentică și provocatoare pentru alergători. Organizatorii asigură o atmosferă prietenoasă și o bună logistică pentru participanți.

name: BUILA TRAIL RACE Discover Oltenia de sub munte!
description: Buila Trail Race 2026 este un concurs de alergare montană organizat de Asociația Sport fără Limite Vâlcea, ce promovează frumusețea Parcului Național Buila-Vânturarița. Evenimentul se desfășoară în data de 18 iulie 2026, în localitatea Bărbătești, Vâlcea, și oferă probe variate pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile de pregătire. Participanții pot alege între curse pentru copii, crosuri și trasee montane de 11, 18 și 36 km, toate cu peisaje spectaculoase și provocări montane autentice.

name: BURDUF CHALLENGE Alergăm pentru brânză și colibe!
description: Burduf Challenge este un concurs de alergare montană desfășurat în Râu Sadului, Sibiu, pe 18 iulie 2026. Evenimentul cuprinde trei curse pe trasee subalpine pitorești, cu diferențe de nivel semnificative, adresate atât adulților, cât și copiilor și adolescenților. Participarea susține proiectul Țara Colibelor, printr-o donație inclusă în taxa de înscriere, iar după cursă alergătorii sunt invitați la un brunch cu produse locale. Evenimentul promovează ecoturismul și conservarea patrimoniului cultural montan din zona Munților Cindrel și Lotrului.

name: Zagori Mountain Running (ZMR)
description: Ο αγώνας Zagori Mountain Running (ZMR) είναι το μεγαλύτερο ελληνικό ορεινό τρέξιμο, που προσφέρει μια μοναδική εμπειρία μέσα στη φυσική ομορφιά και τον πολιτισμό της περιοχής Ζαγορίου. Με διαδρομές που διασχίζουν πέτρινα γεφύρια, χωριά και το εντυπωσιακό φαράγγι του Βίκου, οι δρομείς έχουν την ευκαιρία να δοκιμάσουν τις αντοχές τους σε απαιτητικά μονοπάτια με μεγάλες υψομετρικές διαφορές. Το ZMR περιλαμβάνει πολλαπλές διαδρομές, από 5χλμ για όλους έως και τον διήμερο αγώνα Challenge 93χλμ, καλύπτοντας διαφορετικά επίπεδα δυσκολίας και εμπειρίας. Η διοργάνωση είναι φιλόξενη και επαγγελματική, με έμφαση στην ασφάλεια και την υποστήριξη των αθλητών.

name: XCO National Championship 2026 (ДЛШ и ХОБИ)
location: Knyazhevska Gora Park, Knyazhevo, Sofia, Bulgaria

name: 15ο Zagori Mountain Running
description: Ο αγώνας Zagori Mountain Running αποτελεί το μεγαλύτερο ελληνικό ορεινό αγώνα δρόμου, προσφέροντας μια μοναδική εμπειρία μέσα από τα επιβλητικά τοπία του Ζαγορίου. Οι διαδρομές διασχίζουν πέτρινα γεφύρια, το φαράγγι του Βίκου και το ορεινό συγκρότημα της Τύμφης, συνδυάζοντας φυσική ομορφιά και απαιτητικό ανάγλυφο. Με πολλές επιλογές διαδρομών, από 5χλμ έως 93χλμ, ο αγώνας καλύπτει όλες τις προτιμήσεις και επίπεδα δρομέων. Η διοργάνωση είναι φιλόξενη και οργανωμένη, με έμφαση στην ασφάλεια και την υποστήριξη των αθλητών.

name: Ο Δρόμος του Αλατιού
description: Ο Δρόμος του Αλατιού είναι ένας αγώνας δρόμου που διεξάγεται στο Μεσολόγγι, προσφέροντας διαδρομές 10χλμ, 5χλμ και 1000μ. Η διοργάνωση δίνει έμφαση στην ακριβή ηλεκτρονική χρονομέτρηση και την άρτια οργάνωση, με στόχο να προσφέρει μια αξέχαστη εμπειρία σε δρομείς από όλη την Ελλάδα. Ο αγώνας συνδυάζει αθλητικό πνεύμα και τοπική παράδοση, προσελκύοντας συμμετέχοντες όλων των ηλικιών και επιπέδων. Η διοργάνωση φροντίζει για την άμεση ανακοίνωση αποτελεσμάτων και την παροχή αναμνηστικών διπλωμάτων συμμετοχής.

name: Boogie To The Van 8k fun run
Балкан ултра
description: Balkan Ultra is a challenging mountain race held in the area around Pleven Hut, Apriltsi. The courses include technical sections with significant elevation gain and require good physical fitness and mountain experience. Participants can choose between two main distances—Sky and Ultra—each with a unique route through beautiful and demanding mountain terrain. The race offers impressive views and varied trails, including routes over peaks such as Botev and Mlechni Chal.

name: Магура Run
description: Magura RUN is a running event held near the village of Rabisha, Belogradchik, in northwestern Bulgaria. The event celebrates a love of movement and running, inviting all runners to take part regardless of their pace. The course offers a unique experience in nature, with the chance to run at both sunset and sunrise, combining sport with the beauty of the local landscape. The organizers, BG EVENTS AND GUIDING, put a great deal of effort and energy into creating an authentic and challenging event that may be the last of its kind because of changes in nature.
course_highlights: The course passes by Rabisha Lake and through the area around the village of Rabisha
The chance to run at sunset and sunrise
Held amid the scenic natural landscapes of northwestern Bulgaria
additional: The event is organized by BG EVENTS AND GUIDING, with an emphasis on authenticity and energy. Possible challenges in preparing for the event include finding workers to clear the course. The race takes place on July 27 and 28 near Rabisha Lake. No information is provided about start times, prices, or registration.

name: Национален шампионат под 23г.
description: The National U18 Championships is one of the largest competitions on the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sporting calendar. The competition includes a variety of events, with the discus and hammer events held at the National Sports Academy in Studentski Grad. Traditionally, the championships bring together young athletes from across the country, giving them the opportunity to compete at a high level and showcase their talent. The event is organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation.

name: Bucovina Ultra Rocks
description: Bucovina Ultra Rocks by UTMB te invită să explorezi inima sălbatică a Carpaților Orientali, una dintre ultimele regiuni sălbatice autentice din Europa. Cu șase curse ce variază de la o alergare rapidă de 15 km până la o provocare de 114 km, traseele străbat creste stâncoase, păduri neatinse de UNESCO, stâne medievale și peisaje naturale impresionante precum Cheile Moara Dracului și Pietrele Doamnei. Așteaptă-te la urcări abrupte, poteci tehnice și condiții montane autentice, fiecare kilometru oferind o experiență unică în sălbăticia europeană.

name: Cer Night trail
description: Cer Night Trail is a night race held on Mount Cer, known for its beautiful natural scenery and challenging trails. The race brings together trail-running enthusiasts who enjoy running through forests and mountain terrain beneath the starry sky. The event is part of the Cer Trail race series, which promotes community, perseverance, and a love of nature. Cer Night Trail gives runners the opportunity to experience the magic of night trail running in the unique setting of Mount Cer.
course_highlights: A night race through the forests and mountain terrain of Mount Cer
Challenging trails with natural obstacles and beautiful views
A sense of community and support among runners
additional: Cer Night Trail is part of the Cer Trail race series, which also includes Cer Winter Trail and Cer Ultra Trail. The race is a member of the UTMB and ITRA communities. The Instagram profile promotes the values of community, support, and runners’ strength, especially that of women. Photos and videos from previous races are available on the Instagram profile.

name: 10ο WAVE Running
description: Το 10ο WAVE Running επιστρέφει δυναμικά στις 24-25 Ιουλίου 2026 στην ακτογραμμή Κεραμωτής - Αβδήρων, με κεντρική βάση την παραλία Μυρωδάτου στη Ξάνθη. Η επετειακή διοργάνωση προσφέρει τρεις διαδρομές 5 km, 10 km και 28 km μέσα στο μοναδικό φυσικό περιβάλλον του Δέλτα Νέστου. Παράλληλες δράσεις αναδεικνύουν τον χαρακτήρα και τη φιλοσοφία του θεσμού, όπως καθαρισμό ακτών, έκθεση τοπικών προϊόντων και μουσικά δρώμενα, δημιουργώντας μια ολοκληρωμένη γιορτή αθλητισμού, φύσης και πολιτισμού.

name: SEMIMARATON TARA DE PIATRĂ
description: Semimaratonul Țara de Piatră este o cursă de alergare ce se desfășoară pe 26 iulie 2026 în zona Avram Iancu, Câmpeni, Alba, România. Participanții pot alege între trei curse de diferite distanțe, alergând pe trasee ce trec prin peisaje istorice și naturale ale Apusenilor, încărcate cu spiritul strămoșilor. Startul este programat la ora 8:00, iar transportul către linia de start este asigurat cu autocare. Kitul de concurs se ridică sâmbăta și duminica dimineața înainte de start. Evenimentul oferă o experiență autentică și energizantă pentru alergători de toate nivelurile.

name: 2ο Oinousses Run
description: Ο 2ος Oinousses Run είναι ένας μοναδικός αγώνας που συνδυάζει τρέξιμο και ποδηλασία στο μαγευτικό νησί των Οινουσσών. Η διαδρομή των 13 χλμ για το τρέξιμο περνά από το ιστορικό μοναστήρι του Ευαγγελισμού και προσφέρει εντυπωσιακή θέα προς τη Χίο, ενώ η ποδηλατική διαδρομή των 20 χλμ κάνει έναν πλήρη γύρο του νησιού με ήπιες ανηφόρες και γρήγορες κατηφόρες. Οι συμμετέχοντες απολαμβάνουν μια όμορφη εμπειρία μέσα σε γραφικά τοπία και παραθαλάσσιες διαδρομές, με παροχές όπως ηλεκτρονική χρονομέτρηση, μετάλλιο, αναμνηστικό T-shirt και σταθμούς ανεφοδιασμού. Ο αγώνας διοργανώνεται από τους Ποδηλάτες Χίου και τον Δήμο Οινουσσών, προσφέροντας μια φιλική και καλοκαιρινή αθλητική εκδήλωση.

name: Славееви Планини Ултра
distance_verbose: 50 km, 50 km, 33 km, 28 km, 16 km, 10 km
description: Slaveevi Planini Ultra 2026 is a trail running and mountain biking event held in the surroundings of the town of Dospat in the Rhodope Mountains. The event offers a variety of distances from 9 to 56 km, with different difficulty levels and up to 2,900 m of elevation gain. Participants can enjoy scenic forests, panoramic views, and fresh air, combining sport, adventure, and a love of the mountains. The start and finish are in the town center, and the race is suitable for both experienced runners and cyclists and enthusiasts looking for new challenges.
course_highlights: Distances from 9 to 56 km with up to 2,900 m of elevation gain
Route through scenic forests with panoramic views
Start and finish in the center of Dospat
additional: The race package includes a medal, a souvenir bearing the event logo, timing, a race number, course marking, photo coverage, and aid stations. Additional and mandatory equipment is not included. Registration at lower fees is available until April 30, 2026, 23:59:59; payment is due by May 2 at 12:00. Registration at early-bird fees is available until April 30, 2026, with medals, race packages, and aid stations included.

name: Национален шампионат по шосейни бягания
description: The first national road running championship in Bulgaria will take place in Plovdiv on August 1, 2026. The competition includes distances of 1 mile, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, as well as races for children and beginners. The event is part of the Run Bulgaria series and offers a prize fund of over BGN 4,000. It is an important opportunity for recreational and professional runners to compete on attractive courses and prepare for European and world championships.

name: С ухание на малини и боровинки Run
description: With the scent of raspberries and blueberries, Run is an exciting trail running race held in northwestern Bulgaria, in the area around Midzhur Hut and Kopren Hut. Participants can choose from various courses with different difficulty levels and technical features, running amid breathtaking mountain views. The race offers adrenaline, new friendships, and a sense of accomplishment on every course. The organizers recommend wearing trail running shoes and remind participants that the race may be canceled in unfavorable weather conditions.

name: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare
description: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare is an event in the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge Series, held in Chepelare, in the Western Rhodope Mountains. The start and finish are at Olympic Square, at an altitude of 1,062 m. The routes pass through Rhodope forests, mountain meadows, and panoramic ridge trails, reaching a high point of 1,872 m. Participants can choose from three distances, which are the same for mountain running and mountain biking.

name: LATERAL Mures 24H ~ 2026
description: Lateral Mures 24H este un eveniment sportiv de anduranță organizat de Asociația Mureș Runners, desfășurat în inima naturii, pe Platoul Cornești din Târgu Mureș. Competiția include probe de 24 de ore pentru MTB și alergare trail, atât individual, cât și pe echipe, precum și o cursă de alergare de 12 ore și o cursă de o buclă de 10,5 km. Traseul este o buclă de aproximativ 10,5 km cu diferență de nivel de 215 m, majoritar prin pădure, marcat vizibil pe timp de zi și cu semne reflectorizante pe timp de noapte. Evenimentul promovează spiritul de echipă, rezistența și pasiunea pentru mișcare în natură.

name: Tura Licuricilor ~ 2026
description: Tura Licuricilor, ediția a 11-a, este un eveniment de alergare organizat în Parcul Franz Joseph din Timișoara, ce are loc pe 1 august 2026, începând cu ora 20:30. Evenimentul este parte din seria Alergotura, care promovează alergarea ca stil de viață și comunitatea sportivă locală. Participanții se pot bucura de o cursă plăcută în aer liber, într-un cadru natural urban, ideal pentru alergători de toate nivelurile. Organizatorii oferă suport și motivație pentru adoptarea alergării, încurajând implicarea comunității.

name: Mogoșa Everesting
organizer: Asociația Club Sportiv de Alergare Montană Maramureș
description: Mogoșa Everesting este o competiție de alergare montană ce se desfășoară pe 1 august 2026 la Lacul Mogoșa, Maramureș, România. Participanții pot concura individual sau în echipe, acumulând ture pe traseul montan pentru a atinge o înălțime totală de Everesting. Evenimentul este organizat de Asociația Club Sportiv de Alergare Montană Maramureș și oferă o experiență provocatoare și comunitară, cu categorii pentru juniori și echipe. Taxele de participare sunt accesibile, iar înscrierile sunt deschise până în limita locurilor disponibile.
